-- Production payloads still require the private loader capability. Only this
-- local Maintenance copy skips that requirement for direct executor testing.

-- Potassium and several other executors scan both the autoexec root and nested
-- folders. If the identical build is already ready, the second copy must not
-- unload/restart it (which also caused duplicated Anti-AFK failure toasts).
if getgenv().__CHSAE_BuildId == "2026-09-20-v3.0-cloverui-local-test-r1"
    and getgenv().__CHSAE_PayloadReady == true then
    return
end

do
    local LOADER_URL = "https://cloverhub.app/clover.lua"
    local env=getgenv()
    local state=env.__CHSAE_AutoExecute
    if state and state.loading and os.clock()-state.started<60 then return end
    if not state then
        state={enabled=false,queued=false}
        env.__CHSAE_AutoExecute=state
        local candidates={queue_on_teleport,queueonteleport,
            type(syn)=="table" and syn.queue_on_teleport,
            type(fluxus)=="table" and fluxus.queue_on_teleport}
        for i=1,4 do if type(candidates[i])=="function" then state.queue=candidates[i];break end end
        state.files=type(isfile)=="function" and type(readfile)=="function" and type(writefile)=="function"
            and type(delfile)=="function" and type(isfolder)=="function" and type(makefolder)=="function"
    end
    state.loading=true;state.started=os.clock();state.url=LOADER_URL
    function state:flagPath()
        local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        return player and "CloverHub/StealAnEgg/autoexec-"..player.UserId..".json"
    end
    function state:arm()
        if not self.files then self.note="Unavailable: readable, writable and deletable flag files required";return end
        if not self.enabled then self.note="Off";return end
        if self.url=="" then self.note="Saved · loader URL not configured";return end
        if not self.queue then self.note="Settings only · executor cannot queue after teleport";return end
        if self.queued then self.note="Armed for hop/rejoin · restarts require executor Auto Execute";return end
        local path=self:flagPath()
        if not path then self.note="Waiting for account";return end
        local code=string.format([=[pcall(function()
if game.PlaceId~=107778070777162 or getgenv().__CloverHubSAE_Session then return end
if type(isfile)~="function" or type(readfile)~="function" or not isfile(%q) then return end
local data=game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(%q))
if type(data)~="table" or data.enabled~=true then return end
loadstring(game:HttpGet(%q))()
end)]=],path,path,self.url)
        local ok,result=pcall(self.queue,code)
        self.queued=ok and result~=false
        self.note=self.queued and "Armed for hop/rejoin · restarts require executor Auto Execute" or "Queue failed · automatic return unavailable"
    end
    function state:restore()
        local ok=pcall(function()
            local path=self:flagPath()
            if self.files and path then
                self.enabled=isfile(path) and game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(path)).enabled==true or false
            end
        end)
        if not ok then self.enabled=false;self.note="Flag read failed";return end
        self:arm()
    end
    function state:set(value)
        if not self.files then self:arm();return false end
        local ok=pcall(function()
            local path=assert(self:flagPath(),"Account unavailable")
            if value then
                for _,folder in ipairs({"CloverHub","CloverHub/StealAnEgg"}) do
                    if not isfolder(folder) then makefolder(folder) end
                end
                writefile(path,game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({enabled=true}))
                assert(isfile(path) and game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(path)).enabled==true)
            else
                if isfile(path) then delfile(path) end
                assert(not isfile(path))
            end
        end)
        if not ok then self.note=value and "Flag save failed · not armed" or "Flag removal failed · queued reload may remain enabled";return false end
        self.enabled=value==true
        self:arm()
        return true
    end
    state:restore()
end

-- Dev-friendly reload: unload the previous instance instead of stacking UIs.
-- Older v0.2 sessions synchronously fired this event from their unload handler;
-- if an awakened status consumer re-entered the event, even loading the fixed
-- build could deadlock before it took ownership. Retire the stale event first so
-- the legacy unload closure observes nil and skips that unsafe Fire.
do
    local staleStatusWake = getgenv().__CHSAE_StatusWake
    getgenv().__CHSAE_StatusWake = nil
    if staleStatusWake then pcall(function() staleStatusWake:Destroy() end) end
end
do
local previousBuild = getgenv().__CHSAE_BuildId
local previousCharacter = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
if getgenv().__CloverHubSAE_Unload or getgenv().__VoidHubSAE_Unload then
    pcall(getgenv().__CloverHubSAE_Unload or getgenv().__VoidHubSAE_Unload)
    getgenv().__CloverHubSAE_Unload = nil
    getgenv().__VoidHubSAE_Unload = nil -- one-release compatibility cleanup
    task.wait(0.15)
end
-- v175 used Physics for flight, which the native Ragdoll module interprets
-- as ragdoll. Its cleanup then refused to stand up. Repair only that build's
-- same inactive rig after unloading; never interrupt a live native ragdoll.
if previousBuild == "2026-09-08-v1.7-arena-sell-v175"
    or previousBuild == "2026-09-08-v1.7-arena-sell-v175-key-r1" then
    local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if character == previousCharacter and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
        and root and not root.Anchored and not humanoid.PlatformStand and not humanoid.Sit
        and humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
        and (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")) or 0) <= workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        and #character:QueryDescendants("BallSocketConstraint") == 0 then
        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end
end
end
-- Belt-and-suspenders: destroy any leftover CloverHub UI (a failed prior unload
-- can strand a duplicate). The former title is accepted once for migration.
-- title, so other Obsidian-based scripts are left alone.
do
    local guiRoots = { game:GetService("CoreGui") }
    pcall(function() if gethui then guiRoots[#guiRoots + 1] = gethui() end end)
    pcall(function() guiRoots[#guiRoots + 1] = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") end)
    for _, root in ipairs(guiRoots) do
        if root then
            -- GetDescendants: the Obsidian ScreenGui is nested (e.g. under RobloxGui),
            -- so GetChildren misses it — that left stale duplicates on reload.
            for _, g in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and g.Name == "Obsidian" then
                    for _, d in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
                        if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton"))
                            and (tostring(d.Text):find("CloverHub", 1, true)
                                or tostring(d.Text):find("VoidHub", 1, true)) then
                            pcall(function() g:Destroy() end)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Session token: background loops check this and exit when a newer script
-- instance takes over (Library:Unload doesn't kill task.spawn loops).
local SESSION = { Marker = {} }
getgenv().__CloverHubSAE_Session = SESSION.Marker
getgenv().__CHSAE_ConfigControllers = {}
local RELEASE_VERSION = "v3.0"
local BUILD_ID = "2026-09-20-v3.0-cloverui-local-test-r1"
getgenv().__CHSAE_ReleaseVersion = RELEASE_VERSION
getgenv().__CHSAE_BuildId = BUILD_ID
local function sessionAlive()
    return getgenv().__CloverHubSAE_Session == SESSION.Marker
end

-- Disabled feature workers share one rare wake signal instead of polling forever.
-- Fire it deferred so a UI callback never runs resumed gameplay work inline.
SESSION.IdleWorkerWake = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
SESSION.IdleWorkerWakeQueued = false
function SESSION.WakeIdleWorkers(reason)
    if not sessionAlive() or SESSION.IdleWorkerWakeQueued then return end
    SESSION.IdleWorkerWakeQueued = true
    task.defer(function()
        SESSION.IdleWorkerWakeQueued = false
        if sessionAlive() then
            pcall(function() SESSION.IdleWorkerWake:Fire(reason or "setting") end)
        end
    end)
end

-- The high-speed CFrame mover does not need Roblox's PlayerModule disabled.
-- Disabling it as soon as a saved Auto-Steal toggle loaded made the character
-- feel anchored while the hub was only scanning/waiting for a target. Always
-- keep normal movement controls enabled; the mover still owns each CFrame
-- during an actual trip.
local function setStealControlLock(_enabled)
    local controls = getgenv().__CHSAE_Controls
    if not controls then return end
    pcall(function() controls:Enable() end)
end

local repo = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deividcomsono/Obsidian/fa7be5477c30e4a302cc60c85e93ecca926d297b/"
do
    local folder = "CloverHub/StealAnEgg/cache"
    local revision = assert(repo:match("/([^/]+)/$"))
    local names = {
        ["Library.lua"] = "Obsidian",
        ["addons/ThemeManager.lua"] = "ThemeManager",
        ["addons/SaveManager.lua"] = "SaveManager",
    }
    local path, versionPath = folder .. "/cloverui.lua", folder .. "/cloverui.version"
    local sources, modules = {}, {}
    local persisted = false
    local function decode(saved)
        local bundle = assert(loadstring(saved, "CloverHub/cloverui"))()
        assert(type(bundle) == "table", "Invalid UI bundle")
        for relative in pairs(names) do
            assert(type(bundle[relative]) == "string" and #bundle[relative] > 0, "Incomplete UI bundle")
            assert(loadstring(bundle[relative], "CloverHub/" .. names[relative]))
        end
        return bundle
    end
    if type(readfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
        pcall(function()
            if isfile(versionPath) and isfile(path) and readfile(versionPath) == revision then
                sources = decode(readfile(path))
                persisted = true
            end
        end)
    end
    function SESSION.LoadUI(relative)
        local name = assert(names[relative], "Unknown UI dependency")
        if modules[relative] then return modules[relative] end
        local source = sources[relative]
        if not source and type(readfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
            pcall(function()
                local oldPath = folder .. "/" .. name
                if isfile(oldPath .. ".version") and isfile(oldPath .. ".lua")
                    and readfile(oldPath .. ".version") == revision then
                    local saved = readfile(oldPath .. ".lua")
                    if type(saved) == "string" and #saved > 0 and loadstring(saved) then
                        source = saved
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        if not source then
            source = game:HttpGet(repo .. relative)
            assert(type(source) == "string" and #source > 0, "Empty UI download: " .. name)
        end
        local chunk, err = loadstring(source, "CloverHub/" .. name)
        assert(chunk, err)
        local result = chunk()
        assert(type(result) == "table", "Invalid UI module: " .. name)
        sources[relative], modules[relative] = source, result
        for dependency in pairs(names) do
            if not modules[dependency] then return result end
        end
        if not persisted and type(writefile) == "function" and type(isfolder) == "function"
            and type(makefolder) == "function" then
            local ok, issue = pcall(function()
                local parts = { "return {" }
                for dependency in pairs(names) do
                    parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("[%q]=%q,", dependency, sources[dependency])
                end
                parts[#parts + 1] = "}"
                local bundle = table.concat(parts, "\n")
                decode(bundle)
                for _, directory in ipairs({ "CloverHub", "CloverHub/StealAnEgg", folder }) do
                    if not isfolder(directory) then makefolder(directory) end
                end
                writefile(versionPath, "")
                writefile(path, bundle)
                assert(type(readfile) == "function" and readfile(path) == bundle, "UI cache readback failed")
                writefile(versionPath, revision)
                assert(readfile(versionPath) == revision, "UI cache version readback failed")
                persisted = true
            end)
            if not ok then warn("[CloverHub-SAE] UI cache unavailable: " .. tostring(issue)) end
        end
        if persisted and type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
            for _, oldName in pairs(names) do
                for _, suffix in ipairs({ ".lua", ".version" }) do
                    local oldPath = folder .. "/" .. oldName .. suffix
                    pcall(function() if isfile(oldPath) then delfile(oldPath) end end)
                end
            end
        end
        return result
    end
end

-- [[ INSTANT MANUAL EGG PICKUP ]] --
-- Auto-Steal invokes EggState directly, but a player pressing/tapping the native
-- CarryAreaEgg prompt normally holds for 0.25 or 1.2 seconds. Keep manual pickup
-- on the game's own prompt transaction while removing only that local hold. The
-- event-driven hook also covers dropped and Admin Abuse eggs created later.
do
    local env = getgenv()
    local durationGetter = rawget(env, "getproximitypromptduration")
    local durationSetter = rawget(env, "setproximitypromptduration")
    local originalDurations = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local state = {
        Patched = 0,
        ExecutorSetter = type(durationSetter) == "function",
    }
    local shownConn

    local function isManualEggPrompt(prompt)
        return typeof(prompt) == "Instance"
            and prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
            and prompt.Name == "CarryAreaEgg"
    end

    local function readDuration(prompt)
        if type(durationGetter) == "function" then
            local ok, value = pcall(durationGetter, prompt)
            if ok and tonumber(value) then return tonumber(value) end
        end
        return tonumber(prompt.HoldDuration) or 0
    end

    local function writeDuration(prompt, value)
        if type(durationSetter) == "function" then
            pcall(durationSetter, prompt, value)
        end
        -- Keep the visible/custom prompt UI synchronized on executors where the
        -- InstantPP primitive changes only the internal interaction duration.
        pcall(function() prompt.HoldDuration = value end)
    end

    local function makeInstant(prompt)
        if not isManualEggPrompt(prompt) then return end
        if originalDurations[prompt] == nil then
            originalDurations[prompt] = readDuration(prompt)
            state.Patched += 1
        end
        writeDuration(prompt, 0)
    end

    local ok, prompts = pcall(function()
        return workspace:QueryDescendants("ProximityPrompt#CarryAreaEgg")
    end)
    if ok and type(prompts) == "table" then
        for _, prompt in ipairs(prompts) do makeInstant(prompt) end
    else
        -- Compatibility fallback for executors without QueryDescendants. This is
        -- a one-time scan; future prompts use ProximityPromptService below.
        for _, instance in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if isManualEggPrompt(instance) then makeInstant(instance) end
        end
    end

    shownConn = ProximityPromptService.PromptShown:Connect(function(prompt)
        makeInstant(prompt)
    end)

    env.__CHSAE_InstantPPState = state
    env.__CHSAE_InstantPPRestore = function()
        if shownConn then pcall(function() shownConn:Disconnect() end) end
        for prompt, duration in pairs(originalDurations) do
            if prompt.Parent ~= nil then writeDuration(prompt, duration) end
        end
        table.clear(originalDurations)
    end
end

-- [[ 2. HELPERS ]] --
-- Game-HUD-style number format: TRUNCATED to 1 decimal, ".0" stripped —
-- matches exactly what the in-game UI shows (3,996,839 → "3.9M", 16e9 → "16B").
local function short(n)
    n = tonumber(n) or 0
    local neg = n < 0
    local abs = math.abs(n)
    for _, p in ipairs({ {1e12,"T"}, {1e9,"B"}, {1e6,"M"}, {1e3,"K"} }) do
        if abs >= p[1] then
            local v = math.floor(abs / p[1] * 10) / 10
            local s = (v % 1 == 0) and tostring(math.floor(v)) or string.format("%.1f", v)
            return (neg and "-" or "") .. s .. p[2]
        end
    end
    return (neg and "-" or "") .. tostring(math.floor(abs))
end

local function fmtClock(sec)
    sec = math.floor(sec)
    -- Prometheus' LuaU parser does not accept the floor-division token (`//`).
    -- Explicit floors are equivalent here and remain valid in Roblox Luau.
    return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d",
        math.floor(sec / 3600), math.floor((sec % 3600) / 60), sec % 60)
end

local function toHex(c3)
    return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X",
        math.floor(c3.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c3.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c3.B * 255 + 0.5))
end

local function humanWait(a, b)
    task.wait(a + math.random() * ((b or a) - a))
end

-- Rarity data straight from the game's Directory
local function getRarityData()
    local entries = {}
    pcall(function()
        local R = require(ReplicatedStorage.Data.Rarity)
        local seen = {}
        for _, v in pairs(R.Rarities) do
            if type(v) == "table" and v._id and not seen[v._id] then
                seen[v._id] = true
                entries[#entries + 1] = {
                    id    = v._id,
                    num   = tonumber(v.RarityNumber) or 0,
                    color = v.Color,
                    odds  = v.DefaultRarityValue,
                }
            end
        end
        table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
            if a.num ~= b.num then return a.num > b.num end
            return a.id < b.id
        end)
    end)
    return entries
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════
-- 💾 CONFIG PERSISTENCE — every setting, one JSON file
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════
-- The whole `Settings` table IS the private automatic config — no per-control
-- save code, so any setting added later persists automatically. Named/shared
-- profiles use a redacted snapshot below and never receive WebhookURL.
-- Loaded HERE, before a single control is built, so every dropdown/toggle/
-- slider comes up with your saved value on a fresh server (rejoin, server hop,
-- or a plain re-execute).
--
-- FILE LAYOUT (CloverHub keeps a separate Steal an Egg profile):
-- can never read each other's config):
--   CloverHub/universalToggle(SAG).json  → { "UseUniversalConfig": true|false }
--   CloverHub/universalConfig(SAG).json  → shared by every account on this PC
--   CloverHub/config(SAG)_<UserId>.json  → DEFAULT: per-user, so two accounts
--                                        don't overwrite each other's setup
--
-- Auto-save checks scalar/selection values against the last saved snapshot every
-- 3 s. Unchanged checks do not copy Settings, sort keys, build strings or encode
-- JSON. Keep direct Settings writes and picker table references compatible.
--
local ConfigMeta = {
    loaded = false, lastSave = 0, note = "never saved",
    migrated = false,
    legacyPath = "VoidHub/config(SAG)_" .. tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId) .. ".json",
}
local CONFIG_DIR    = "CloverHub"
local CONFIG_TOGGLE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/universalToggle(SAG).json"
local CONFIG_PATH   = CONFIG_DIR .. "/config(SAG)_" .. tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId) .. ".json"
do -- flip to the shared file only if the toggle file says so
    local ok, universal = pcall(function()
        local togglePath = isfile and isfile(CONFIG_TOGGLE) and CONFIG_TOGGLE
            or (isfile and isfile("VoidHub/universalToggle(SAG).json")
                and "VoidHub/universalToggle(SAG).json")
        if togglePath then
            local d = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(togglePath))
            return type(d) == "table" and d.UseUniversalConfig == true
        end
        return false
    end)
    if ok and universal then
        CONFIG_PATH = CONFIG_DIR .. "/universalConfig(SAG).json"
        ConfigMeta.legacyPath = "VoidHub/universalConfig(SAG).json"
    end
end

local function configSig(t, depth)
    local keys = {}
    for k in pairs(t) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
        local v = t[k]
        if type(v) == "table" then
            parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(k) .. "={" .. (((depth or 0) < 3) and configSig(v, (depth or 0) + 1) or "…") .. "}"
        else
            parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(k) .. "=" .. tostring(v)
        end
    end
    return table.concat(parts, ",")
end

-- [[ DELIVERY SPEED PROFILE ]] --
function ConfigMeta.normalizeDeliverySpeeds(profile)
    profile = type(profile) == "table" and profile or {}
    local mode = Settings.StealMovementType == "Tween" and "Tween" or "TP"
    for _, name in ipairs({ "TP", "Tween" }) do
        local key = name .. "ReturnSpeed"
        local value = tonumber(profile[key])
        if value == nil and name == mode then value = tonumber(profile.StealSpeed or profile.HopSpeed or profile.TweenSpeed) end
        if not value or value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then
            value = 700
        end
        Settings[key] = math.clamp(math.floor(value + 0.5), 100, 1000)
    end
    Settings.StealSpeed = Settings[mode .. "ReturnSpeed"]
end
-- [[ END DELIVERY SPEED PROFILE ]] --

local function configLoad()
    Settings.Stall = false
    if not (isfile and readfile) then ConfigMeta.note = "no file API"; return false end
    local sourcePath = isfile(CONFIG_PATH) and CONFIG_PATH
        or (isfile(ConfigMeta.legacyPath) and ConfigMeta.legacyPath)
    local ok, raw = pcall(function() return sourcePath and readfile(sourcePath) or nil end)
    if not (ok and type(raw) == "string" and #raw > 2) then ConfigMeta.note = "no saved config"; return false end
    local ok2, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if not (ok2 and type(data) == "table") then ConfigMeta.note = "⚠️ corrupt file — using defaults"; return false end

    for k, def in pairs(Settings) do
        if k == "Stall" then continue end
        local v = data[k]
        if v ~= nil then
            if type(def) == "table" and type(v) == "table" then
                -- MERGE IN PLACE: the overlay pickers hold a reference to this exact
                -- table, so replacing it would silently orphan their store.
                for kk in pairs(def) do def[kk] = nil end
                for kk, vv in pairs(v) do if vv == true then def[kk] = true end end
            elseif type(def) == type(v) then
                Settings[k] = v
            end
        end
    end
    -- Seller thresholds are irreversible safety inputs. Type-mismatched or
    -- missing values must not be skipped while a saved Auto-Sell flag is kept.
    local function savedSellerFloorValid(key)
        local value = data[key]
        return type(value) == "number" and value == value
            and value >= 0 and value < math.huge
    end
    if not savedSellerFloorValid("FuseMinimumValue")
        or not savedSellerFloorValid("FuseKGThreshold")
        or (data.FuseKGMode ~= "Any" and data.FuseKGMode ~= "Above" and data.FuseKGMode ~= "Below") then
        Settings.AutoFuse = false
        Settings.FuseMinimumValue, Settings.FuseKGThreshold, Settings.FuseKGMode = 0, 0, "Any"
    end
    if not savedSellerFloorValid("SellPetValueThreshold") then
        Settings.SellPetValueThreshold = 0
        Settings.AutoSell = false
        Settings.SellPetsWhenFull = false
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if not savedSellerFloorValid("SellEggValueThreshold") then
        Settings.SellEggValueThreshold = 0
        Settings.AutoSellEggs = false
        Settings.SellEggsWhenFull = false
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    -- Public v0.1 changes the safe default from distance/value-first to rarity-first.
    -- Migrate old profiles once; later user changes continue to save normally.
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 1 then
        Settings.TargetPriority = "Rarity"
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 2 then
        -- v0.2 efficiency profile: preserve explicit Straight/Default choices,
        -- but upgrade the previous safe default into the requested hybrid route.
        if Settings.StealRoute == "Wall to Wall" then Settings.StealRoute = "Turbo Hybrid" end
        if Settings.StealRoute == "Y Level" then Settings.StealRoute = "Fly" end
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 3 then
        -- The status overlay used to default ON, which also persisted that
        -- accidental default into existing profiles. Hide it once; users can
        -- still explicitly enable Show Status afterward.
        Settings.ShowStatusOverlay = false
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 4 then
        -- v0.4 cleanup: retire the removed one-shot mutation experiment safely.
        -- Its old transaction keys are not part of Settings and the rewritten
        -- config drops them; Auto Mutate is disarmed once in case it was coupled.
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 5 then
        -- v0.6 adds explicit full-inventory sellers and refreshes the config schema.
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 6 then
        -- Sideways facing is now part of registered movement instead of a setting.
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 7 then
        -- Guard protection is now an explicit opt-in control.
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 8 then
        -- Ordinary runtime controls resume as saved. WebhookURL is private to
        -- the local automatic profile and is redacted only when a named/shared
        -- config is serialized later in this file. Irreversible sellers are now
        -- the deliberate exception and require fresh session approval.
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 9 then
        -- v1.0 retires Great Bloom/Incubator automation and introduces the
        -- previous event flow and its protected-egg filters.
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 10 then
        -- v1.3 adds compact native-income filters to Steal and both sellers.
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 11 then
        -- v77 changes seller Value into a strict keep floor and repairs mobile
        -- blur commits. Disarm irreversible sellers once so every upgraded user
        -- reviews the new Minimum Value before the first batch can run.
        Settings.AutoSell = false
        Settings.SellPetsWhenFull = false
        Settings.AutoSellEggs = false
        Settings.SellEggsWhenFull = false
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 12 then
        -- v82 adds an explicit irreversible-sale review. Existing persisted
        -- seller toggles are disarmed once so the first activation must pass
        -- through the new live match preview.
        Settings.AutoSell = false
        Settings.SellPetsWhenFull = false
        Settings.AutoSellEggs = false
        Settings.SellEggsWhenFull = false
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 14 then
        -- Retired movement engines migrate to the single maintained Glide engine.
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    -- Seller consent is session-only. A saved ON flag must never start an
    -- irreversible worker during autoexecute before the user can see the live
    -- match preview in this Roblox session.
    Settings.AutoSell = false
    Settings.SellPetsWhenFull = false
    Settings.AutoSellEggs = false
    Settings.SellEggsWhenFull = false
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 15 then
        Settings.AutoRift, Settings.PriorityEvent, Settings.RiftMinimumValue = false, false, 0
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    elseif not savedSellerFloorValid("RiftMinimumValue") then
        Settings.AutoRift, Settings.RiftMinimumValue = false, 0
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 16 then
        -- User deferred the collection flow while movement is investigated.
        Settings.AutoRift = false
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if (tonumber(data.ConfigRevision) or 0) < 17 then
        ConfigMeta.migrated = true
    end
    if Settings.StealRoute == "Chicken TP" then Settings.StealRoute = "Straight" end
    Settings.ConfigRevision = 17
    -- v3 migration: keep the user's prior Hop/Tween speed, but retire both old
    -- movement modes and the separate step-size setting.
    if data.StealSpeed == nil then
        Settings.StealSpeed = tonumber(data.HopSpeed or data.TweenSpeed) or 800
    end
    Settings.StealSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.StealSpeed) or 800, 100, 1000)
    if Settings.StealRoute == "Wall to Wall" then Settings.StealRoute = "Turbo Hybrid" end
    if Settings.StealRoute == "Y Level" then Settings.StealRoute = "Fly" end
    if Settings.StealRoute ~= "Straight" and Settings.StealRoute ~= "Default"
        and Settings.StealRoute ~= "Turbo Hybrid" and Settings.StealRoute ~= "Fly" then
        Settings.StealRoute = "Straight"
    end
    Settings.StealMovementBackend = "Glide"
    if Settings.StealMovementType ~= "Tween" then Settings.StealMovementType = "TP" end
    Settings.StealRagdoll = nil
    if Settings.StealRoute == "Default" then Settings.StealRoute = "Straight" end
    ConfigMeta.normalizeDeliverySpeeds(data)
    Settings.HoverRunSpeed = nil -- discard the retired saved setting
    Settings.StealWallSpacing = "Wide Wall"
    -- v4.5 migration: the old switch meant move when true. The new user-facing
    -- Prevent Snap switch means wait for range when true.
    if data.PlaceInRangeOnly == nil and type(data.PlaceMoveToPen) == "boolean" then
        Settings.PlaceInRangeOnly = not data.PlaceMoveToPen
    end
    -- v4.6 migration: the old master Enabled switch is gone. Preserve its
    -- effective state once, so an old disabled profile cannot start sending.
    if data.WebhookMutations == nil and data.WebhookHatches == nil then
        Settings.WebhookSteals = data.WebhookEnabled == true and data.WebhookSteals ~= false
    end


    ConfigMeta.loaded = true
    ConfigMeta.note   = sourcePath == ConfigMeta.legacyPath and "loaded legacy profile" or "loaded"
    return true
end

-- Private automatic persistence and shareable configs deliberately use two
-- views of the same Settings table. The default is fail-closed for callers:
-- only an explicit true may include the Discord webhook token.
local function configSnapshot(includeWebhookURL)
    local snapshot = {}
    for key, value in pairs(Settings) do
        if key == "Stall" then continue end
        if includeWebhookURL == true or key ~= "WebhookURL" then
            if type(value) == "table" then
                local copy = {}
                for item, enabled in pairs(value) do copy[item] = enabled end
                snapshot[key] = copy
            else
                snapshot[key] = value
            end
        end
    end
    -- Consent to an irreversible seller is intentionally session-ephemeral;
    -- persist its filters, never an armed worker.
    snapshot.AutoSell = false
    snapshot.SellPetsWhenFull = false
    snapshot.AutoSellEggs = false
    snapshot.SellEggsWhenFull = false
    return snapshot
end

-- [[ AUTOMATIC CONFIG PERSISTENCE CONTROLLER ]] --
function ConfigMeta.CreatePersistence(deps)
    local controller = {}
    local lastSnapshot, saving, retry = nil, false, false
    -- These flags are session consent, not persistent settings. Keep the same
    -- normalization as configSnapshot without allocating a snapshot on each tick.
    local ephemeral = { AutoSell = true, SellPetsWhenFull = true,
        AutoSellEggs = true, SellEggsWhenFull = true }
    local function unchanged()
        if not lastSnapshot then return false end
        for key, value in pairs(deps.settings) do
            if key == "Stall" then continue end
            if ephemeral[key] then value = false end
            local saved = lastSnapshot[key]
            if type(value) == "table" then
                if type(saved) ~= "table" then return false end
                -- Settings tables are flat boolean selection stores. Compare
                -- both directions so in-place removals and false entries count.
                for item, enabled in pairs(value) do
                    if saved[item] ~= enabled then return false end
                end
                for item, enabled in pairs(saved) do
                    if value[item] ~= enabled then return false end
                end
            elseif value ~= saved then return false end
        end
        for key in pairs(lastSnapshot) do
            if not ephemeral[key] and deps.settings[key] == nil then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    function controller:Prime()
        -- Only a non-migrated load is the baseline. A failed migration save must
        -- remain dirty, not be marked saved by startup initialization.
        if saving or not deps.alive() then return false end
        lastSnapshot = deps.snapshot()
        return true
    end
    function controller:Save(force)
        if not deps.alive() or deps.blocked() then return false end
        if saving then
            if force then retry = true end -- coalesce force requests until next tick
            return false
        end
        if not force and not retry and unchanged() then return false end
        saving, retry = true, false
        local ok, written = pcall(function()
            local snapshot = deps.snapshot()
            local encodedOk, encoded = pcall(deps.encode, snapshot)
            if not encodedOk then deps.meta.note = "⚠️ encode failed"; return false end
            -- Encoding/file APIs may yield on some executors. Never begin a
            -- write from a superseded session or after NoSave became enabled.
            if not deps.alive() or deps.blocked() then return false end
            if not pcall(deps.write, encoded) then
                deps.meta.note = "⚠️ write failed"
                return false
            end
            lastSnapshot = snapshot -- commit only the snapshot actually written
            deps.meta.lastSave, deps.meta.note = deps.time(), "saved"
            return true
        end)
        saving = false
        if not ok then deps.meta.note = "⚠️ save failed" end
        if not ok or not written then retry = true end
        return ok and written == true
    end
    return controller
end
-- [[ AUTOMATIC CONFIG FILE ADAPTER ]] --
ConfigMeta.persistence = ConfigMeta.CreatePersistence({
    settings = Settings, meta = ConfigMeta, alive = sessionAlive,
    blocked = function() return getgenv().__CloverHubSAE_NoSave or getgenv().__VoidHubSAE_NoSave end,
    snapshot = function() return configSnapshot(true) end,
    encode = function(snapshot) return HttpService:JSONEncode(snapshot) end,
    write = function(encoded)
        pcall(function()
            if makefolder and isfolder and not isfolder(CONFIG_DIR) then makefolder(CONFIG_DIR) end
        end)
        if not sessionAlive() or getgenv().__CloverHubSAE_NoSave or getgenv().__VoidHubSAE_NoSave then
            error("config save cancelled", 0)
        end
        writefile(CONFIG_PATH, encoded)
    end,
    time = os.time,
})
local function configSave(force)
    if SESSION.InventoryWake then SESSION.InventoryWake("config") end
    if not writefile then ConfigMeta.note = "no file API"; return false end
    return ConfigMeta.persistence:Save(force)
end

configLoad()
do
    -- Flat scalar keys are deliberate: configLoad treats table defaults as
    -- boolean selection stores. Invalid/legacy values fail safely to disabled.
    for _, keys in ipairs({
        { "TargetKGMode", "TargetKGThreshold" },
        { "SellPetKGMode", "SellPetKGThreshold" },
        { "SellEggKGMode", "SellEggKGThreshold" },
        { "FuseKGMode", "FuseKGThreshold" },
    }) do
        local modeKey, thresholdKey = keys[1], keys[2]
        local mode = Settings[modeKey]
        if mode ~= "Below" and mode ~= "Above" and mode ~= "Any" then
            Settings[modeKey] = "Any"
            ConfigMeta.migrated = true
        end
        local threshold = math.max(tonumber(Settings[thresholdKey]) or 0, 0)
        if Settings[thresholdKey] ~= threshold then
            Settings[thresholdKey] = threshold
            ConfigMeta.migrated = true
        end
    end
    for _, thresholdKey in ipairs({
        "TargetValueThreshold", "SellPetValueThreshold", "SellEggValueThreshold", "RiftMinimumValue", "FuseMinimumValue",
    }) do
        local threshold = tonumber(Settings[thresholdKey])
        local valid = type(threshold) == "number" and threshold == threshold
            and threshold >= 0 and threshold < math.huge
        if not valid then
            threshold = 0
            if thresholdKey == "SellPetValueThreshold" then
                Settings.AutoSell = false
                Settings.SellPetsWhenFull = false
            elseif thresholdKey == "SellEggValueThreshold" then
                Settings.AutoSellEggs = false
                Settings.SellEggsWhenFull = false
            end
        end
        if Settings[thresholdKey] ~= threshold then
            Settings[thresholdKey] = threshold
            ConfigMeta.migrated = true
        end
    end
end
if Settings.AutoRift ~= true then Settings.AutoRift = false end
if Settings.PriorityEvent ~= true then Settings.PriorityEvent = false end
if ConfigMeta.migrated then configSave(true)
else ConfigMeta.persistence:Prime() end -- loading itself is not a change

-- Always on: whatever you change in the hub is on disk within ~3s.
task.spawn(function()
    while sessionAlive() do
        task.wait(3)
        if not sessionAlive() then break end
        pcall(configSave)
    end
end)

function RuntimeStatus.isCaptureEventUid(uid)

function RuntimeStatus.clearRiftClaimHandoff(uid)
    if uid == nil
        or tostring(RuntimeStatus.riftClaimHandoffUid) == tostring(uid) then
        RuntimeStatus.riftClaimHandoffUid = nil
        RuntimeStatus.riftClaimHandoffAt = 0
    end
end
function RuntimeStatus.riftClaimHandoffPending()
    local uid = RuntimeStatus.riftClaimHandoffUid
    local claimedAt = tonumber(RuntimeStatus.riftClaimHandoffAt) or 0
    local grace = tonumber(RuntimeStatus.riftClaimHandoffGrace) or 2.5
    if Settings.AutoRift ~= true or uid == nil or claimedAt <= 0
        or os.clock() - claimedAt > grace then
        RuntimeStatus.clearRiftClaimHandoff(uid)
        return false
    end
    return true
end
-- Main stealing owns first choice; event collection uses otherwise idle time.

    if Settings.AutoSteal ~= true then return false end
    if type(RuntimeStatus.normalStealTargetAvailable) == "function" then
        return RuntimeStatus.normalStealTargetAvailable()
    end
    return true -- allow the main scanner to initialize before starting event work
end

function RuntimeStatus.adminEventHasPriority()
    if Settings.AutoSteal == true then return false end

    return Settings.AutoRift == true and (RuntimeStatus.riftClaimHandoffPending()
        or RuntimeStatus.riftWantsBody == true or RuntimeStatus.riftPlacementWanted == true)
end
-- [[ RIFT PLANNER ]] --
-- Pure rules; native decoding and eligibility are supplied by the adapter.
RuntimeStatus.RiftPlanner = {}
function RuntimeStatus.RiftPlanner.Signature(state)
    if type(state) ~= "table" or type(state.Requirements) ~= "table"
        or #state.Requirements ~= 3 then return nil end
    local parts = { tostring(state.BannerId or "") }
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local category = state.Requirements[i]
        if type(category) ~= "string" or category == "" then return nil end
        parts[#parts + 1] = category
    end
    return table.concat(parts, "\31")
end
function RuntimeStatus.RiftPlanner.ValueAllowed(value, known, minimum)
    if type(minimum) ~= "number" or minimum ~= minimum
        or minimum < 0 or minimum >= math.huge then return false end
    if known ~= true or type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value
        or value < 0 or value >= math.huge then return false end
    return minimum == 0 or value < minimum
end
function RuntimeStatus.RiftPlanner.Plan(state, pets, eggs)
    local signature = RuntimeStatus.RiftPlanner.Signature(state)
    if not signature then return nil end
    local plan = { signature = signature, slots = {}, pets = {}, eggs = {}, missing = {}, ready = true }
    local function cheapest(list, category, used)
        local best
        for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
            if entry.category == category and not used[entry.uid]
                and (not best or entry.value < best.value
                    or (entry.value == best.value and entry.uid < best.uid)) then best = entry end
        end
        return best
    end
    for i, category in ipairs(state.Requirements) do
        local pet = cheapest(pets, category, plan.pets)
        local slot = { category = category }
        if pet then
            plan.pets[pet.uid] = true
            slot.petUid, slot.waiting = pet.uid, pet.waiting == true
            if slot.waiting then plan.ready = false end
        else
            plan.ready = false
            local egg = cheapest(eggs, category, plan.eggs)
            if egg then
                plan.eggs[egg.uid] = true
                slot.eggUid, slot.placed = egg.uid, egg.placed == true
            else
                plan.missing[category] = (plan.missing[category] or 0) + 1
            end
        end
        plan.slots[i] = slot
    end
    return plan
end
function RuntimeStatus.RiftPlanner.Action(enabled, protected, normalAvailable, priority, pending, plan)
    if not enabled then return "off" end
    if protected then return "transaction" end
    if normalAvailable then return "normal" end
    if pending then return "claim" end
    if not plan then return "state" end
    if plan.ready then return "trade" end
    for _, slot in ipairs(plan.slots) do
        if slot.eggUid and not slot.placed then return "place" end
    end
    if next(plan.missing) ~= nil then return "collect" end
    return "hatch"
end

-- Status cards are written by several workers. Avoid invalidating the same UI
-- hierarchy every polling pass, and provide one lightweight wake signal for the
-- overlay so it can react to real state changes instead of formatting at 4 Hz.
RuntimeStatus.statusWake = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
getgenv().__CHSAE_StatusWake = RuntimeStatus.statusWake
RuntimeStatus.statusLabelCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
RuntimeStatus.statusWakeBusy = false
RuntimeStatus.statusWakePending = nil
RuntimeStatus.presentationInterval = function()
    return (RuntimeStatus.clientFPS or 60) < 35 and 0.25 or 0.1
end
function RuntimeStatus.wakeOverlay(reason)
    if not sessionAlive() then return end
    RuntimeStatus.statusWakePending = reason or "status"
    if RuntimeStatus.statusWakeBusy then return end
    RuntimeStatus.statusWakeBusy = true
    -- BindableEvent:Fire resumes Event:Wait listeners synchronously. One resumed
    -- arbiter worker can set another status before returning to Wait, recursively
    -- firing the same event and hanging the entire producer (observed for 30 s in
    -- setStealStatus after a claim). Isolate and coalesce the wake so status/UI
    -- listeners can never block movement, carry completion, or the loader thread.
    task.defer(function()
        while sessionAlive() and RuntimeStatus.statusWakePending ~= nil do
            local pending = RuntimeStatus.statusWakePending
            RuntimeStatus.statusWakePending = nil
            pcall(function() RuntimeStatus.statusWake:Fire(pending) end)
            task.wait(RuntimeStatus.presentationInterval())
        end
        RuntimeStatus.statusWakeBusy = false
    end)
end
function RuntimeStatus.setLabel(label, text)
    text = tostring(text)
    if not label or RuntimeStatus.statusLabelCache[label] == text then return false end
    RuntimeStatus.statusLabelCache[label] = text
    -- Obsidian's Label:SetText performs a synchronous layout refresh. During a
    -- snapshot replacement the steal worker can change status several times in
    -- one scheduler turn; the library refresh then re-enters groupbox layout and
    -- has been observed hanging the client for 30+ seconds. Update the native
    -- TextLabel directly when available so status presentation can never block
    -- movement or target reconciliation. Keep SetText only as a compatibility
    -- fallback for a future library object without an exposed TextLabel.
    local textLabel = type(label) == "table" and rawget(label, "TextLabel") or nil
    local ok
    -- Even Instance:IsA is protected for the identity-2 worker when Obsidian is
    -- parented under CoreGui, so do not touch the instance before elevating.
    if typeof(textLabel) == "Instance" then
        local originalIdentity = type(getthreadidentity) == "function" and getthreadidentity() or nil
        if type(setthreadidentity) == "function" then pcall(setthreadidentity, 8) end
        ok = pcall(function()
            textLabel.Text = text
            rawset(label, "Text", text)
        end)
        if originalIdentity ~= nil and type(setthreadidentity) == "function" then
            pcall(setthreadidentity, originalIdentity)
        end
    else
        ok = pcall(function() label:SetText(text) end)
    end
    if ok then RuntimeStatus.wakeOverlay("label") end
    return ok
end
function RuntimeStatus.set(key, value)
    value = tostring(value)
    if RuntimeStatus[key] == value then return false end
    RuntimeStatus[key] = value
    RuntimeStatus.wakeOverlay(key)
    return true
end

end

-- Reused by Steal and both sellers. Each feature gets only the two
-- requested controls and evaluates them inside its existing scan/pass.
function RuntimeStatus.addKGFilterControls(groupbox, idPrefix, modeKey, thresholdKey, onChange, protection)
    local picker = BindDropdownOverlay(groupbox, idPrefix .. "KGMode", protection and "Prevent KG" or "KG Rule",
        RuntimeStatus.kgFilterModes, {
        configKey = modeKey,
        multi = false,
        text = protection and "Prevent KG" or "KG Rule",
        tooltip = "Any = no KG filter.",
        displayMap = RuntimeStatus.kgFilterDisplayMap,
        get = function() return Settings[modeKey] or "Any" end,
        set = function(value)
            Settings[modeKey] = (value == "Below" or value == "Above") and value or "Any"
        end,
        onChange = onChange,
    })

    local input = groupbox:AddInput(idPrefix .. "KGThreshold", {
        Text = "KG Threshold",
        Default = tostring(math.max(tonumber(Settings[thresholdKey]) or 0, 0)),
        Numeric = true,
        Finished = true,
        Placeholder = "0",
        Tooltip = "Uses the KG shown in game.",
    })
    local function refreshCommittedCaption()
        if type(RuntimeStatus.setCommittedThresholdCaption) == "function" then
            RuntimeStatus.setCommittedThresholdCaption(input, "KG Threshold",
                Settings[thresholdKey])
        end
    end
    refreshCommittedCaption()
    input:OnChanged(function(value)
        Settings[thresholdKey] = math.max(tonumber(value) or 0, 0)
        refreshCommittedCaption()
        if onChange then pcall(onChange) end
    end)

    local registry = getgenv().__CHSAE_ConfigControllers
    if type(registry) == "table" then
        registry[thresholdKey] = {
            GetValue = function() return Settings[thresholdKey] end,
            SetValue = function(_, value)
                local threshold = math.max(tonumber(value) or 0, 0)
                Settings[thresholdKey] = threshold
                pcall(function() input:SetValue(tostring(threshold)) end)
                refreshCommittedCaption()
            end,
        }
    end
    return picker, input
end

-- Compact native-income thresholds shared by Steal and both sellers. The UI
-- accepts the same suffix language players see in game while Settings keeps the
-- exact numeric value for comparisons and config persistence.
do
    local multipliers = {
        [""] = 1,
        k = 1e3,
        m = 1e6,
        b = 1e9,
        t = 1e12,
    }
    local displaySuffixes = {
        { 1e12, "T" }, { 1e9, "B" }, { 1e6, "M" }, { 1e3, "K" },
    }

    local function finiteNonnegative(value)
        return type(value) == "number" and value == value
            and value >= 0 and value < math.huge
    end

    function RuntimeStatus.parseCompactValue(raw)
        if type(raw) == "number" then
            return finiteNonnegative(raw) and raw or nil
        end
        local text = tostring(raw or ""):lower():gsub("%s+", "")
        if text == "" then return 0 end
        if text:sub(1, 1) == "$" then text = text:sub(2) end
        if text == "" then return nil end

        local amountText, suffix = text:match("^([%d,]*%.?%d+)(%a*)$")
        local multiplier = multipliers[suffix]
        if not amountText or not multiplier then return nil end

        -- Commas are optional, but malformed groups are rejected instead of
        -- silently changing an irreversible seller threshold.
        local integer = amountText:match("^([^%.]*)") or ""
        if integer == "" then integer = "0" end
        if integer:find(",", 1, true) then
            local lead, groups = integer:match("^(%d%d?%d?)(,.*)$")
            if not lead or not groups or (groups:gsub(",%d%d%d", "")) ~= "" then
                return nil
            end
        elseif not integer:match("^%d+$") then
            return nil
        end

        local amount = tonumber((amountText:gsub(",", "")))
        local value = amount and amount * multiplier or nil
        return finiteNonnegative(value) and value or nil
    end

    function RuntimeStatus.formatCompactValue(raw)
        local value = tonumber(raw) or 0
        if not finiteNonnegative(value) or value == 0 then return "0" end
        local divisor, suffix = 1, ""
        for _, row in ipairs(displaySuffixes) do
            if value >= row[1] then
                divisor, suffix = row[1], row[2]
                break
            end
        end
        local text = ("%.6f"):format(value / divisor)
        text = text:gsub("(%..-)0+$", "%1"):gsub("%.$", "")
        return text .. suffix
    end

    -- Short display used only in the caption above a threshold textbox. The
    -- textbox and Settings retain their canonical numeric value; this compact
    -- copy prevents long KG/value numbers from running outside narrow columns.
    function RuntimeStatus.formatThresholdConfirmation(raw)
        local value = tonumber(raw) or 0
        if not finiteNonnegative(value) or value == 0 then return "0" end
        local divisor, suffix, suffixIndex = 1, "", nil
        for index, row in ipairs(displaySuffixes) do
            if value >= row[1] then
                divisor, suffix, suffixIndex = row[1], row[2], index
                break
            end
        end
        local function render(currentDivisor, currentSuffix)
            local scaled = value / currentDivisor
            local decimals = scaled >= 100 and 0 or (scaled >= 10 and 1
                or (scaled >= 1 and 2 or (currentDivisor == 1 and 6 or 2)))
            local text = (("%%.%df"):format(decimals)):format(scaled)
            text = text:gsub("(%..-)0+$", "%1"):gsub("%.$", "")
            return text, currentSuffix
        end
        local text, renderedSuffix = render(divisor, suffix)
        if tonumber(text) and tonumber(text) >= 1000 and suffixIndex and suffixIndex > 1 then
            local nextRow = displaySuffixes[suffixIndex - 1]
            text, renderedSuffix = render(nextRow[1], nextRow[2])
        end
        return text .. renderedSuffix
    end

    function RuntimeStatus.setCommittedThresholdCaption(input, title, raw)
        if type(input) ~= "table" or type(input.SetText) ~= "function" then return false end
        local display = RuntimeStatus.formatThresholdConfirmation(raw)
        local caption = ('%s: <font color="#49E685"><b>%s</b></font>')
            :format(tostring(title), display)
        return pcall(function() input:SetText(caption) end)
    end

    function RuntimeStatus.valueFilterActive(threshold)
        return (tonumber(threshold) or 0) > 0
    end

    function RuntimeStatus.markValueFilterChanged()
        -- Irreversible sellers wait for the textbox and config callback to settle.
        -- This also closes the mobile tap-away race where visible text used to be
        -- newer than the numeric Settings value.
        RuntimeStatus.valueFilterReadyAt = os.clock() + 0.75
    end

    function RuntimeStatus.sellerValueFilterReady(settingKey)
        if RuntimeStatus.valueFilterLoadInProgress == true then return false end
        if os.clock() < (tonumber(RuntimeStatus.valueFilterReadyAt) or 0) then return false end
        local ok, focused = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("UserInputService"):GetFocusedTextBox()
        end)
        if not (ok and focused == nil) then return false end

        -- Finished text inputs can update their visible Value before Obsidian's
        -- callback commits the parsed number. An irreversible seller must prove
        -- that the text the user sees and the number it will compare are equal.
        local state = settingKey and RuntimeStatus.valueFilterInputs
            and RuntimeStatus.valueFilterInputs[settingKey] or nil
        if state and type(state.ReadText) == "function" then
            local readOk, visible = pcall(state.ReadText)
            local parsed = readOk and RuntimeStatus.parseCompactValue(visible) or nil
            if parsed == nil or parsed ~= tonumber(Settings[settingKey]) then return false end
        end
        return true
    end

    function RuntimeStatus.addValueFilterInput(groupbox, inputId, settingKey, labelText, onChange, tooltipText)
        local normalizing = false
        -- The formatted textbox is the user's safety contract. Canonicalize the
        -- stored number to that exact round trip so readiness can use strict
        -- equality even for unusually precise imported thresholds.
        local initialText = RuntimeStatus.formatCompactValue(Settings[settingKey])
        local initialValue = RuntimeStatus.parseCompactValue(initialText)
        if initialValue ~= nil then Settings[settingKey] = initialValue end
        local input = groupbox:AddInput(inputId, {
            Text = labelText,
            Default = initialText,
            Numeric = false,
            -- Keep full-string editing for decimals; a supplemental FocusLost
            -- connection below commits ordinary PC/mobile tap-away as well.
            Finished = true,
            Placeholder = "750M / 1.25B / 2T",
            Tooltip = tooltipText or "Uses $/s. K, M, B, T work; 0 disables.",
        })

        local function refreshCommittedCaption()
            RuntimeStatus.setCommittedThresholdCaption(input, labelText, Settings[settingKey])
        end
        refreshCommittedCaption()

        local function setInputText(value)
            local text = RuntimeStatus.formatCompactValue(value)
            normalizing = true
            pcall(function() input:SetValue(text) end)
            normalizing = false
        end

        local function commitRaw(raw, source)
            if normalizing then return false end
            RuntimeStatus.markValueFilterChanged()
            local value = RuntimeStatus.parseCompactValue(raw)
            if value == nil then
                setInputText(Settings[settingKey])
                pcall(function()
                    Library:Notify("Use a value like 750M, 1.25B, or 2T.", 4)
                end)
                if onChange then pcall(onChange, "invalid") end
                return false
            end
            local display = RuntimeStatus.formatCompactValue(value)
            local canonical = RuntimeStatus.parseCompactValue(display)
            if canonical == nil then return false end
            local changed = tonumber(Settings[settingKey]) ~= canonical
            Settings[settingKey] = canonical
            setInputText(canonical)
            refreshCommittedCaption()
            if changed and onChange then pcall(onChange, source or "user") end
            return true
        end

        input:OnChanged(function(raw)
            commitRaw(raw, "user")
        end)

        -- Pinned Obsidian only commits Finished inputs when FocusLost's Enter
        -- argument is true. Its input object exposes Holder, so attach the
        -- missing ordinary-blur commit without depending on private upvalues.
        local textBox = input.Holder and input.Holder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextBox", true)
        if textBox then
            local blurConnection = textBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                if normalizing then return end
                -- Do not compare against input.Value here: Finished inputs may
                -- already mirror the typed text even though OnChanged never ran.
                commitRaw(textBox.Text, "blur")
            end)
            if type(input.Connections) == "table" then
                table.insert(input.Connections, blurConnection)
            else
                RuntimeStatus.valueFilterInputConnections =
                    RuntimeStatus.valueFilterInputConnections or {}
                table.insert(RuntimeStatus.valueFilterInputConnections, blurConnection)
            end
        end

        RuntimeStatus.valueFilterInputs = RuntimeStatus.valueFilterInputs or {}
        RuntimeStatus.valueFilterInputs[settingKey] = {
            ReadText = function()
                return textBox and textBox.Text or input.Value
            end,
            Commit = function()
                return commitRaw(textBox and textBox.Text or input.Value, "blur")
            end,
        }

        local registry = getgenv().__CHSAE_ConfigControllers
        if type(registry) == "table" then
            registry[settingKey] = {
                GetValue = function() return Settings[settingKey] end,
                SetValue = function(_, raw)
                    RuntimeStatus.markValueFilterChanged()
                    local value = RuntimeStatus.parseCompactValue(raw)
                    if value == nil then
                        local current = tonumber(Settings[settingKey])
                        value = finiteNonnegative(current) and current or 0
                    end
                    local display = RuntimeStatus.formatCompactValue(value)
                    local canonical = RuntimeStatus.parseCompactValue(display)
                    Settings[settingKey] = canonical ~= nil and canonical or 0
                    setInputText(Settings[settingKey])
                    refreshCommittedCaption()
                    if onChange then pcall(onChange, "config") end
                end,
            }
        end
        return input
    end
end

-- One clock per steal transaction. It updates only while a transaction is live,
-- then sleeps on the shared status event, so idle clients pay no timer polling cost.
do
    function RuntimeStatus.beginStealTimer(uid)
        local timer = RuntimeStatus.stealTimer
        timer.active = true
        timer.startedAt = os.clock()
        timer.uid = uid
        RuntimeStatus.set("stealTime", "⏱️ Time: 0.00s")
    end

    function RuntimeStatus.finishStealTimer(outTime, backTime)
        local timer = RuntimeStatus.stealTimer
        local total = math.max(0, (tonumber(outTime) or 0) + (tonumber(backTime) or 0))
        timer.active = false
        timer.last = total
        timer.outTime = tonumber(outTime) or 0
        timer.backTime = tonumber(backTime) or 0
        timer.completed = (tonumber(timer.completed) or 0) + 1
        timer.total = (tonumber(timer.total) or 0) + total
        timer.average = timer.total / timer.completed
        RuntimeStatus.set("stealTime", ("⏱️ Time: %.2fs · %.2f out / %.2f back")
            :format(total, timer.outTime, timer.backTime))
        -- Home may be rebuilding/unloading while a delivery signal finishes.
        -- Presentation must never be able to terminate the steal worker after
        -- the server has already accepted and claimed the egg.
        pcall(SessionMetrics.Set, SessionMetrics, "stealTime", ("%.2fs"):format(total))
        pcall(SessionMetrics.Set, SessionMetrics, "avgStealTime", ("%.2fs"):format(timer.average))
    end

    function RuntimeStatus.pauseStealTimer()
        local timer = RuntimeStatus.stealTimer
        if not timer.active then return false end
        timer.active = false
        -- Preserve timer.last and the Home metric as the most recent verified
        -- steal. The game-screen timer is driven only by timer.active, so armed,
        -- cooldown, resync, event, place, and treadmill activity show no timer.
        RuntimeStatus.wakeOverlay("steal-timer-paused")
        return true
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while sessionAlive() do
            local timer = RuntimeStatus.stealTimer
            if timer.active then
                local elapsed = math.max(0, os.clock() - (tonumber(timer.startedAt) or os.clock()))
                RuntimeStatus.set("stealTime", ("⏱️ Time: %.2fs"):format(elapsed))
                pcall(SessionMetrics.Set, SessionMetrics, "stealTime", ("%.2fs"):format(elapsed))
                task.wait(RuntimeStatus.presentationInterval())
            else
                RuntimeStatus.statusWake.Event:Wait()
            end
        end
    end)
end

local ServerBox = HomeTab:AddLeftGroupbox("🌐 Server")

-- A successful same-server rejoin deliberately removes ClientReplicator and can
-- also populate GuiService's error text during the handoff. Mark it before the
-- TeleportService call so the disconnect webhook only reports unexpected losses.
getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns = getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns or {}
function RuntimeStatus.failSameServerRejoin(detail, attempt)
    if not RuntimeStatus.sameServerRejoinPending then return end
    if attempt ~= nil and RuntimeStatus.sameServerRejoinAttempt ~= attempt then return end
    RuntimeStatus.sameServerRejoinPending = false
    RuntimeStatus.sameServerRejoinAttempt = nil
    RuntimeStatus.intentionalDisconnectUntil = 0
    RuntimeStatus.intentionalDisconnectReason = nil
    detail = tostring(detail or "Teleport failed")
    Library:Notify("⚠️ Same-server rejoin failed: " .. detail, 5)
end
function RuntimeStatus.requestSameServerRejoin(reason)
    if RuntimeStatus.sameServerRejoinPending or RuntimeStatus.serverHopPending then
        local detail = "another teleport is already pending"
        Library:Notify("⚠️ " .. detail, 4)
        return false
    end
    local placeId, jobId = game.PlaceId, game.JobId
    if type(jobId) ~= "string" or jobId == "" then
        Library:Notify("⚠️ Same-server rejoin failed: job id unavailable", 5)
        return false
    end
    RuntimeStatus.sameServerRejoinPending = true
    local attempt = {}
    RuntimeStatus.sameServerRejoinAttempt = attempt
    RuntimeStatus.intentionalDisconnectUntil = os.clock() + 45
    RuntimeStatus.intentionalDisconnectReason = tostring(reason or "Same-server rejoin")
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, jobId, LocalPlayer)
        end)
        if not ok then
            RuntimeStatus.failSameServerRejoin(err, attempt)
        end
    end)
    task.delay(45, function()
        if sessionAlive() and RuntimeStatus.sameServerRejoinAttempt == attempt then
            RuntimeStatus.failSameServerRejoin("teleport timed out", attempt)
        end
    end)
    return true
end
pcall(function()
    getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns[#getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns + 1]
        = TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player, _, message)
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then return end
            if os.clock() < (tonumber(RuntimeStatus.intentionalDisconnectUntil) or 0) then
                RuntimeStatus.failSameServerRejoin(message)
            end
        end)
end)

MakeButtonPanel(ServerBox, "BtnServerPanel", {
    { "🔄 Rejoin Server", function()
        -- Never fall back to Teleport(placeId): that joins a random job.
        RuntimeStatus.requestSameServerRejoin("Same-server rejoin")
    end },
    { "💬 Copy Discord", function()
        local env = getgenv()
        local clipboardApi = rawget(env, "Clipboard")
        local copy = rawget(env, "setclipboard") or rawget(env, "toclipboard")
            or (type(clipboardApi) == "table" and clipboardApi.set)
        if type(copy) ~= "function" then
            Library:Notify("Discord: discord.gg/CloverOnTop", 5)
            return
        end
        local success = pcall(copy, "discord.gg/CloverOnTop")
        Library:Notify(success and "✅ Discord copied." or "❌ Copy failed.", 3)
    end },
})
