    RuntimeStatus.inventoryFullGraceUntil = 0
    if Settings.SellEggsWhenFull then
        -- Keep Auto-Steal armed while the seller creates space, but relinquish
        -- character ownership so the sell worker can run immediately.
        if type(pendingCarry) == "table" and pendingCarry.inFlight ~= true then
            getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest = nil
        end
        carrying = false
        ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = false
        Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = false, false
        Arb.release("Steal")
        RuntimeStatus.pauseStealTimer()
        RuntimeStatus.carry = "📦 Carry: none"
        RuntimeStatus.set("target", "🎯 Target: none")
        setStealStatus(("🟠 Eggs full %d/%d · selling matches"):format(
            tonumber(count) or 0, tonumber(capacity) or 0))
        return false
    end
    local wasEnabled = autoStealTgl and autoStealTgl.Value == true
    -- Stop the worker state immediately, then drive the actual Obsidian control
    -- through SetValue so its knob/color and OnChanged callback agree. Repeat on
    -- the deferred UI turn because this function can run inside Save's own data
    -- changed callback while Obsidian is already processing another update.
    Settings.AutoSteal = false
    local function syncVisibleToggleOff()
        if not (sessionAlive() and autoStealTgl) then return end
        pcall(autoStealTgl.SetValue, autoStealTgl, false)
        Settings.AutoSteal = false
    end
    syncVisibleToggleOff()
    task.defer(syncVisibleToggleOff)
    RuntimeStatus.inventoryFullStopped = true
    ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = false
    clearPersistentTarget()
    -- A claim can fill the final slot and disable Auto-Steal before the worker's
    -- success branch gets another scheduler turn. Retire only a completed request;
    -- a genuinely yielding Invoke must remain protected by the single-flight lock.
    if type(pendingCarry) == "table" and pendingCarry.inFlight ~= true then
        getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest = nil
    end
    Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = false, false
    Arb.release("Steal")
    RuntimeStatus.carry = "📦 Carry: none"
    RuntimeStatus.pauseStealTimer()
    RuntimeStatus.set("target", "🎯 Target: none")
    setStealStatus("🟠 Inventory full · Auto-Steal off")

    if not eggInventoryFullAlerted then
        eggInventoryFullAlerted = true
        local details = {
            count = tonumber(count) or 0,
            capacity = tonumber(capacity) or 0,
            reason = tostring(reason or "Egg inventory is full"),
        }
        if type(RuntimeStatus.sendWebhook) == "function" then
            task.spawn(RuntimeStatus.sendWebhook, "inventory-full", "Egg Inventory Full",
                ("Auto-Steal was turned off. Egg inventory: **%d / %d**.")
                    :format(details.count, details.capacity), 0xF59E0B, false)
        else
            RuntimeStatus.pendingInventoryFullAlert = details
        end
        Library:Notify(("🥚 Inventory full (%d/%d) · Auto-Steal turned off.")
            :format(details.count, details.capacity), 6)
    end
    return wasEnabled
end

-- Save replication is the primary wake-up. The per-cycle check below remains a
-- cheap fail-safe for executors where ConnectForDataChanged is unavailable.
pcall(function()
    local conn = EggInventorySave.ConnectForDataChanged("EggInventory", function()
        local full, count, capacity = RuntimeStatus.eggInventoryCapacityState()
        if not full then
            eggInventoryFullAlerted = false
            RuntimeStatus.inventoryFullStopped = false
            RuntimeStatus.inventoryFullGraceUntil = 0
            if autoStealTgl and not autoStealTgl.Value then setStealStatus("🔴 Off") end
            if wakeEggScanner then wakeEggScanner("inventory-space") end
        elseif autoStealTgl and autoStealTgl.Value then
            task.defer(RuntimeStatus.stopAutoStealForFullInventory, count, capacity,
                "Your egg inventory is full!")
        end
    end)
    if typeof(conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
        local runtimeConns = getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns
        if type(runtimeConns) == "table" then runtimeConns[#runtimeConns + 1] = conn end
    end
end)
end

function RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockNeedsCrane()
    return Settings.AutoUnlockGreatBloom == true
        and RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockStealWanted == true
end

function RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockHasCraneReservation()
    if Settings.AutoUnlockGreatBloom ~= true
        or RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlock.locked == false then return false end
    local claimedAt = tonumber(RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockClaimedAt) or 0
    local claimGrace = tonumber(RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockClaimGrace) or 8
    local claimSync = claimedAt > 0 and os.clock() - claimedAt <= claimGrace
    local state = RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlock
    return claimSync or state.reservedEggUid ~= nil or state.reservedPetUid ~= nil
        or RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockReturnPending == true
end

function RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockReturnHasPriority()
    return Settings.AutoUnlockGreatBloom == true
        and RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockReturnPending == true
        and not RuntimeStatus.normalStealPending()
end

function RuntimeStatus.carryRequestInFlight()
    local request = getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
    return type(request) == "table" and request.inFlight == true
end

-- A successful Invoke is not ownership proof. If its bounded replication grace
-- expires with the same egg still available, retain the transaction for a local
-- retry instead of treating the next pass as a fresh TrackStart departure.
RuntimeStatus.retainUnverifiedPickup = function(request)
    -- An accepted request still needs authoritative ownership before returning.
    if not sessionAlive() or type(request) ~= "table" then return false end
    local backend = request.movementBackend or Settings.StealMovementBackend
    if backend ~= "Glide" or request.owner ~= "Steal"
        or request.purpose == "tp-bait" or request.done ~= true
        or request.inFlight ~= false or request.accepted ~= true
        or request.carrySeen or request.carryEndedSeen or request.droppedSeen
        or request.claimSeen or request.cancelledByDeath
        or request.supersededByDrop or request.supersededByRecovery
        or request.character ~= LocalPlayer.Character
        or request.generation ~= stealRuntime.respawnGeneration
        or getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest ~= request
        or tostring(stealRuntime.lockedUid) ~= tostring(request.uid)
        or resetWallClosed() or not Arb.hold("Steal") then return false end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now < (tonumber(request.proofDeadline) or math.huge) then return false end
    if stillCarrying(request.uid)
        or claimConfirmed(request.uid, request.category, request.claimSequenceAtStart) then
        return false
    end
    local root, humanoid = getCharParts()
    local live = findAreaEgg(request.uid)
    local state = live and tostring(live.State)
    local carrierId = live and tonumber(live.CarrierUserId)
    if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0
        or (lineSide(root.Position) or -1) <= 0
        or not live or not live.BottomCFrame or (state ~= "Slot" and state ~= "Dropped")
        or (carrierId ~= nil and carrierId > 0 and carrierId ~= LocalPlayer.UserId) then
        return false
    end
    stealRuntime.requestFailureUid = request.uid
    stealRuntime.requestFailureAt = now
    stealRuntime.lastRequestKind = "position-sync"
    stealRuntime.lastRequestError = "carry accepted but ownership not replicated"
    ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = true
    Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = true, true
    Arb.stealBeat = now
    RuntimeStatus.pickupProofRetries = (RuntimeStatus.pickupProofRetries or 0) + 1
    return true
end

function RuntimeStatus.stealFeatureEnabled()
    return sessionAlive() and EggCmds
        and ((autoStealTgl and autoStealTgl.Value == true)
            or RuntimeStatus.riftCollecting == true
            or RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockNeedsCrane())
end

local function carryLossRecoveryPending()
    local uid = stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid or stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid
    local kind = tostring(stealRuntime.lastRequestKind or "")
    return uid ~= nil and tostring(stealRuntime.lockedUid) == tostring(uid)
        and (kind == "carry-loss-sync" or kind == "death-drop-sync" or kind == "carry-drop")
end
RuntimeStatus.carryLossRecoveryPending = carryLossRecoveryPending

-- Stop on the carry-loss edge before a stale field row can complete the return.
-- Near TrackStart this may be normal delivery: the caller checks exact claim
-- confirmation, and the worker waits for claim/drop evidence in place.
RuntimeStatus.carryLostInField = function(uid)
    if uid == nil or stillCarrying(uid) then return false end
    if RuntimeStatus.carryLossAwaitingProof(uid) then return true end
    local root = getCharParts()
    local side = root and lineSide(root.Position)
    return type(side) == "number" and side > 60
end

-- An egg already in hand, or a guard drop still being reclaimed, outranks a
-- momentary stealFeatureEnabled() dip. riftCollecting falls to false the
-- instant its field target leaves the field — which is the exact moment we picked
-- that egg up — so the plain check cancelled the run to the safe zone about a
-- tenth of a second after every Rift grab, stranding the egg mid-field.
-- The window is bounded, so a genuine Auto-Steal off still ends the worker once
-- the egg it was holding has been delivered.
RuntimeStatus.stealWorkerAlive = function()
    if RuntimeStatus.stealFeatureEnabled() then
        stealRuntime.featureGraceAt = 0
        return true
    end
    if not (carrying or carryLossRecoveryPending()) then
        stealRuntime.featureGraceAt = 0
        return false
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    if (tonumber(stealRuntime.featureGraceAt) or 0) <= 0 then
        stealRuntime.featureGraceAt = now
    end
    return now - stealRuntime.featureGraceAt <= stealRuntime.featureGrace
end

local function stealOn()
    if Settings.Stall then return false end
    if not RuntimeStatus.stealWorkerAlive() then return false end
    local recoveringCarryLoss = carryLossRecoveryPending()
    local committedSteal = Arb.owner == "Steal" and stealRuntime.lockedUid ~= nil
    -- Finish a real grab/carry, but stop an ordinary outbound target so the
    -- hatched Crane can take the shared Event body lane without starvation.
    if RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockReturnHasPriority()
        and not recoveringCarryLoss
        and not carrying and not Arb.critical
        and not RuntimeStatus.carryRequestInFlight() then return false end
    if RuntimeStatus.adminEventHasPriority() and not recoveringCarryLoss
        and not committedSteal
        and (Arb.owner == "AdminEvent"
            or (not carrying and not Arb.critical
                and not RuntimeStatus.carryRequestInFlight())) then return false end
    local root, humanoid = getCharParts()
    if not (root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0) then return false end
    local ownsBody = Arb.hold("Steal")
    Arb.stealBeat = os.clock()   -- …and prove the steal loop is still alive
    return ownsBody
end

-- A movement cancellation is not a failed steal while the exact UID is still
-- owned by this player. Revalidate through the carry signal + authoritative
-- field record, clear any stale arbiter yield, and keep the transaction locked
-- for an immediate safe-zone retry. Only State=Dropped may enter re-pick logic.
RuntimeStatus.preserveCarriedReturn = function(uid, reason)
    if uid == nil or not RuntimeStatus.stealFeatureEnabled() then return false end
    local root, humanoid = getCharParts()
    if not (root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0) then return false end

    local graceDeadline = os.clock()
        + math.clamp(getNetworkPingSeconds() * 2 + 0.05, 0.12, 0.35)
    local held = false
    repeat
        if droppedAreaEgg(uid) then return false end
        if stillCarrying(uid) then
            held = true
            break
        end
        if os.clock() >= graceDeadline then break end
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    until not sessionAlive()
    if not held or not sessionAlive()
        or not RuntimeStatus.stealFeatureEnabled() then return false end

    local live = findAreaEgg(uid)
    carrying = true
    stealRuntime.carriedUid = uid
    stealRuntime.lockedUid = uid
    stealRuntime.rememberPositiveCarry(uid)
    if live and live.AreaId ~= nil then
        RuntimeStatus.activeGuardAreaId = tostring(live.AreaId)
    end
    local request = getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
    if type(request) == "table" and tostring(request.uid) == tostring(uid) then
        request.carrySeen = true
        request.carryActive = true
        request.carryEndedSeen = false
        request.droppedSeen = false
    end

    ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = true
    Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = true, true
    Arb.stealBeat = os.clock()
    -- A protected carry outranks every unrelated body task. This also repairs an
    -- AdminEvent owner that slipped in during a missed-replication frame.
    if Arb.owner and Arb.owner ~= "Steal" then Arb.release(Arb.owner) end
    if not Arb.acquire("Steal") then return false end

    RuntimeStatus.returnResumeCount = (RuntimeStatus.returnResumeCount or 0) + 1
    RuntimeStatus.lastReturnResumeAt = os.clock()
    RuntimeStatus.lastReturnResumeReason = tostring(reason or "cancelled")
    RuntimeStatus.lastReturnResumeUid = uid
    RuntimeStatus.carry = "📦 Carry: verified · resuming home"
    return true
end

-- A bat/guard drop is still the same steal transaction. Keep the exact UID and
-- body ownership, then let the normal pickup path route from the current position
-- to the egg's new Dropped BottomCFrame. Persistent Steal is not required here.
local function armDroppedEggReacquire(uid, reason, authoritativeRecord)
    uid = uid or (os.clock() - (tonumber(stealRuntime.dropDetectedAt) or 0) <= 3
        and (stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid or stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid) or nil)
    local authoritativeDrop = type(authoritativeRecord) == "table"
        and tostring(authoritativeRecord.State) == "Dropped"
        and authoritativeRecord.BottomCFrame ~= nil
        and (authoritativeRecord.Uid == nil
            or tostring(authoritativeRecord.Uid) == tostring(uid))
    if uid == nil or (not authoritativeDrop and not droppedAreaEgg(uid)) then return false end

    if authoritativeDrop then
        stealRuntime.dropRecoveryRecord = authoritativeRecord
        stealRuntime.dropRecoveryRecordUid = uid
        stealRuntime.dropRecoveryRecordAt = os.clock()
    end

    local newlyConfirmed = tostring(stealRuntime.lastRequestKind) ~= "carry-drop"
        or tostring(stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid) ~= tostring(uid)
    stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid = uid
    if (tonumber(stealRuntime.dropDetectedAt) or 0) <= 0 then
        stealRuntime.dropDetectedAt = os.clock()
    end
    if newlyConfirmed then
        stealRuntime.dropCount = (tonumber(stealRuntime.dropCount) or 0) + 1
    end
    -- Once this exact request produced a carried egg and the authoritative field
    -- record says Dropped, it is a completed old transaction even if InvokeServer
    -- is still yielding locally. Retire only that request so a fresh pickup is not
    -- blocked beside the egg; its late result is isolated below.
    local liveRequest = getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
    if type(liveRequest) == "table"
        and tostring(liveRequest.uid) == tostring(uid)
        and liveRequest.carrySeen == true then
        if liveRequest.inFlight then liveRequest.supersededByDrop = true end
        if getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest == liveRequest then
            getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest = nil
        end
    end
    stealRuntime.lockedUid = uid
    stealRuntime.requestFailureUid = uid
    stealRuntime.requestFailureAt = stealRuntime.dropDetectedAt
    stealRuntime.lastRequestKind = "carry-drop"
    stealRuntime.lastRequestError = tostring(reason or "egg dropped during return")
    RuntimeStatus.pendingDroppedUid = uid
    RuntimeStatus.dropReacquireArmedAt = os.clock()
    if Settings.PersistentSteal then stealRuntime.persistentUid = uid end

    carrying = false
    RuntimeStatus.carry = "📦 Carry: dropped · reclaiming"
    ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = true
    Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = true, true
    Arb.stealBeat = os.clock()
    if Arb.owner ~= "Steal" then Arb.acquireWait("Steal", 0.25) end
    if wakeEggScanner then wakeEggScanner("reacquire-dropped-egg") end
    return true
end
RuntimeStatus.armDroppedEggReacquire = armDroppedEggReacquire

RuntimeStatus.activeDroppedRecoveryRecord = function(uid)
    local kind = tostring(stealRuntime.lastRequestKind or "")
    local exactLock = uid ~= nil
        and tostring(stealRuntime.lockedUid) == tostring(uid)
        and (tostring(stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid) == tostring(uid)
            or tostring(stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid) == tostring(uid))
    if not exactLock or (kind ~= "carry-drop" and kind ~= "death-drop-sync"
        and kind ~= "carry-loss-sync") then return nil end
    local dropped = RuntimeStatus.getDroppedRecoveryRecord(uid)
    if dropped then return dropped end
    -- A fatal catch can restore the exact egg to Slot before the replacement
    -- character spawns. That is still this proven carry transaction, not a fresh
    -- target that should be staged through TrackStart again.
    local rec = findAreaEgg(uid)
    if (kind == "carry-drop" or kind == "death-drop-sync")
        and rec and tostring(rec.State) == "Slot" and rec.BottomCFrame then return rec end
    return nil
end

RuntimeStatus.reconcileCarryLossSnapshot = function(snapshot)
    local uid = stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid or stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid
    if uid == nil then return end
    local records = type(snapshot) == "table" and (snapshot.Records or snapshot) or nil
    if type(records) ~= "table" then return end
    for _, rec in pairs(records) do
        local recUid = type(rec) == "table" and (rec.Uid or rec.UID or rec.EggUid) or nil
        if recUid ~= nil and tostring(recUid) == tostring(uid) then
            local carrierId = tonumber(rec.CarrierUserId)
            local recState = tostring(rec.State)
            local recoveryReady = ((recState == "Slot" or recState == "Dropped")
                    and rec.BottomCFrame ~= nil)
                or carrierId == LocalPlayer.UserId
            if tostring(stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid) == tostring(uid) then
                if recoveryReady then
                    stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingAt = 0
                    stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingReason = ""
                elseif recState ~= "Claimed"
                    and not (carrierId ~= nil and carrierId > 0
                        and carrierId ~= LocalPlayer.UserId)
                    and (tonumber(stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingAt) or 0) <= 0 then
                    stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingAt = os.clock()
                    stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingReason = "snapshot-transitioning"
                end
            end
            if tostring(rec.State) == "Dropped" and rec.BottomCFrame then
                armDroppedEggReacquire(uid, "full snapshot confirmed dropped egg", rec)
            elseif tostring(stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid) == tostring(uid)
                and tostring(rec.State) == "Slot" and rec.BottomCFrame then
                stealRuntime.lockedUid = uid
                if wakeEggScanner then wakeEggScanner("death-recovery-slot") end
            end
            return
        end
    end
    if tostring(stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid) == tostring(uid) then
        if (tonumber(stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingAt) or 0) <= 0 then
            stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingAt = os.clock()
        end
        stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingReason = "snapshot-missing"
    end
end

-- [[ DELIVERY SPEED RUNTIME ]] --
function RuntimeStatus.getDeliverySpeed(mode)
    mode = mode or Settings.StealMovementType
    local key = mode == "Tween" and "TweenReturnSpeed" or "TPReturnSpeed"
    local speed = tonumber(Settings[key])
    if not speed or speed ~= speed or speed == math.huge or speed == -math.huge then
        speed = 700
    end
    return math.clamp(math.floor(speed + 0.5), 100, 1000)
end
function RuntimeStatus.setDeliverySpeed(value)
    local mode = Settings.StealMovementType == "Tween" and "Tween" or "TP"
    local speed = tonumber(value)
    if not speed or speed ~= speed or speed == math.huge or speed == -math.huge then
        speed = RuntimeStatus.getDeliverySpeed(mode)
    end
    speed = math.clamp(math.floor(speed + 0.5), 100, 1000)
    Settings[mode .. "ReturnSpeed"], Settings.StealSpeed = speed, speed
    return speed
end
-- [[ END DELIVERY SPEED RUNTIME ]] --

-- [[ STANDALONE CLAIM FLOW ]] --
do
local Claim=(function()
-- Claim completion and single-flight drain adapted from standalone Engine.
-- No movement, settling, inventory scans or yields are performed by this state machine.
local Claim = {}
Claim.__index = Claim
local function same(a,b) return a ~= nil and b ~= nil and tostring(a) == tostring(b) end
function Claim.new(adapter) return setmetatable({a=adapter},Claim) end
function Claim:begin(request, carrySeen)
    if self.current and self.current.request == request then return self.current end
    if self.current then self.last=self.current end
    local t={request=request,uid=request.uid,category=request.category,phase="PICKUP",
        carrySeen=carrySeen == true or request.carrySeen == true,startedAt=self.a.now()}
    if t.carrySeen then t.carryProofAt=self.a.now() end
    self.current=t
    return t
end
function Claim:observeCarry(state)
    local t=self.current
    if not t or t.proven or not self.a.alive(t.request) or type(state) ~= "table" then return end
    if state.IsCarrying == true and same(state.Uid,t.uid) then
        t.carrySeen=true
        t.carryProofAt=t.carryProofAt or self.a.now()
    end
end
function Claim:returning()
    local t=self.current
    if t and t.request.carrySeen then t.carryProofAt=t.carryProofAt or self.a.now() end
    if t and t.phase == "PICKUP" then t.phase="RETURN" end
end
function Claim:movementStarted(speed)
    local t=self.current
    if t and t.phase == "RETURN" then
        t.returnTweenAt=t.returnTweenAt or self.a.now()
        t.returnSpeed=speed
    end
end
function Claim:arrived()
    local t=self.current
    if t and t.phase == "RETURN" and self.a.homeDistance() <= 12 then
        t.homeAt=self.a.now()
        t.phase,t.deadline="CLAIM",self.a.now()+8
    end
end
function Claim:resumeHeldReturn()
    local t=self.current
    if not t or t.proven or (t.phase ~= "CLAIM" and t.phase ~= "FAILED")
        or t.request.deliveryRejected or not self.a.alive(t.request)
        or not self.a.held or not self.a.held(t.uid) or self.a.homeDistance() <= 12 then return false end
    -- A displaced carrier is still in delivery, not waiting at home for a claim.
    -- Retain the exact request (including an unresolved Invoke) and carry proof.
    t.phase,t.deadline="RETURN",nil
    t.returnResumes=(t.returnResumes or 0)+1
    return true
end
function Claim:observeClaim(feedback)
    local t=self.current
    if not t or not self.a.alive(t.request) then return nil end -- untracked/manual claim
    if type(feedback) ~= "table" then return false end
    if t.phase == "FAILED" then return nil end -- bookkeeping may observe it; stopped flow stays stopped
    if t.phase == "READY" and not same(feedback.Uid or feedback.EggUid or feedback.UID,t.uid) then return nil end
    if t.proven or not (t.carrySeen or t.request.carrySeen) then return false end
    if feedback.AssetCategory and t.category and feedback.AssetCategory ~= t.category then return false end
    local uid=feedback.Uid or feedback.EggUid or feedback.UID
    if uid ~= nil then
        if not same(uid,t.uid) then return false end
    elseif (t.phase ~= "RETURN" and t.phase ~= "CLAIM")
        or self.a.homeDistance() > 12 or t.request.droppedSeen then return false end
    t.proven,t.finishedAt,t.phase=true,self.a.now(),"DRAIN"
    t.deadline=t.finishedAt+8
    t.request.claimSeen,t.request.standaloneClaimVerified=true,true
    t.request.claimFinishedAt=t.finishedAt
    self.a.halt() -- standalone finish(): release tween and hold, retain the rig
    return true,t.uid
end
function Claim:verified(uid)
    local t=self.current
    return t ~= nil and t.proven == true and (uid == nil or same(uid,t.uid))
        and self.a.alive(t.request)
end
function Claim:poll()
    local t=self.current
    if not t then return "IDLE" end
    if not self.a.alive(t.request) then return "STALE" end
    self:resumeHeldReturn()
    if t.proven then
        if not t.request.inFlight then t.phase="READY"
        elseif self.a.now() >= t.deadline and t.phase ~= "BLOCKED" then
            t.phase="BLOCKED"
            self.a.releaseRig("pickup reply still pending after claim")
        end
    elseif (t.phase == "CLAIM" and self.a.now() >= t.deadline)
        or ((t.phase == "RETURN" or t.phase == "CLAIM") and t.request.deliveryRejected) then
        t.phase="FAILED"
        t.failedAt=self.a.now()
        self.a.halt()
        self.a.releaseRig(t.request.deliveryRejected and "server rejected delivery" or "home reached without claim feedback")
    end
    return t.phase
end
return Claim

end)()
-- Main adapter for standalone claim completion. Existing inventory/notifications
-- consume the validated signal; they do not own movement completion.
local claims=Claim.new({
    now=os.clock,
    alive=function(request)
        local root,humanoid=getCharParts()
        return sessionAlive() and request.character == LocalPlayer.Character
            and request.generation == stealRuntime.respawnGeneration
            and root ~= nil and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
    end,
    homeDistance=function()
        local root,humanoid=getCharParts()
        local track=RuntimeStatus.getTrackStart()
        if not root or not humanoid or not track then return math.huge end
        return (root.Position-(track.Position+Vector3.new(0,humanoid.HipHeight,0))).Magnitude
    end,
    held=function(uid)
        local rec=findAreaEgg(uid)
        return rec ~= nil and rec.State == "Carried" and tonumber(rec.CarrierUserId) == LocalPlayer.UserId
    end,
    halt=function()
        local movement=RuntimeStatus.DevChickenTween
        local l=movement and movement.lease
        if l and Arb.owner == l.owner and LocalPlayer.Character == l.character then
            movement.stopTween(l,false)
            l.temporary:Move(Vector3.zero,false)
            local v=l.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            l.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(0,v.Y,0)
            l.lastUse=os.clock()
        end
    end,
    releaseRig=function(reason)
        local movement=RuntimeStatus.DevChickenTween
        if movement and movement.lease and movement.lease.owner == "Steal" then movement.restore(reason) end
    end,
})
RuntimeStatus.StealClaim=claims
RuntimeStatus.beginStealClaim=function(request,carrySeen)
    return claims:begin(request,carrySeen)
end
RuntimeStatus.waitStealClaim=function(uid,keepGoing)
    local t=claims.current
    if not t or tostring(t.uid) ~= tostring(uid) then return false end
    claims:arrived()
    while sessionAlive() and keepGoing() do
        if claims:verified(uid) then return true end
        local phase=claims:poll()
        if phase == "FAILED" or phase == "STALE" or phase ~= "CLAIM" then return false end
        if t.request.droppedSeen or droppedAreaEgg(uid)
            or tostring(stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid) == tostring(uid) then t.phase="PICKUP"; return false end
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    end
    return false
end
RuntimeStatus.serviceStealClaimDrain=function()
    local t=claims.current
    if not t then return false end
    local phase=claims:poll()
    if phase == "STALE" then claims.current=nil; return false end
    if phase == "FAILED" then
        local rec=findAreaEgg(t.uid)
        if not t.request.inFlight
            and rec and (rec.State == "Slot" or rec.State == "Dropped") then
            -- A failed delivery may retry in either normal or persistent mode.
            -- Keep unresolved invokes locked and never treat a held egg as free.
            if getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest == t.request then getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest=nil end
            claims.last=t
            claims.current=nil
            setStealStatus("🔁 Delivery failed · retrying steal")
            return false
        end
        -- Claimed, removed after confirmed carry release, or transferred eggs
        -- no longer belong to this failed delivery. Let selection reconcile them.
        local ended=rec and (rec.State == "Claimed" or (rec.State == "Carried"
            and (tonumber(rec.CarrierUserId) or 0) > 0 and tonumber(rec.CarrierUserId) ~= LocalPlayer.UserId))
            or (not rec and t.request.carryEndedSeen == true)
        if not t.request.inFlight and ended then
            if getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest == t.request then getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest=nil end
            claims.last=t
            claims.current=nil
            setStealStatus("🔁 Delivery ended · selecting next egg")
            return false
        end
        setStealStatus(t.request.inFlight and "⏳ Delivery failed · waiting for pickup reply"
            or "⏳ Delivery unverified · waiting for egg state")
        return true
    end
    if not t.proven then return false end
    if phase == "READY" then
        if getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest == t.request then getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest=nil end
        return false
    end
    -- Keep the exact request lock until its real reply; no body hold, teleport,
    -- duplicate pickup or repeated inventory scan while draining.
    RuntimeStatus.carry=phase == "BLOCKED" and "📦 Claimed · pickup reply stalled" or "📦 Claimed · finishing pickup reply"
    return true
end

end
-- [[ END STANDALONE CLAIM FLOW ]] --

-- [[ DEVELOPMENT CHICKEN TWEEN ]] --
do
local Recovery=(function()
-- Observe server recovery actions. This is recovery evidence, not pickup approval.
local Recovery = {}
Recovery.__index = Recovery
function Recovery.new(character)
    return setmetatable({character=character,generation=0,endedGeneration=0,running=false},Recovery)
end
function Recovery:observe(character,packet)
    if character ~= self.character or type(packet) ~= "table" then return false end
    local args=packet.Arguments
    if args == nil then args={} elseif type(args) ~= "table" then return false end
    if packet.Action == "BeginRagdoll" then
        local duration=args[1]
        if (#args ~= 1 and #args ~= 4) or type(duration) ~= "number"
            or duration ~= duration or duration < 0 or duration == math.huge then return false end
        self.generation+=1
        self.expiresAt=os.clock()+duration
        self.running=true
        return true
    elseif packet.Action == "EndRagdoll" and #args == 0 and self.running then
        self.running=false
        self.endedGeneration=self.generation
        return true
    end
    return false
end
function Recovery.ready(t,ragdollUntil,serverNow)
    local r=t.recovery
    if not r or r.character ~= t.character or t.recoveryGeneration == nil then return false,"recovery observer unavailable" end
    if t.targetLandedAt == nil or not t.reactionSeen or not t.request or not t.request.carryEndedSeen then
        return false,"waiting for bait release and target landing"
    end
    if r.running or r.endedGeneration <= t.recoveryGeneration then return false,"waiting for server EndRagdoll" end
    if (tonumber(ragdollUntil) or 0) > serverNow then return false,"waiting for replicated recovery deadline" end
    return true
end
return Recovery

end)()
local Pose = (function()
local Pose = {}

function Pose.heading(x, z, previousX, previousZ)
    local length = math.sqrt(x * x + z * z)
    if length < 0.001 then return previousX or 0, previousZ or -1 end
    return x / length, z / length
end

return Pose

end)()
local Tween = (function()
-- Main automation movement: TweenService owns root CFrame during each leg.
local Tween = {}
Tween.__index = Tween

function Tween.new(root, humanoid, bridge, service)
    return setmetatable({ root = root, humanoid = humanoid, bridge = bridge,
        service = service }, Tween)
end

function Tween:stop()
    self.ragdollHold = nil
    self.interpolation = nil
    self.registrationPending, self.registrationWaitAt, self.correctionObserved = nil, nil, nil
    self.correctionWaitAt, self.correctionLastAt = nil, nil
    self.pauseSpent, self.pauseCredit, self.frameWaitSpent = 0, 0, 0
    self.goal, self.holdCFrame, self.completedAt, self.lastStep = nil, nil, nil, nil
    if self.tween then self.tween:Cancel(); self.tween:Destroy(); self.tween = nil end
end

function Tween:correctionGate(now, resume)
    if self.correctionActive and self.correctionActive() then
        if self.tween then self.tween:Pause() end
        if not self.correctionWaitAt then self.correctionCount = (self.correctionCount or 0) + 1 end
        self.correctionWaitAt = self.correctionWaitAt or now
        local elapsed = math.max(0, now - (self.correctionLastAt or now))
        self.correctionSeconds = (self.correctionSeconds or 0) + elapsed
        self.correctionLastAt = now
        local credit = math.min(elapsed, math.max(0, 3 - (self.pauseSpent or 0)))
        self.pauseSpent = (self.pauseSpent or 0) + credit
        self.pauseCredit = (self.pauseCredit or 0) + credit
        if self.deadline then self.deadline += credit end
        self.registrationPending = true
        if now - self.correctionWaitAt >= 3 then
            return true, "movement registration wait expired: correcting"
        end
        return true
    end
    if self.correctionWaitAt then
        if not resume then return true end
        self.correctionWaitAt, self.correctionLastAt = nil, nil
        self.registrationPending, self.registrationWaitAt = false, nil
        self.observed, self.observedAt = self.root.Position, now
        self.lastStep = now
        if self.interpolation then
            self.interpolation = self.root.Position
        elseif self.tween then
            local deadline, spent, credit = self.deadline, self.pauseSpent, self.pauseCredit
            self:setGoal(self.goal, self.speed)
            self.deadline, self.pauseSpent, self.pauseCredit = deadline, spent, credit
        elseif self.goal and (self.goal - self.root.Position).Magnitude > .35 then
            local delta = self.root.Position - self.goal
            if self.ragdollHold and Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z).Magnitude <= .6 and math.abs(delta.Y) <= 3 then
                self.goal = self.root.Position
                self.holdCFrame = self:uprightAt(self.goal)
                return false
            end
            return true, "character relocated"
        end
    end
    return false
end

function Tween:setGoal(goal, speed)
    self:stop()
    self.endpointRecovery = false
    self:faceGoal(goal)
    self:startLeg(goal, speed)
end

function Tween:faceGoal(goal)
    if self.correctionActive and self.correctionActive() then return end
    local origin = self.root.Position
    local delta, look = goal - origin, self.root.CFrame.LookVector
    local fallbackX, fallbackZ = Pose.heading(look.X, look.Z, self.headingX, self.headingZ)
    self.headingX, self.headingZ = Pose.heading(delta.X, delta.Z, fallbackX, fallbackZ)
    self.root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(origin,
        origin + Vector3.new(self.headingX, 0, self.headingZ), Vector3.yAxis)
end

function Tween:startLeg(goal, speed)
    if self.tween then self.tween:Cancel(); self.tween:Destroy(); self.tween = nil end
    self.goal, self.speed, self.completedAt, self.holdCFrame = goal, speed, nil, nil
    self.target = self:uprightAt(goal)
    local duration = (goal - self.root.Position).Magnitude / speed
    self.deadline = os.clock() + duration + 4
    if (goal - self.root.Position).Magnitude <= 0.35 then self.holdCFrame = self.target; return end
    self.tween = self.service:Create(self.root, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = self.target })
    if not (self.correctionActive and self.correctionActive()) then self.tween:Play() end
end

function Tween:uprightAt(position)
    local look = self.root.CFrame.LookVector
    self.headingX, self.headingZ = Pose.heading(look.X, look.Z, self.headingX, self.headingZ)
    return CFrame.lookAt(position, position + Vector3.new(self.headingX, 0, self.headingZ), Vector3.yAxis)
end

function Tween:standUp()
    if self.correctionActive and self.correctionActive() then return false end
    local heldGoal = self.holdCFrame and self.goal
    self:stop()
    self.root.CFrame = self:uprightAt(self.root.Position)
    self.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    self.humanoid.PlatformStand = false
    self.humanoid.AutoRotate = true
    local state = self.humanoid:GetState()
    if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll then
        self.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end
    if heldGoal then
        self.goal, self.holdCFrame = heldGoal, self:uprightAt(heldGoal)
    end
end

function Tween:step(now)
    if not self.goal then return true end
    local blocked, issue = self:correctionGate(now, true)
    if blocked then return issue == nil, issue end
    local frameSeconds = self.lastStep and math.max(0, now - self.lastStep) or 1 / 60
    self.lastStep = now
    if self.interpolation then
        local remaining = (self.goal - self.root.Position).Magnitude
        if self.bridge and remaining > .35 then
            local registered, _, reason = self.bridge(self.root, (self.goal - self.root.Position).Unit, self.speed, remaining, nil, nil, math.min(remaining, self.speed))
            if not registered then
                if reason ~= "renewing" and reason ~= "correcting" then
                    return false, "movement registration failed: " .. tostring(reason or "unavailable")
                end
                self.registrationPending = true
                self.registrationWaitAt = self.registrationWaitAt or now
                if reason == "correcting" then self.correctionObserved = true end
                local credit = math.min(frameSeconds, math.max(0, 3 - (self.pauseSpent or 0)))
                self.pauseSpent = (self.pauseSpent or 0) + credit
                self.pauseCredit = (self.pauseCredit or 0) + credit
                self.deadline = self.deadline + credit
                if now - self.registrationWaitAt >= 1.5 or self.pauseSpent >= 3 then
                    return false, "movement registration wait expired: " .. reason
                end
                return true
            end
            if self.correctionObserved then self.interpolation = self.root.Position end
            self.correctionObserved = nil
            self.registrationPending, self.registrationWaitAt = false, nil
        end
        if (self.root.Position - self.interpolation).Magnitude > 80 then return false, "character relocated" end
        local frameCredit = math.min(math.max(0, frameSeconds - .1), math.max(0, 8 - (self.frameWaitSpent or 0)))
        self.frameWaitSpent = (self.frameWaitSpent or 0) + frameCredit
        self.pauseCredit = (self.pauseCredit or 0) + frameCredit
        self.deadline += frameCredit
        if remaining > .35 and now >= self.deadline then return false, "movement timeout" end
        local alpha = remaining > .35 and math.min(self.speed * math.min(frameSeconds, .1) / remaining, 1) or 1
        self.root.CFrame = self.root.CFrame:Lerp(self.target, alpha)
        self.interpolation = self.root.Position
        if alpha >= 1 then self.interpolation, self.holdCFrame = nil, self.target end
    end
    if self.tween then
        local playback = self.tween.PlaybackState
        if playback == Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled then return false, "engine tween cancelled" end
        local remaining = (self.goal - self.root.Position).Magnitude
        if remaining <= 0.35 then
            self.tween:Cancel(); self.tween:Destroy(); self.tween = nil
            self.holdCFrame = self.target
        elseif playback == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
            self.completedAt = self.completedAt or now
            -- As in the main mover, observe delayed final displacement before
            -- allowing one nearby endpoint correction; never chase indefinitely.
            local settle = math.clamp(frameSeconds * 4 + (self.pingSeconds or 0) * 1.5 + 0.08, 0.16, 0.9)
            if now - self.completedAt >= settle then
                if not self.endpointRecovery and remaining <= 20 then
                    self.endpointRecovery = true
                    self:startLeg(self.goal, math.clamp(math.min(self.speed, 500), 100, 500))
                else
                    return false, self.endpointRecovery and "tween final approach failed" or "tween ended away from goal"
                end
            end
        elseif now >= self.deadline then return false, "movement timeout" end
    end
    -- Never compete with the active TweenService writer. Hold only at rest.
    if not self.tween and self.holdCFrame then
        local drift = self.root.Position - self.holdCFrame.Position
        local elapsed = math.clamp(frameSeconds, 0, 0.25)
        local verticalAllowance = math.max(3, workspace.Gravity * elapsed * elapsed + 2)
        if not self.ragdollHold and (math.sqrt(drift.X * drift.X + drift.Z * drift.Z) > 6 or math.abs(drift.Y) > verticalAllowance) then
            return false, "character relocated during hold"
        end
        self.root.CFrame = self.holdCFrame
    end
    self.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, self.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
    self.humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
    return true
end

function Tween:relocate(goal)
    self:stop()
    if self.correctionActive and self.correctionActive() then return false end
    self:faceGoal(goal)
    self.root.CFrame = self:uprightAt(goal)
    self.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, self.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
    -- Leave movement idle so the chicken's recovery can run naturally.
    return true
end

function Tween:holdAt(goal, ragdollHold)
    if not self:relocate(goal) then return false end
    self.ragdollHold = ragdollHold == true
    self.goal, self.holdCFrame = goal, self:uprightAt(goal)
    return true
end

function Tween:interpolateTo(goal, speed)
    assert(type(speed) == "number" and speed > 0 and speed < math.huge, "invalid interpolation speed")
    self:stop()
    self:faceGoal(goal)
    self.goal, self.speed, self.target = goal, speed, self:uprightAt(goal)
    self.lastStep, self.interpolation = os.clock(), self.root.Position
    self.deadline = self.lastStep + (goal - self.root.Position).Magnitude / speed + 4
end

function Tween:returnHome(home, speed)
    self:interpolateTo(home, speed)
end

function Tween:destroy()
    self:stop()
end

return Tween

end)()
local Rig = (function()
-- One replacement per run; retain the original for Stop/reload cleanup.
local Rig = {}
Rig.__index = Rig

function Rig.new(player, character, original, camera)
    return setmetatable({ player = player, character = character, original = original,
        camera = camera, subject = camera and camera.CameraSubject }, Rig)
end

function Rig:rebindAnimations(outgoing)
    local animate = self.character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if self.player.Character ~= self.character or not animate or not animate:IsA("LocalScript")
        or not animate.Enabled then return end
    animate.Enabled = false
    local animator = outgoing and outgoing:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if animator then
        for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do track:Stop(0) end
    end
    animate.Enabled = true
end

function Rig:attach(nativeBody)
    assert(self.player.Character == self.character and self.original.Parent == self.character,
        "character changed before Humanoid replacement")
    if nativeBody then
        self.nativeBody = true
        self.autoRotate, self.breakJointsOnDeath = self.original.AutoRotate, self.original.BreakJointsOnDeath
        self.attached = true
        return self.original
    end
    local archivable = self.original.Archivable
    self.original.Archivable = true
    local ok, replacement = pcall(function() return self.original:Clone() end)
    self.original.Archivable = archivable
    if not ok then error(replacement) end
    assert(replacement, "Humanoid clone unavailable")
    self.replacement = replacement -- publish before mutation so cleanup can roll back
    replacement.Name = self.original.Name
    self.original.Parent = nil
    replacement.Parent = self.character
    self:rebindAnimations(self.original)
    if self.camera and self.camera.CameraSubject == self.original then
        self.camera.CameraSubject = replacement
    end
    self.attached = true
    return replacement
end

function Rig:restore()
    if self.restored then return end
    if self.nativeBody then
        if self.player.Character == self.character and self.original.Parent == self.character then
            if self.original.AutoRotate == false then self.original.AutoRotate = self.autoRotate end
            if self.original.BreakJointsOnDeath == false then self.original.BreakJointsOnDeath = self.breakJointsOnDeath end
        end
        self.restored = true
        return
    end
    local replacement = self.replacement
    local current = self.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local sameCharacter = self.player.Character == self.character
    -- Never overwrite a new character or another script's replacement.
    if sameCharacter and (current == replacement or current == nil or current == self.original) then
        if replacement and replacement.Parent == self.character then replacement.Parent = nil end
        if self.original.Parent == nil then self.original.Parent = self.character end
        if current ~= self.original then self:rebindAnimations(replacement) end
    end
    if self.camera and replacement and self.camera.CameraSubject == replacement then
        if sameCharacter and self.original.Parent == self.character then
            self.camera.CameraSubject = self.subject
        elseif self.player.Character then
            local nextHumanoid = self.player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if nextHumanoid then self.camera.CameraSubject = nextHumanoid end
        end
    end
    if replacement then replacement:Destroy() end
    -- Old characters no longer need the detached original. Do not leak it.
    if not sameCharacter and self.original.Parent == nil then self.original:Destroy() end
    self.restored = true
end

return Rig

end)()
local ReferenceTween = (function()
-- One frame writer for forest approach, target travel, return and endpoint hold.
-- The native character/controller stays attached for the entire transaction.
local ReferenceTween = {}
ReferenceTween.__index = ReferenceTween
setmetatable(ReferenceTween, { __index = Tween })

function ReferenceTween.new(root, humanoid, bridge, service)
    humanoid.AutoRotate = false
    return setmetatable(Tween.new(root, humanoid, bridge, service), ReferenceTween)
end

function ReferenceTween:setGoal(goal, speed)
    assert(type(speed) == "number" and speed > 0 and speed < math.huge, "invalid movement speed")
    self:stop()
    self.goal, self.speed = goal, speed
    self.target = self:uprightAt(goal)
    self.lastStep, self.observed = os.clock(), self.root.Position
    self.deadline = self.lastStep + (goal - self.observed).Magnitude / speed + 8
end

function ReferenceTween:interpolateTo(goal, speed) self:setGoal(goal, speed) end
function ReferenceTween:returnHome(goal, speed) self:setGoal(goal, speed) end

function ReferenceTween:waitForMovement(now, dt, reason)
    self.registrationPending = true
    self.registrationWaitAt = self.registrationWaitAt or now
    self.observed = self.root.Position
    self.lastStep = now
    local credit = math.min(dt, math.max(0, 8 - (self.pauseSpent or 0)))
    self.pauseSpent = (self.pauseSpent or 0) + credit
    self.pauseCredit = (self.pauseCredit or 0) + credit
    self.deadline += credit
    if reason == "correcting" then
        if not self.correctionObserved then self.correctionCount = (self.correctionCount or 0) + 1 end
        self.correctionObserved = true
        self.correctionSeconds = (self.correctionSeconds or 0) + dt
    end
    if now - self.registrationWaitAt >= 8 then
        return false, "movement registration wait expired: " .. reason
    end
    return true
end

function ReferenceTween:step(now)
    if not self.goal then return true end
    local dt = math.max(0, now - self.lastStep)
    self.lastStep = now
    -- No orientation, velocity or position writes while native correction owns us.
    if self.correctionActive and self.correctionActive() then
        return self:waitForMovement(now, dt, "correcting")
    end
    if self.correctionObserved then
        self.correctionObserved = nil
        self.observed = self.root.Position
        self.target = self:uprightAt(self.goal)
    end
    local drift = self.root.Position - self.observed
    local resting = self.holdCFrame ~= nil
    local horizontal = Vector3.new(drift.X, 0, drift.Z).Magnitude
    local verticalLimit = math.max(3, workspace.Gravity * math.min(dt, .25)^2 + 2)
    if horizontal > (resting and 6 or 80) or (resting and math.abs(drift.Y) > verticalLimit)
        or (not resting and drift.Magnitude > 80) then
        return false, resting and "character relocated during hold" or "character relocated"
    end
    local delta = self.goal - self.root.Position
    local distance = delta.Magnitude
    -- Long frames never become a large catch-up teleport. Use the same configured
    -- speed on normal frames, and give bounded time credit for skipped travel.
    local step = math.min(distance, self.speed * math.min(dt, .1), 60)
    if distance > .01 and self.bridge then
        local covered, _, reason = self.bridge(self.root, delta.Unit, self.speed, distance,
            nil, nil, math.min(distance, math.max(step, self.speed * .2)))
        if not covered then
            if reason ~= "renewing" and reason ~= "correcting" then
                return false, "movement registration failed: " .. tostring(reason or "unavailable")
            end
            return self:waitForMovement(now, dt, reason)
        end
    end
    self.registrationPending, self.registrationWaitAt = false, nil
    local lost = math.max(0, dt - math.min(dt, .1, 60 / self.speed))
    local credit = math.min(lost, math.max(0, 8 - (self.frameWaitSpent or 0)))
    self.frameWaitSpent = (self.frameWaitSpent or 0) + credit
    self.pauseCredit = (self.pauseCredit or 0) + credit
    self.deadline += credit
    if distance > .35 and now >= self.deadline then return false, "movement timeout" end
    if distance > .01 then
        self.root.CFrame = self.root.CFrame:Lerp(self.target, math.min(1, step / distance))
    end
    self.observed = self.root.Position
    self.holdCFrame = (self.goal - self.observed).Magnitude <= .35 and self.target or nil
    self.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, self.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
    self.humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
    return true
end

function ReferenceTween:relocate(goal, speed)
    self:stop()
    if self.correctionActive and self.correctionActive() then return false, "correcting" end
    local delta = goal - self.root.Position
    local distance = delta.Magnitude
    speed = speed or 500
    -- TP is permitted only inside one conservative registered frame. A local
    -- impulse receipt is not permission for an arbitrary distant relocation.
    if distance > math.min(6, speed / 60) then return false, "target requires tween" end
    if distance > .01 then
        if not self.bridge then return false, "movement registration unavailable" end
        local covered, _, reason = self.bridge(self.root, delta.Unit, speed, distance, nil, nil, distance)
        if not covered then return false, reason end
        self.root.CFrame = self:uprightAt(goal)
    end
    self.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, self.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
    self.observed = self.root.Position
    return true
end

-- Only the outbound adapter may call this after a fresh, confirmed chicken hit.
-- Use the live relocation baseline once; ordinary tween/hold never resets it.
function ReferenceTween:teleportTo(goal, speed, b)
    self:stop()
    local state = b and b.state
    if not state or not b.token or type(b.sample) ~= "function" or type(b.adopt) ~= "function"
        or not self.root.Parent or state.Character ~= self.root.Parent
        or self.humanoid.Parent ~= self.root.Parent
        or state.RootPart ~= self.root or state.Humanoid ~= self.humanoid then
        return false, "native teleport baseline unavailable"
    end
    if state.CorrectionContext or (self.correctionActive and self.correctionActive()) then
        return false, "correcting"
    end
    local ok, issue = pcall(function()
        self.root.CFrame = self:uprightAt(goal)
        self.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, self.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
        local sample = b.sample(state, os.clock(), self.humanoid.WalkSpeed)
        assert(type(sample) == "table" and typeof(sample.Position) == "Vector3"
            and (sample.Position - self.root.Position).Magnitude <= .01, "native teleport sample unavailable")
        b.adopt(b.token, state, sample)
        assert(state.LastSample == sample and not state.ValidationLocked, "native teleport baseline rejected")
    end)
    self.observed = self.root.Position
    if not ok then return false, tostring(issue) end
    self:setGoal(goal, speed)
    self.holdCFrame = self.target
    return true
end

function ReferenceTween:holdAt(goal, _ragdollHold, speed)
    local moved, reason = self:relocate(goal, speed)
    if not moved then return false, reason end
    self:setGoal(goal, speed or 500)
    return true
end

function ReferenceTween:standUp()
    -- Recovery is owned by the game's Ragdoll lifecycle; pickup waits for it.
    return not (self.correctionActive and self.correctionActive())
end

return ReferenceTween

end)()
-- Transaction-scoped movement ownership; one writer for the steal flow.
local dev = { enabled = true, lease = nil,
    phase = "idle", reason = "ready", launches = 0, engine = "r28 chicken TP / registered tween" }
RuntimeStatus.DevChickenTween = dev
function dev.persistentAlive()
    local p = dev.persistent
    return p ~= nil and sessionAlive() and LocalPlayer.Character == p.character
        and p.root.Parent == p.character and p.original.Parent == nil
        and p.temporary.Parent == p.character and p.original.Health > 0 and p.temporary.Health > 0
end
function dev.restorePersistent(reason)
    local p = dev.persistent
    if not p then return true end
    local ok, issue = pcall(function()
        p.rig:restore()
        dev.syncHandoff(p)
    end)
    if not ok then dev.reason = "persistent restore failed: " .. tostring(issue); return false end
    dev.persistent = nil
    dev.reason = reason or "persistent rig restored"
    return true
end
function dev.alive(l)
    return dev.lease == l and not l.cancelled and sessionAlive()
        and LocalPlayer.Character == l.character and l.root.Parent == l.character
        and l.original.Health > 0 and l.temporary.Health > 0
        and ((l.nativeBody and l.temporary == l.original and l.original.Parent == l.character)
            or (not l.nativeBody and l.original.Parent == nil and l.temporary.Parent == l.character))
        and not l.root.Anchored and not l.temporary.Sit and os.clock() - l.lastUse < 45
        and (Arb.owner == l.owner or (l.owner == "Steal" and dev.enabled and Arb.owner == nil))
        and ((l.progression and l.keepGoing()) or (not l.progression
            and (Settings.Stall or RuntimeStatus.stealFeatureEnabled()
                or (l.rift and Settings.AutoRift and RuntimeStatus.stealWorkerAlive()))))
end
function dev.stopTween(l, hold)
    if hold then l.mover:holdAt(l.root.Position) else l.mover:stop() end
    l.tween, l.holdCFrame = l.mover.tween, l.mover.holdCFrame
end
function dev.syncHandoff(l)
    if l.nativeBody then return true end
    if l.handoffSynced then return true end
    local b = l.handoffBridge
    local state = b and b.state
    if not state or LocalPlayer.Character ~= l.character or l.original.Parent ~= l.character
        or state.Character ~= l.character or state.RootPart ~= l.root or state.Humanoid ~= l.original then return true end
    local sample = b.sample(state, os.clock(), l.original.WalkSpeed)
    assert(type(sample) == "table" and typeof(sample.Position) == "Vector3"
        and (sample.Position - l.root.Position).Magnitude <= 0.01, "native handoff sample unavailable")
    b.adopt(b.token, state, sample)
    l.handoffSynced = true
    return true
end
function dev.restore(reason)
    if dev.transactionRetry then
        local ok, retried, retryReason = pcall(dev.transactionRetry, reason)
        if ok and retried then return true end
        if ok and type(retryReason)=="string" then reason=retryReason end
        if not ok then reason="movement retry failed: "..tostring(retried) end
    end
    dev.transactionRetry=nil
    dev.transactionStep=nil
    if dev.transactionCamera then dev.transactionCamera:restore();dev.transactionCamera=nil end
    local l = dev.lease
    dev.reason, dev.phase = reason or "restored", dev.enabled and "idle" or "off"
    if not l then return true end
    l.cancelled, l.stopReason = true, reason or "restored"
    if l.connection then l.connection:Disconnect(); l.connection = nil end
    if l.postConnection then l.postConnection:Disconnect(); l.postConnection = nil end
    if l.referenceHeartbeat then l.referenceHeartbeat:Disconnect(); l.referenceHeartbeat = nil end
    local ok, issue = pcall(function()
        if l.mover then l.mover:destroy() end
        if l.temporary and l.temporary.Parent == l.character and l.autoRotate ~= nil then
            l.temporary.AutoRotate = l.autoRotate
        end
        if not (dev.persistent and dev.persistent.rig == l.rig
            and dev.persistentAlive()) then
            l.rig:restore()
            if LocalPlayer.Character == l.character and l.original.Parent == l.character then
                dev.syncHandoff(l)
            end
            if dev.persistent and dev.persistent.rig == l.rig then dev.persistent = nil end
        end
    end)
    -- A native handoff error must not leave PlayerModule disabled.
    if l.restoreControls and l.controls then
        local controlsRestored = pcall(function() l.controls:Enable() end)
        if controlsRestored then l.restoreControls = false end
    end
    if not ok then dev.reason = "restore failed: " .. tostring(issue); return false end
    dev.lease = nil
    return true
end
function dev.begin(delivery, owner, keepGoing)
    owner = owner or "Steal"
    local progression = owner == "Place" or owner == "Mutate" or owner == "Treadmill" or owner == "Scramble"
    if owner ~= "Steal" and not progression then return false, "invalid movement owner" end
    if progression and (type(keepGoing) ~= "function" or not keepGoing()) then return false, "cancelled" end
    if not dev.enabled and delivery ~= true then return false, "Tween disabled" end
    if dev.lease and dev.lease.owner ~= owner then return false, "another movement owns the rig" end
    if dev.lease and dev.alive(dev.lease) then
        dev.lease.lastUse = os.clock()
        return true
    end
    if not dev.restore("starting") then return false, dev.reason end
    local persistent = false
    if dev.persistent and (not persistent or not dev.persistentAlive()) then
        if not dev.restorePersistent("movement setup") then return false, dev.reason end
    end
    local saved = persistent and dev.persistent or nil
    local root, original = getCharParts()
    if saved then original = saved.original end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not root or not original or original.Health <= 0 or root.Anchored or original.Sit
        or Arb.owner ~= owner then return false, "character activity unavailable" end
    if integrityState and integrityState.RootPart == root and integrityState.Humanoid ~= original then
        return false, "another movement controller owns the Humanoid"
    end
    local nativeBody = true
    local bridge = saved and saved.handoffBridge or integrityBridge
    if not nativeBody and (not bridge or not bridge.state or bridge.state.RootPart ~= root or bridge.state.Humanoid ~= original) then
        bridge = RuntimeStatus.findMovementDispatcher(root, original)
    end
    if not nativeBody and (not bridge or type(bridge.sample) ~= "function" or type(bridge.adopt) ~= "function" or not bridge.token) then
        return false, "native movement handoff unavailable"
    end
    local l = { character = character, root = root, original = original, owner = owner,
        progression = progression, keepGoing = keepGoing, handoffBridge = bridge, nativeBody = nativeBody,
        movementType = Settings.StealMovementType, delivery = delivery == true,
        rift = type(stealRuntime.webhookTarget) == "table" and stealRuntime.webhookTarget.source == "rift",
        lastUse = os.clock(), speed = 500 }
    l.recovery = Recovery.new(character)
    l.rig = saved and saved.rig or Rig.new(LocalPlayer, character, original, workspace.CurrentCamera)
    dev.lease = l
    local ok, issue = pcall(function()
        l.referenceMovement = owner == "Steal" or (owner == "Scramble"
            and RuntimeStatus.Scramble and RuntimeStatus.Scramble.preparingPart ~= nil)
        l.controls = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule):GetControls()
        l.restoreControls = l.controls.controlsEnabled == true
        l.controls:Disable()
        l.temporary = saved and saved.temporary or l.rig:attach(l.nativeBody)
        l.autoRotate = l.temporary.AutoRotate
        if persistent then
            l.temporary.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
            if not saved then
                dev.persistent = l
                RuntimeStatus.watchStealHumanoid(character)
            end
        end
        l.registration = {checks=0,renewed=0,reused=0,renewing=0,correcting=0,failed=0,workMs=0,maxWorkMs=0}
        local function checkedTravel(...)
            local started=os.clock()
            local registered,reused,reason=registerIntegrityTravel(...)
            local r=l.registration
            local elapsed=(os.clock()-started)*1000
            r.checks+=1;r.workMs+=elapsed;r.maxWorkMs=math.max(r.maxWorkMs,elapsed)
            r.lastReason=reason or (registered and (reused and "reused" or "renewed") or "unavailable")
            r.lastAt=os.clock()
            if registered then
                if reused then r.reused+=1 else r.renewed+=1 end
            elseif reason=="renewing" then r.renewing+=1
            elseif reason=="correcting" then r.correcting+=1
            else r.failed+=1 end
            return registered,reused,reason
        end
        l.mover = (l.referenceMovement and ReferenceTween or Tween).new(root, l.temporary,
            l.nativeBody and (owner=="Steal" and checkedTravel or registerIntegrityTravel) or nil, TweenService)
        l.mover.correctionActive = function()
            return l.nativeBody and integrityState and rawget(integrityState, "CorrectionContext") ~= nil
        end
        l.mover.pingSeconds = math.clamp(getNetworkPingSeconds(), 0, 1)
        l.connection = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
            if not dev.alive(l) then dev.restore("movement released"); return end
            -- A released Steal lease may be reused next cycle, but cannot write
            -- the character while the arbiter is between owners.
            if Arb.owner ~= l.owner then return end
            local stepped, moved, reason = pcall(function()
                if dev.transactionStep then dev.transactionStep(os.clock()) end
                return l.mover:step(os.clock())
            end)
            if not stepped or not moved then
                dev.restore(not stepped and tostring(moved) or reason); return
            end
            l.tween, l.holdCFrame = l.mover.tween, l.mover.holdCFrame
        end)
    end)
    if not ok then dev.restore("setup failed: " .. tostring(issue)); return false, tostring(issue) end
    dev.phase, dev.reason = "staging", l.nativeBody and "real body active" or "r17 replacement active"
    return true
end
function dev.eggGoal(position)
    local l = dev.lease
    return position + Vector3.new(0, l.temporary.HipHeight + l.root.Size.Y / 2, 0)
end
function dev.move(position, reach, keepGoing, onReached, abortFn, speed, interpolate)
    local l = dev.lease
    if not l or not dev.alive(l) or Arb.owner ~= l.owner then return false, "Tween rig unavailable" end
    local ticket = {}
    l.ticket, l.goal, l.speed = ticket, position, speed or RuntimeStatus.getDeliverySpeed(l.movementType)
    local completedBySignal=false
    local ok, reached, reason = pcall(function()
        if not keepGoing() or (abortFn and abortFn()) then return false, "cancelled" end
        if onReached and onReached() then completedBySignal=true; return true end
        if interpolate and (l.owner == "Steal" or l.owner == "Scramble") then l.mover:returnHome(position, l.speed)
        else l.mover:setGoal(position, l.speed) end
        local claims = RuntimeStatus.StealClaim
        if l.owner == "Steal" and claims and claims.movementStarted then claims:movementStarted(l.speed) end
        local deadline = os.clock() + (position - l.root.Position).Magnitude / l.speed + 8
        while dev.alive(l) and l.ticket == ticket do
            l.lastUse = os.clock()
            if Arb.owner ~= l.owner or not keepGoing() or (abortFn and abortFn()) then return false, "cancelled" end
            if onReached and onReached() then completedBySignal=true; return true end
            if (l.root.Position - position).Magnitude <= (reach or 0.35) then return true end
            if os.clock() >= deadline then return false, "movement timeout" end
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        return false, l.stopReason or "Tween interrupted"
    end)
    if dev.lease == l and l.ticket == ticket and not l.cancelled then
        dev.stopTween(l, ok and reached == true and not completedBySignal)
    end
    if not ok then dev.restore("Tween error"); return false, tostring(reached) end
    return reached, reason
end
function dev.groundMove(position, reach, keepGoing, onReached, abortFn, speed, interpolate)
    local l = dev.lease
    if not l then return false, "Tween rig unavailable" end
    local y = groundY(position.X, position.Z, position.Y) or position.Y
    return dev.move(Vector3.new(position.X, y, position.Z), reach, keepGoing, onReached, abortFn, speed, interpolate)
end
function dev.returnHome(keepGoing, abortFn, guardAreaId)
    local l, track = dev.lease, RuntimeStatus.getTrackStart()
    if not l or not track then return false, "home unavailable" end
    local claims=RuntimeStatus.StealClaim
    if claims then claims:returning() end
    local function claimed() return claims and claims:verified() end
    local speed = RuntimeStatus.getDeliverySpeed(l.movementType)
    do
        if Settings.StealRoute == "Fly" then
            local y = l.root.Position.Y + 21
            local ok, reason = dev.move(Vector3.new(l.root.Position.X, y, l.root.Position.Z), 0.35, keepGoing, claimed, abortFn, speed, true)
            if not ok then return false, reason end
            ok, reason = dev.move(Vector3.new(track.Position.X, y, track.Position.Z), 0.35, keepGoing, claimed, abortFn, speed, true)
            if not ok then return false, reason end
        elseif Settings.StealRoute == "Turbo Hybrid" then
            local previousPhase = RuntimeStatus.movementPhase
            RuntimeStatus.movementPhase = "return"
            local planned, points = pcall(RuntimeStatus.guardRoutePoints, l.root.Position, track.Position, guardAreaId)
            RuntimeStatus.movementPhase = previousPhase
            if not planned then return false, "guard route unavailable" end
            for _, point in ipairs(points) do
                local ok, reason = dev.groundMove(point, 3.5, keepGoing, claimed, abortFn, speed, true)
                if not ok then return false, reason end
            end
        end
    end
    local home = track.Position + Vector3.new(0, l.temporary.HipHeight, 0)
    local ok, reason = dev.move(home, 0.35, keepGoing, claimed, abortFn, speed, true)
    if not ok then return false, reason end
    if claims and not claimed() then claims:arrived() end
    dev.phase = claimed() and "claim verified" or "claim wait"
    return true
end
RuntimeStatus.prepareMovementOwner = function(owner)
    local l = dev.lease
    if l and l.owner ~= owner and not dev.restore("handoff to " .. tostring(owner)) then return false end
    if dev.persistent and owner ~= "Steal" then
        return dev.restorePersistent("handoff to " .. tostring(owner))
    end
    return true
end
RuntimeStatus.progressionTweenTo = function(owner, position, reach, keepGoing)
    if owner ~= "Place" and owner ~= "Mutate" and owner ~= "Treadmill" then return false, "invalid progression owner" end
    if dev.lease and not dev.restore("progression handoff") then return false, dev.reason end
    local ready, reason = dev.begin(true, owner, keepGoing)
    if not ready then return false, reason end
    local ok, reached, issue = pcall(dev.groundMove, position, reach, keepGoing, nil, nil, 500)
    if not dev.restore("progression arrival") then return false, dev.reason end
    if not ok then return false, tostring(reached) end
    return reached, issue
end
getgenv().__CHSAE_TPRestore = function(reason)
    if not dev.restore(reason or "unload") then return false end
    return dev.restorePersistent(reason or "unload")
end
function dev.prime()
    if not sessionAlive() or dev.lease or dev.persistentAlive()
        or Arb.owner ~= nil or Arb.treadmillTraining then return end
    local root, humanoid = getCharParts()
    if not root or not humanoid or root.Anchored or humanoid.Sit or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    if not Arb.acquire("Steal") then return end
    local ok, ready, issue = pcall(dev.begin, true)
    dev.restore("startup Steal rig prepared")
    Arb.release("Steal")
    if not ok or not ready then dev.reason = tostring(ok and issue or ready) end
end
getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns[#getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns + 1] = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    task.delay(0.75, function()
        if sessionAlive() and LocalPlayer.Character == character then dev.prime() end
    end)
end)
getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns[#getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local l = dev.lease
    if l and (l.cancelled or not dev.alive(l)) then dev.restore("movement cancelled") end
    if not dev.lease and dev.persistent and not dev.persistentAlive() then dev.restorePersistent("character changed") end
end)

-- [[ RECOVERY EVENT ADAPTER ]] --
local recoveryJSON=game:GetService("HttpService")
local packages=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
local networking=packages and packages:FindFirstChild("Networking")
local recoveryRemote=networking and networking:FindFirstChild("RE/RigSync/Refresh")
dev.recoveryEventReady=recoveryRemote ~= nil and recoveryRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent")
if dev.recoveryEventReady then
    getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns[#getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns+1]=recoveryRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(encoded)
        local l=dev.lease
        if not sessionAlive() or not l or not l.recovery or l.cancelled
            or LocalPlayer.Character ~= l.character or type(encoded) ~= "string" or #encoded > 16384 then return end
        local ok,packet=pcall(recoveryJSON.JSONDecode,recoveryJSON,encoded)
        if ok then l.recovery:observe(LocalPlayer.Character,packet) end
    end)
end

end
-- [[ END DEVELOPMENT CHICKEN TWEEN ]] --

-- [[ EXACT STANDALONE ENGINE ]] --
do
local Engine=(function()
-- CloverHub steal rewrite: engine r1. No Roblox globals, UI, waits, or spawned loops.
-- The adapter owns movement and replicated facts. Tick never yields.
local Engine = {}
Engine.__index = Engine

local defaults = {
    speed = 500, returnSpeed = 500, reach = 2, settle = 0.35, settleSamples = 3,
    pickupTimeout = 8, proofTimeout = 3, claimTimeout = 8,
    travelSlack = 8, maxPickupAttempts = 3, maxDrops = 2,
    maxCycles = 1, scanInterval = 0.5, idleTimeout = 30,
}

function Engine.new(adapter, options)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Engine)
    self.a, self.c = adapter, {}
    for key, value in pairs(defaults) do
        local supplied = options and options[key]
        if supplied == nil then supplied = value end
        assert(type(supplied) == "number" and supplied == supplied
            and supplied > 0 and supplied < math.huge, "invalid option: " .. key)
        self.c[key] = supplied
    end
    if not options or options.returnSpeed == nil then self.c.returnSpeed = self.c.speed end
    self.phase, self.active = "IDLE", true
    self.started, self.phaseAt = adapter.now(), adapter.now()
    self.nextScan, self.cycles, self.drops, self.attempts = 0, 0, 0, 0
    self.events, self.eventIndex, self.eventCount = {}, 0, 0
    self.metrics = { ticks = 0, maxGap = 0, totalGap = 0, work = 0, maxWork = 0,
        over50ms = 0, over100ms = 0, over250ms = 0, requests = 0,
        recoveryWaits = 0, recoverySeconds = 0 }
    self:note("start")
    return self
end

function Engine:note(kind, detail)
    self.eventIndex = self.eventIndex % 128 + 1
    self.eventCount = math.min(128, self.eventCount + 1)
    self.events[self.eventIndex] = { t = self.a.now() - self.started,
        phase = self.phase, kind = kind, detail = detail }
    if self.a.diagnostic and (kind == "stop" or kind == "recovery wait"
        or kind == "movement interruption" or kind == "target synchronization wait" or kind == "pickup reply"
        or kind == "bait pickup rejected") then
        local ok, context = pcall(self.a.diagnostic)
        if ok then self.events[self.eventIndex].context = context
        else self.events[self.eventIndex].contextError = tostring(context):sub(1,180) end
    end
end

function Engine:transition(phase, timeout)
    local now = self.a.now()
    if self.phase == "RECOVER" or self.phase == "DROP_WAIT" then
        self.metrics.recoverySeconds += math.max(0, now - self.phaseAt)
    end
    self:note("leave", { seconds = now - self.phaseAt, next = phase })
    self.phase, self.phaseAt = phase, now
    if phase == "DONE" or phase == "STOPPED" then self.endedAt = now end
    self.deadline = timeout and now + timeout or nil
end

function Engine:stop(reason)
    if not self.active then return end
    -- Release movement even if presentation/export fails later.
    self.active, self.reason = false, reason or "stopped"
    self:transition("STOPPED")
    self:note("stop", self.reason)
    self.a.halt()
end

function Engine:move(phase, goal, speed)
    speed = speed or self.c.speed
    self.goal = goal
    self:transition(phase, self.a.distance(goal) / speed + self.c.travelSlack)
    self.a.setGoal(goal, speed)
end

function Engine:beginReturn()
    if not self.carrySeen then self:stop("return without carry proof"); return end
    self.carryEndedAt = nil
    self.returnAt = self.a.now()
    self:note("carry verified", self.uid)
    self:move("RETURN", self.a.home(), self.c.returnSpeed)
end

function Engine:waitRecovery(reason)
    if self.phase == "RECOVER" or self.phase == "DROP_WAIT" then return end
    if self.phase == "CLAIM" then self.a.halt(); return end
    local leg = self.phase == "RETURN" and "RETURN"
        or ((self.phase == "OUTBOUND" or self.phase == "SETTLE") and "OUTBOUND")
    if not leg then return end
    self.a.halt()
    -- Carry-off and plot relocation can precede claim feedback in the same frame.
    -- Record a real home arrival now; it still requires the native claim verdict.
    if leg == "RETURN" and self.carryEndedAt and self.a.distance(self.a.home()) <= 12 then
        self.homeArrivalAt = self.a.now()
        self:transition("CLAIM", self.c.claimTimeout)
        return
    end
    local remaining = self.c.pickupTimeout - self.metrics.recoverySeconds
    if remaining <= 0 then self:stop("recovery synchronization budget exhausted"); return end
    self.recoveryLeg = leg
    self.metrics.recoveryWaits += 1
    self:note("recovery wait", { reason = reason, leg = leg, uid = self.uid })
    self:transition("RECOVER", remaining)
end

function Engine:movementInterrupted(reason)
    if not self.active or self.foreignCarry or self.deliveryFailure or self.claimSeen or self.a.sealed() then return false end
    local recoverable = reason == "character relocated" or reason == "character relocated during hold"
        or reason == "movement timeout" or reason == "movement registration wait expired: renewing"
        or reason == "movement registration wait expired: correcting"
    if not recoverable then return false end
    self:note("movement interruption", { reason = reason })
    if self.phase == "PREPARE" then return self.preparation:resumeMovement(reason) end
    self.a.halt()
    -- Never replay a pending invoke. Reconcile its reply/carry with the same UID.
    if self.phase == "CLAIM" or self.phase == "PICKUP" or self.phase == "PROOF"
        or self.phase == "RECOVER" or self.phase == "DROP_WAIT" then return true end
    local leg = self.phase == "RETURN" and "RETURN"
        or ((self.phase == "OUTBOUND" or self.phase == "SETTLE") and "OUTBOUND")
    if not leg then return false end
    self.interruptions = (self.interruptions or 0) + 1
    if self.interruptions > 3 then self:stop("movement recovery limit"); return true end
    self:waitRecovery(reason)
    return true
end

function Engine:observeCarry(state)
    if not self.active or not self.uid or type(state) ~= "table" then return end
    if self.preparation and self.preparation:observeCarry(state) then return end
    if state.IsCarrying == true then
        if state.Uid ~= nil and tostring(state.Uid) == tostring(self.uid) then
            self.carrySeen, self.carryActive, self.carryEndedAt = true, true, nil
        elseif state.Uid ~= nil then
            self.foreignCarry = true
        end
    elseif state.IsCarrying == false and self.carrySeen then
        if state.Uid == nil or tostring(state.Uid) == tostring(self.uid) then
            self.carryActive, self.carryEndedAt = false, self.carryEndedAt or self.a.now()
            self:waitRecovery("carry ended; awaiting field or claim")
        end
    end
end

function Engine:observeClaim(feedback)
    if self.active and self.preparation and self.preparation:observeClaim(feedback) then return end
    if not self.active or not self.uid or not self.carrySeen then return end
    if type(feedback) ~= "table" then return end
    if feedback.AssetCategory and self.category and feedback.AssetCategory ~= self.category then return end
    local uid = feedback.Uid or feedback.EggUid
    if uid ~= nil then
        if tostring(uid) ~= tostring(self.uid) then return end
    else
        -- Anonymous feedback needs an exclusive, positively carried transaction
        -- in the home phase. A globally Claimed field record is never proof.
        local arrived = self.phase == "CLAIM" and self.homeArrivalAt ~= nil
            and self.deadline ~= nil and self.a.now() < self.deadline
