        if (self.phase ~= "RETURN" and self.phase ~= "CLAIM"
            and not (self.phase == "RECOVER" and self.recoveryLeg == "RETURN"))
            or (not arrived and self.a.distance(self.a.home()) > 12)
            or self.dropObserved or self.foreignCarry then return end
    end
    self.claimSeen = true
    self:note("claim feedback", uid or "scoped by carry and home")
end

function Engine:observeDeliveryFailure(message)
    if not self.active or not self.carrySeen or not self.uid then return end
    if self.phase ~= "RETURN" and self.phase ~= "CLAIM"
        and not (self.phase == "RECOVER" and self.recoveryLeg == "RETURN") then return end
    if message == "Delivery failed! The egg was returned to its nest." then
        self.deliveryFailure = message
    end
end

function Engine:finish()
    self.a.halt()
    self.cycles += 1
    self:note("verified", { uid = self.uid, outbound = (self.returnAt or self.a.now()) - self.cycleAt,
        delivery = self.returnAt and self.a.now() - self.returnAt or 0 })
    self.retired[self.uid] = true
    self.lastUid, self.uid = self.uid, nil
    self.claimSeen = false
    if self.cycles >= self.c.maxCycles then
        self.active, self.reason = false, "verified cycle limit reached"
        self:transition("DONE")
    else
        self:transition("DRAIN", self.c.pickupTimeout)
    end
end

function Engine:requestPickup()
    if self.a.pending() then return end
    if self.attempts >= self.c.maxPickupAttempts then self:stop("pickup attempt limit"); return end
    local record = self.a.record(self.uid)
    if self.a.sealed() then self:stop("area reset"); return end
    if not self.a.available(record) then self:stop("target unavailable before pickup"); return end
    if self.a.distance(self.a.eggGoal(record)) > self.c.reach or (self.a.pickupReady and not self.a.pickupReady(self.a.now())) then return end
    self.attempts += 1
    self.metrics.requests += 1
    self:transition("PICKUP", self.c.pickupTimeout)
    self.request = self.a.request(record)
    self:note("pickup", { attempt = self.attempts, distance = self.a.distance(self.goal) })
end

function Engine:tick(now, dt)
    if not self.active then return end
    local workAt = self.a.now()
    local m = self.metrics
    m.ticks += 1
    m.maxGap, m.totalGap = math.max(m.maxGap, dt), m.totalGap + dt
    if dt > 0.05 then m.over50ms += 1 end
    if dt > 0.1 then m.over100ms += 1 end
    if dt > 0.25 then m.over250ms += 1 end
    self:step(now)
    local work = self.a.now() - workAt
    m.work, m.maxWork = m.work + work, math.max(m.maxWork, work)
end

function Engine:step(now)
    local alive, unavailable = self.a.alive()
    if not alive then self:stop(unavailable or "character unavailable"); return end
    if self.foreignCarry then self:stop("another egg was picked up"); return end
    if self.claimSeen then self:finish(); return end
    if self.deliveryFailure then self:stop("server rejected delivery: " .. self.deliveryFailure); return end
    if self.phase == "IDLE" then
        if now - self.phaseAt > self.c.idleTimeout then self:stop("no eligible target"); return end
        if now < self.nextScan or self.a.pending() or self.a.sealed() then return end
        self.nextScan = now + self.c.scanInterval
        self.retired = self.retired or {}
        local record = self.a.choose(self.retired)
        if not record then return end
        self.uid, self.category = record.Uid, record.AssetCategory
        self.cycleAt, self.attempts, self.drops = now, 0, 0
        self.carrySeen, self.carryActive, self.claimSeen = false, false, false
        self.carryEndedAt, self.dropObserved, self.request = nil, false, nil
        self.pickupRetryNotBefore, self.interruptions = nil, 0
        self.targetMissingAt = nil
        self.homeArrivalAt = nil
        self:note("selected", self.uid)
        if self.a.prepare then
            self.preparation = self.a.prepare(record)
            self:transition("PREPARE", 30)
        else
            self:move("OUTBOUND", self.a.eggGoal(record))
        end
        return
    end
    if self.phase == "PREPARE" then
        local ready, reason = self.preparation:tick(now)
        if ready == false then self:stop(reason); return end
        if ready then
            local record = self.a.record(self.uid)
            if not self.a.available(record) then self:stop("target unavailable after chicken hit"); return end
            self:move("OUTBOUND", self.a.eggGoal(record))
        end
        return
    end
    if self.phase == "DRAIN" then
        if not self.a.pending() then self:transition("IDLE")
        elseif now >= self.deadline then self:stop("pickup reply still pending after claim") end
        return
    end
    local record = self.a.record(self.uid)
    if self.a.sealed() then self:stop("area reset"); return end
    if record and record.State == "Carried" and not self.a.owned(record) then
        self:stop("target carried by another player"); return
    end
    if record and (record.State == "Dropped" or (record.State == "Slot" and self.carryEndedAt))
        and self.carrySeen and not self.dropObserved then
        self.dropObserved = true
        self.drops += 1
        self:note("drop", self.uid)
        self.a.halt()
        if self.drops > self.c.maxDrops then self:stop("drop recovery limit"); return end
        local spent = self.metrics.recoverySeconds
            + (self.phase == "RECOVER" and math.max(0, now - self.phaseAt) or 0)
        if spent >= self.c.pickupTimeout then self:stop("recovery synchronization budget exhausted"); return end
        self:transition("DROP_WAIT", self.c.pickupTimeout - spent)
    end
    if self.a.movementPaused and self.a.movementPaused()
        and (self.phase == "OUTBOUND" or self.phase == "SETTLE" or self.phase == "RETURN"
            or self.phase == "DROP_WAIT" or self.phase == "RECOVER") then
        if now >= self.deadline then self:stop("movement recovery deadline exceeded") end
        return
    end
    if self.phase == "RECOVER" then
        if now >= self.deadline then self:stop("recovery synchronization timeout"); return end
        if record and record.State == "Carried" and not self.a.owned(record) then
            self:stop("target carried by another player"); return
        end
        if self.a.pending() or (self.a.recovered and not self.a.recovered()) then return end
        if self.recoveryLeg == "RETURN" then
            if self.carrySeen and self.carryActive and not self.carryEndedAt and self.a.owned(record) then
                self:note("recovery resumed", { leg = "RETURN", uid = self.uid })
                self:beginReturn()
            end
        elseif not self.carrySeen and self.a.available(record) then
            self.settleAt, self.samples = nil, 0
            self:note("recovery resumed", { leg = "OUTBOUND", uid = self.uid })
            self:move("OUTBOUND", self.a.eggGoal(record))
        end
        return
    end
    if self.phase == "DROP_WAIT" then
        if now >= self.deadline then self:stop("drop unavailable or pickup still pending"); return end
        if not self.a.pending() and self.a.available(record)
            and (not self.a.recovered or self.a.recovered()) then
            self.carrySeen, self.carryActive, self.carryEndedAt = false, false, nil
            self.request, self.attempts = nil, 0
            self:move("OUTBOUND", self.a.eggGoal(record))
        end
        return
    end
    if self.phase == "OUTBOUND" or self.phase == "SETTLE" then
        if self.a.sealed() then self:stop("area reset"); return end
        if not self.a.available(record) then
            if not record then
                if not self.targetMissingAt then
                    self.targetMissingAt=now
                    self:note("target synchronization wait",self.uid)
                    self.a.halt()
                end
                if now-self.targetMissingAt<.75 and now<self.deadline then return end
            elseif self.dropObserved and record.State=="GuardCarried" then
                self:waitRecovery("guard still owns dropped target")
                return
            end
            self:stop("target changed during approach"); return
        end
        if self.targetMissingAt then
            self.targetMissingAt=nil
            self.settleAt,self.samples=nil,0
            self.goal=self.a.eggGoal(record)
            self.a.setGoal(self.goal,self.c.speed)
        end
        -- Follow a dropped egg if its authoritative position has moved.
        local goal = self.a.eggGoal(record)
        if self.a.goalDistance(goal, self.goal) > self.c.reach then
            self.goal = goal
            self.a.setGoal(goal, self.c.speed)
            self.settleAt, self.samples = nil, 0
        end
        if now >= self.deadline then self:stop("approach deadline exceeded"); return end
        if self.a.distance(self.goal) <= self.c.reach then
            if self.phase == "OUTBOUND" then
                self:transition("SETTLE", self.c.travelSlack)
                self.settleAt, self.samples = now, 0
            end
            self.samples = (self.samples or 0) + 1
            self.settleAt = self.settleAt or now
            if now - self.settleAt >= self.c.settle and self.samples >= self.c.settleSamples
                and now >= (self.pickupRetryNotBefore or 0)
                and (not self.a.pickupReady or self.a.pickupReady(now)) then
                self:requestPickup()
            end
        else
            self.settleAt, self.samples = nil, 0
        end
        return
    end
    if self.phase == "PICKUP" or self.phase == "PROOF" then
        if not self.carryEndedAt and self.a.owned(record) then
            self.carrySeen, self.carryActive = true, true
        end
        if self.carryActive then self.dropObserved = false; self:beginReturn(); return end
        local request = self.request
        if request and request.done and self.phase == "PICKUP" then
            self:note("pickup reply", { accepted = request.accepted, error = request.error })
            if request.accepted then
                self:transition("PROOF", self.c.proofTimeout)
            elseif self.attempts < self.c.maxPickupAttempts and self.a.available(record) then
                if request.error == "Cannot carry eggs while knocked down" then
                    self.pickupRetryNotBefore = now + math.min(2, self.attempts * .75)
                end
                self:move("OUTBOUND", self.a.eggGoal(record))
                self.settleAt, self.samples = nil, 0
            else self:stop("pickup rejected: " .. tostring(request.error)) end
            return
        end
        if now >= self.deadline then
            self:stop(self.phase == "PICKUP" and "pickup reply timeout; single-flight lock retained"
                or "pickup accepted without carry proof")
        end
        return
    end
    if self.phase == "RETURN" then
        if self.carryEndedAt or (self.a.recovered and not self.a.recovered()) then
            self:waitRecovery("carry or guard recovery pending")
            return
        end
        if self.a.distance(self.goal) <= self.c.reach then
            self.a.halt()
            self.homeArrivalAt = now
            self:transition("CLAIM", self.c.claimTimeout)
        elseif now >= self.deadline then self:stop("return deadline exceeded") end
        return
    end
    if self.phase == "CLAIM" and now >= self.deadline then
        self:stop("home reached without claim feedback")
    end
end

function Engine:report()
    local events = {}
    for i = 1, self.eventCount do
        events[i] = self.events[(self.eventIndex - self.eventCount + i - 1) % 128 + 1]
    end
    return { version = "steal-engine-r28", phase = self.phase, reason = self.reason,
        baitPhase = self.preparation and self.preparation.phase,
        baitUid = self.preparation and self.preparation.uid,
        uid = self.uid or self.lastUid, cycles = self.cycles, elapsed = (self.endedAt or self.a.now()) - self.started,
        metrics = self.metrics, events = events,
        registration = self.a.registration and self.a.registration() or nil }
end

return Engine

end)()
local Bait=(function()
-- First-area pickup -> native chicken hit. Pure non-yielding controller.
local Bait = {}
Bait.__index = Bait

function Bait.new(a, target)
    local self = setmetatable({ a = a, targetUid = target.Uid, phase = "FIND_BAIT",
        started = a.now(), deadline = a.now() + 30, nextFind = 0, attempts = 0 }, Bait)
    return self
end

function Bait:setPhase(phase, seconds)
    self.phase, self.phaseAt = phase, self.a.now()
    self.phaseDeadline = self.phaseAt + seconds
    self.a.note("bait phase", phase)
end

function Bait:observeCarry(state)
    if type(state) ~= "table" or not self.uid then return false end
    if state.IsCarrying == true then
        if tostring(state.Uid) ~= tostring(self.uid) then return false end
        if self.hitAt and self.released then return true end -- late old bait packet
        self.carrySeen, self.carryActive, self.released = true, true, false
        return true
    end
    if state.IsCarrying == false and (tostring(state.Uid) == tostring(self.uid)
        or (state.Uid == nil and self.carryActive)) then
        self.carryActive, self.released, self.releasedAt = false, true, self.a.now()
        self.a.note("bait released", self.uid)
        return true
    end
    return false
end

function Bait:observeClaim(feedback)
    if not self.carrySeen or self.released then return false end
    local uid = type(feedback) == "table" and (feedback.Uid or feedback.EggUid)
    if uid ~= nil and tostring(uid) ~= tostring(self.uid) then return false end
    self.failure = "bait was claimed before the chicken hit"
    return true
end

function Bait:observeHit(uid, source)
    if not self.released and self.a.owned(self.a.record(self.uid)) then self.carrySeen = true end
    if not self.carrySeen or tostring(uid) ~= tostring(self.uid) or self.hitAt
        or (self.phase ~= "PICKUP" and self.phase ~= "WAIT_HIT") then return false end
    -- Both the natural callback and explicit invocation delegate to the same
    -- native Forest attack handler. This is dispatch evidence, not server proof.
    self.hitAt = self.a.now()
    self.hitSource = source or "natural"
    self.a.note("chicken attack dispatched", { uid = self.uid, source = self.hitSource })
    return true
end

function Bait:refreshRelease(now)
    if self.hitAt and self.carrySeen and not self.released then
        local record = self.a.record(self.uid)
        if record and (record.State == "Dropped" or record.State == "GuardCarried" or record.State == "Slot")
            and self.a.heldUid() == nil then
            self.released, self.carryActive, self.releasedAt = true, false, now
            self.a.note("bait release verified by field record", self.uid)
        end
    end
end

function Bait:travelReady(now)
    if not self.a.requireReaction then self.phase = "HIT_CONFIRMED"; return true end
    self:refreshRelease(now)
    if self.a.reacting() or (self.a.reactionObserved and self.a.reactionObserved()) then
        self.reactionSeen = true
        self.reactionAt = self.reactionAt or now
    end
    if self.released and self.reactionSeen
        and (not self.a.departureReady or self.a.departureReady(self,now)) then
        self.phase = "HIT_CONFIRMED"
        return true
    end
    if self.phase ~= "WAIT_REACTION" then self:setPhase("WAIT_REACTION", 8) end
    if now >= self.phaseDeadline then return false, "chicken reaction/release not confirmed" end
    return nil
end

function Bait:pickupReady(now)
    self:refreshRelease(now)
    if (self.a.movementPaused and self.a.movementPaused()) or self.failure or not self.hitAt or not self.released or self.a.pending()
        or self.a.heldUid() ~= nil or not self.a.recovered()
        or not self.relocatedAt or not self.reactionAt or now - self.reactionAt < 3 then
        self.readySince = nil
        return false
    end
    self.readySince = self.readySince or now
    return now - self.readySince >= 0.15
end

function Bait:resumeMovement(reason)
    local now=self.a.now()
    if now>=self.deadline or self.failure then return false end
    if self.resumePending then return true end
    if (self.movementRetries or 0)>=2 then return false end
    if self.phase~="FIND_BAIT" and self.phase~="APPROACH" and self.phase~="SETTLE" then return false end
    if self.a.pending() or self.carrySeen then return false end
    self.movementRetries=(self.movementRetries or 0)+1
    self.a.halt()
    self.resumePending=true
    self.a.note("bait movement wait",{reason=reason,attempt=self.movementRetries})
    return true
end

function Bait:tick(now)
    if self.failure then return false, self.failure end
    if self.a.sealed() then return false, "area reset during chicken preparation" end
    if not self.a.available(self.a.record(self.targetUid)) then return false, "target changed during chicken preparation" end
    if now >= self.deadline then return false, "chicken preparation deadline exceeded" end
    if self.resumePending then
        if self.phaseDeadline and now>=self.phaseDeadline then return false,"bait movement recovery timed out" end
        if (self.a.movementPaused and self.a.movementPaused()) or not self.a.recovered() then return nil end
        if self.uid then
            local record=self.a.record(self.uid)
            if not self.a.available(record) then return false,"bait unavailable during movement recovery" end
            self.goal=self.a.eggGoal(record)
            self.a.setBaitGoal(self.goal)
        end
        self.stableAt,self.samples,self.resumePending=nil,0,nil
    end
    if self.hitAt then
        self.a.releaseBaitHold()
        self.chickenGoal = nil
        return self:travelReady(now)
    end
    if self.phase == "FIND_BAIT" then
        if now < self.nextFind then return nil end
        self.nextFind = now + 0.5
        local bait = self.a.findBait(self.targetUid)
        if not bait then return nil end
        self.uid, self.goal = bait.Uid, self.a.eggGoal(bait)
        self.a.bindHitObserver()
        self.a.setBaitGoal(self.goal)
        self:setPhase("APPROACH", self.a.distance(self.goal) / self.a.baitSpeed + 8)
        return nil
    end
    if now >= self.phaseDeadline then return false, "chicken " .. self.phase:lower() .. " timed out" end
    local record = self.a.record(self.uid)
    if self.phase == "APPROACH" or self.phase == "SETTLE" then
        if not self.a.available(record) then return false, "bait unavailable before pickup" end
        if self.a.movementPaused and self.a.movementPaused() then
            self.stableAt, self.samples = nil, 0
            return nil
        end
        local inRange = self.a.distance(self.goal) <= 0.35
        if self.attempts == 0 and self.a.baitInRange then inRange = self.a.baitInRange(record) end
        if not inRange or not self.a.recovered() then
            self.stableAt, self.samples = nil, 0
            return nil
        end
        if self.phase == "APPROACH" then self:setPhase("SETTLE", 6) end
        self.stableAt, self.samples = self.stableAt or now, (self.samples or 0) + 1
        -- First request follows real arrival; retain pacing only after a rejection.
        if self.a.pending() or (self.attempts > 0
            and (now - self.stableAt < (self.retryDelay or 0.6) or self.samples < 3)) then return nil end
        self.attempts += 1
        self:setPhase("PICKUP", 8)
        self.request = self.a.request(record)
        if self.a.approachAfterRequest then
            local ready, issue = self.a.approachAfterRequest(self, now)
            if ready == false then return false, issue end
        end
        self.a.note("bait pickup", { uid = self.uid, attempt = self.attempts })
        return nil
    end
    if self.phase == "PICKUP" or self.phase == "WAIT_HIT" then
        if not self.released and self.a.owned(record) then self.carrySeen, self.carryActive = true, true end
        if not self.carrySeen and self.a.approachAfterRequest then
            local ready, issue = self.a.approachAfterRequest(self, now)
            if ready == false then return false, issue end
        end
        if self.carrySeen then
            if self.released then
                -- Native strike/release callbacks can cross one another on a
                -- slow frame. Give the matching attack callback a short window.
                if now - (self.releasedAt or now) > 0.5 then return false, "bait lost without a matching chicken hit" end
                return nil
            end
            if self.phase ~= "WAIT_HIT" then
                self:setPhase("WAIT_HIT", 10)
                if not self.chickenGoal then self.a.releaseBaitHold() end
            end
            if self.a.invokeAttack and not self.attackRequested then
                if self.a.approachChicken then
                    local ready, issue = self.a.approachChicken(self, now)
                    if ready == false then return false, issue end
                    if not ready then return nil end
                end
                -- Set the latch before entering native code: callback re-entry
                -- and later frames must never issue this bait attack twice.
                self.attackRequested = true
                local ok, sent, issue = pcall(self.a.invokeAttack, self)
                if not ok or not sent then
                    self.failure = "chicken attack invocation failed: " .. tostring(ok and issue or sent)
                    return false, self.failure
                end
                if not self.hitAt then self:observeHit(self.uid, "invoked") end
                if self.hitAt then return self:travelReady(now) end
                self.failure = "chicken attack returned without a valid bait transaction"
                return false, self.failure
            end
            return nil
        end
        if self.request.done and not self.request.accepted then
            self.retryDelay = self.request.error == "Get closer to the egg" and 0.15 or 0.6
            if self.request.error == "Cannot carry eggs while knocked down" then
                self.retryDelay = math.min(2, self.attempts * .75)
            end
            self.a.note("bait pickup rejected", { uid = self.uid, attempt = self.attempts,
                reason = self.request.error, retryDelay = self.retryDelay })
            if self.attempts >= 3 then return false, "bait pickup rejected: " .. tostring(self.request.error) end
            self:setPhase("SETTLE", 6)
            self.stableAt, self.samples = now, 0
        end
    end
    return nil
end

return Bait

end)()
local Pose=(function()
local Pose = {}

function Pose.heading(x, z, previousX, previousZ)
    local length = math.sqrt(x * x + z * z)
    if length < 0.001 then return previousX or 0, previousZ or -1 end
    return x / length, z / length
end

function Pose.canStand(reactionAt, now, ragdollUntil, serverNow)
    return reactionAt ~= nil and now - reactionAt >= 3
        and (tonumber(ragdollUntil) or 0) <= serverNow
end

return Pose

end)()
local RootCamera=(function()
-- Event-driven camera ownership; no RenderStepped or camera CFrame writer.
local RootCamera = {}
RootCamera.__index = RootCamera
function RootCamera.new(player, character, root, getCamera)
    return setmetatable({player=player, character=character, root=root, getCamera=getCamera},RootCamera)
end
function RootCamera:begin()
    if self.player.Character ~= self.character or self.root.Parent ~= self.character then return false end
    local camera = self.getCamera()
    if not camera then return false end
    if self.camera then
        return camera == self.camera and camera.CameraSubject == self.root and camera.CameraType == self.cameraType
    end
    local kind = camera.CameraType.Name
    if kind ~= "Custom" and kind ~= "Follow" then return false end
    local subject = camera.CameraSubject
    if not subject or not subject:IsDescendantOf(self.character) then return false end
    self.camera, self.subject, self.cameraType = camera, subject, camera.CameraType
    camera.CameraSubject = self.root
    return true
end
function RootCamera:restore()
    local camera, subject, cameraType = self.camera, self.subject, self.cameraType
    self.camera, self.subject, self.cameraType = nil, nil, nil
    if not camera or self.getCamera() ~= camera or camera.CameraSubject ~= self.root
        or camera.CameraType ~= cameraType then return false end
    if self.player.Character == self.character and subject and subject.Parent == self.character then
        camera.CameraSubject = subject
    else
        local character = self.player.Character
        camera.CameraSubject = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
    end
    return true
end
return RootCamera

end)()
-- Main owns selection, UI and movement ownership; Engine/Bait own the transaction.
local phaseText = {
    IDLE="Finding an egg", PREPARE="Preparing chicken", OUTBOUND="Going to egg",
    SETTLE="Getting ready to pick up", PICKUP="Picking up egg", PROOF="Confirming pickup",
    RETURN="Bringing egg home", CLAIM="Delivering egg", DROP_WAIT="Waiting for dropped egg",
    RECOVER="Waiting for egg / movement recovery",
    DRAIN="Finishing pickup", DONE="Egg collected", STOPPED="Stopped",
}
local m={completed=0,stages=0,baitApproaches=0,hitReports=0,lastReason="idle"}
RuntimeStatus.ChickenTP=m
local function same(a,b)return a~=nil and b~=nil and tostring(a)==tostring(b)end
function m.isBait(uid)
    local t=m.active
    local p=t and t.engine and t.engine.preparation
    if p and same(uid,p.uid) then return true end
    local r=getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
    return r~=nil and r.purpose=="chicken-bait" and r.inFlight and same(uid,r.uid)
end
function m.observeCarry(state)
    local t=m.active
    if t then t.nextHeldRead=0 end -- invalidate the bounded ownership read on every carry event
    if t and t.engine then t.engine:observeCarry(state) end
    local r=getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
    if r and type(state)=="table" then
        if state.IsCarrying and same(state.Uid,r.uid) then r.carrySeen,r.carryActive=true,true
        elseif state.IsCarrying==false and (same(state.Uid,r.uid) or (state.Uid==nil and r.carryActive)) then
            r.carryActive,r.carryEndedSeen=false,true
        end
    end
    return type(state)=="table" and (m.isBait(state.Uid) or (state.Uid==nil and r and m.isBait(r.uid)))
end
function m.observeClaim(feedback)
    local t=m.active
    if not t or not t.engine then return false end
    local p=t.engine.preparation
    if p and p:observeClaim(feedback) then return true end
    t.engine:observeClaim(feedback)
    if t.engine.claimSeen and t.engine.request then
        t.engine.request.claimSeen,t.engine.request.standaloneClaimVerified=true,true
        t.engine:finish() -- finish before main inventory/event callbacks can hand off ownership
    end
    return false
end
function m.noteHit(hit)
    local t=m.active
    if t and t.engine and t.engine.preparation and type(hit)=="table" and hit.Player==LocalPlayer then
        return t.engine.preparation:observeHit(hit.EggUid,"natural")
    end
    return false
end
function m.isLandingProtected(character)
    local t=m.active
    local engine=t and t.engine
    local prep=engine and engine.preparation
    local dev=RuntimeStatus.DevChickenTween
    local l=dev and dev.lease
    return l~=nil and (l.nativeBody==true or (dev.persistent and dev.persistent.rig==l.rig))
        and dev.alive(l) and Arb.owner==l.owner
        and (l.owner=="Steal" or (l.owner=="Scramble" and t and t.questTravel==true))
        and character==l.character and t~=nil and character==t.character
        and engine~=nil and engine.active and (engine.phase=="PREPARE"
            or engine.phase=="OUTBOUND" or engine.phase=="SETTLE")
        and prep~=nil and prep.hitAt~=nil and prep.carrySeen==true
        and t.bait~=nil and same(prep.uid,t.bait.Uid)
end
function m.maintainLanding()return false end
function m.servicePending()
    local r=getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
    return not m.active and r and r.purpose=="chicken-bait" and r.inFlight==true or false
end
function m.run(target,keepGoing,questTravel)
    local owner=questTravel and "Scramble" or "Steal"
    local recovering = not questTravel and RuntimeStatus.activeDroppedRecoveryRecord(target.Uid) ~= nil
    local dev=RuntimeStatus.DevChickenTween
    local pending=getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
    if pending and pending.inFlight then return false,"previous pickup still in flight" end
    local ready,reason=dev.begin(true,owner,keepGoing)
    if not ready then return false,reason end
    local l=dev.lease
    local root,humanoid=l.root,l.temporary
    local movement=(questTravel or Settings.StealMovementType=="Tween") and "Tween" or "TP"
    local route=Settings.StealRoute
    local track=RuntimeStatus.getTrackStart()
    if not track then dev.restore("TrackStart unavailable");return false,"TrackStart unavailable" end
    RuntimeStatus.StealClaim.current=nil
    local t={targetUid=target.Uid,character=l.character,development=true,phase="staging",questTravel=questTravel==true}
    local a,engine={},nil
    m.active=t
    local function alive()
        if not sessionAlive() then return false,"session replaced" end
        if not keepGoing() then return false,"steal disabled or superseded" end
        if t.failure then return false,t.failure end
        if not dev.alive(l) then
            return false,l.stopReason or "character or movement lease unavailable"
        end
        if not Arb.hold(owner) then return false,"movement ownership lost" end
        return true
    end
    local home=track.Position+Vector3.new(0,humanoid.HipHeight,0)
    -- A confirmed carried-egg loss continues at its current field position.
    if not recovering then
        setStealStatus("Going to start")
        local centered,centerReason=dev.move(home,.35,alive,nil,resetWallClosed,500)
        if not centered then m.active=nil;dev.restore(centerReason);return false,centerReason end
        m.stages+=1
    end
    l.mover:stop()
    local camera=RootCamera.new(LocalPlayer,l.character,root,function()return workspace.CurrentCamera end)
    dev.transactionCamera=camera
    local points,pointIndex
    a.now,a.record,a.sealed=os.clock,findAreaEgg,resetWallClosed
    if questTravel then a.record=function(uid) if uid==target.Uid then return target end;return findAreaEgg(uid) end end
    a.alive=alive
    a.home=function()return home end
    a.halt=function()l.mover:stop();humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero,false)end
    a.pending=function()local r=getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest;return r~=nil and r.inFlight==true end
    a.distance=function(pos)
        local delta=root.Position-pos
        if movement=="TP" and engine and (engine.phase=="OUTBOUND" or engine.phase=="SETTLE")
            and math.abs(delta.Y)<=3 then return Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z).Magnitude end
        return delta.Magnitude
    end
    a.goalDistance=function(from,to)return (from-to).Magnitude end
    a.eggGoal=function(rec)
        if questTravel and rec==target then return target.BottomCFrame.Position end
        return rec.BottomCFrame.Position+Vector3.new(0,humanoid.HipHeight+root.Size.Y/2,0)
    end
    a.available=function(rec)return rec~=nil and rec.BottomCFrame~=nil and (rec.State=="Slot" or rec.State=="Dropped")end
    a.owned=function(rec)return rec~=nil and rec.State=="Carried" and tonumber(rec.CarrierUserId)==LocalPlayer.UserId end
    a.heldUid=function()
        -- Whole-field ownership checks are only needed during bait release/pickup.
        local now=os.clock()
        if now >= (t.nextHeldRead or 0) then
            t.nextHeldRead=now+.2;t.heldUid=nil
            for _,rec in pairs(areaEggRecords())do if a.owned(rec) then t.heldUid=rec.Uid;break end end
        end
        return t.heldUid
    end
    a.recovered=function()
        return not l.recovery.running
            and (tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")) or 0)<=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
            and not humanoid.PlatformStand and humanoid:GetState()~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
            and humanoid:GetState()~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
    end
    a.registration=function()return table.clone(l.registration)end
    a.diagnostic=function()
        local record,lookupError=a.record(engine and engine.uid or target.Uid)
        local state=integrityState
        local impulse=state and rawget(state,"ImpulseContext")
        local correction=state and rawget(state,"CorrectionContext")
        local function number(value)
            value=tonumber(value)
            if value and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge then return value end
        end
        local function position(value)
            if typeof(value)=="Vector3" then return {number(value.X),number(value.Y),number(value.Z)} end
        end
        local function field(object,key)
            return type(object)=="table" and rawget(object,key) or nil
        end
        return {recordState=record and tostring(record.State) or "missing",lookupError=lookupError,
            carrier=record and number(record.CarrierUserId),resetClosed=a.sealed(),arbOwner=Arb.owner,
            carryActive=engine and engine.carryActive,carryEnded=engine and engine.carryEndedAt~=nil,
            pending=a.pending(),health=number(humanoid.Health),anchored=root.Anchored,sit=humanoid.Sit,
            platformStand=humanoid.PlatformStand,humanoidState=tostring(humanoid:GetState()),
            ragdollRemaining=math.max(0,(number(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")) or 0)-workspace:GetServerTimeNow()),
            position=position(root.Position),goal=position(engine and engine.goal),homeDistance=number(a.distance(home)),
            lastCommandedPosition=position(l.mover.interpolation),lastObservedPosition=position(l.mover.observed),
            velocity=position(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity),lastStepAge=l.mover.lastStep and os.clock()-l.mover.lastStep,
            registrationPending=l.mover.registrationPending==true,
            speedEvidence=number(field(state,"SpeedEvidence")),
            leaseCurrent=dev.lease==l,leaseCancelled=l.cancelled==true,leaseStop=l.stopReason,
            currentCharacter=LocalPlayer.Character==l.character,
            integrityPresent=state~=nil,integrityRigMatches=state~=nil and state.RootPart==root and state.Humanoid==humanoid,
            correctionActive=correction~=nil,correctionPhase=tostring(field(correction,"Phase") or "none"),
            correctionReason=tostring(field(correction,"Reason") or "none"),
            impulseKind=tostring(field(impulse,"Kind") or "none"),
            impulseTimeLeft=number(field(impulse,"ExpiresAt")) and field(impulse,"ExpiresAt")-os.clock(),
            impulseOrigin=position(field(impulse,"OriginPosition")),
            maxHorizontalSpeed=number(field(impulse,"MaxHorizontalSpeed")),
            maxVerticalSpeed=number(field(impulse,"MaxVerticalSpeed")),
            maxHorizontalDistance=number(field(impulse,"MaxHorizontalDistance")),
            maxUpwardDistance=number(field(impulse,"MaxUpwardDistance")),registration=a.registration()}
    end
    a.requireReaction=true
    a.teleportOutbound=movement=="TP"
    a.reacting=function()return not a.recovered()end
    a.reactionObserved=function()
        return t.recoveryGeneration~=nil and l.recovery.generation>t.recoveryGeneration
    end
    a.departureReady=function()
        return not a.pending() and not a.movementPaused()
    end
    a.note=function(kind,detail)
        engine:note(kind,detail)
        if kind=="bait phase" then t.phase="contact";m.lastReason="bait "..tostring(detail):lower() end
    end
    a.baitSpeed=500
    a.baitInRange=function(rec)
        return rec~=nil and rec.BottomCFrame~=nil and (root.Position-a.eggGoal(rec)).Magnitude<=1
    end
    a.setBaitGoal=function(pos)l.mover:setGoal(pos,500);m.baitApproaches+=1 end
    a.releaseBaitHold=function()l.mover:stop();humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero,false)end
    a.setGoal=function(pos,speed)
        local prep=engine.preparation
        assert(recovering or (prep and prep.hitAt and prep.carrySeen
            and prep.reactionSeen and prep.released),"target movement requires confirmed bait, chicken reaction and release")
        if engine.phase=="RETURN" then
            t.phase="return"
            points={}
            if route=="Fly" then
                if t.returnDrop~=engine.drops then t.returnDrop=engine.drops;t.returnY=root.Position.Y+21 end
                local y=t.returnY
                points={Vector3.new(root.Position.X,y,root.Position.Z),Vector3.new(pos.X,y,pos.Z)}
            elseif route=="Turbo Hybrid" then
                local previous=RuntimeStatus.movementPhase
                RuntimeStatus.movementPhase="return"
                local ok,route=pcall(RuntimeStatus.guardRoutePoints,root.Position,pos,target.AreaId)
                RuntimeStatus.movementPhase=previous
                if not ok then error("guard route unavailable")end
                for _,point in ipairs(route)do points[#points+1]=point end
            end
            points[#points+1]=pos;pointIndex=1
            l.mover:returnHome(points[pointIndex],speed)
        else
            points,pointIndex=nil,nil
            if recovering or engine.dropObserved then
                t.phase="retrieve"
                l.mover:interpolateTo(pos,speed)
                return
            end
            t.phase="travel"
            prep.targetTweenGoal,prep.relocatedAt,prep.standRequested=pos,nil,nil
            local moved,why=false,"Tween selected"
            if movement=="TP" then
                why="TP already attempted; continuing with tween"
                if not t.teleportAttempted then
                    t.teleportAttempted=true
                    local recovery=l.recovery
                    if a.reactionObserved() and recovery.running and os.clock()<(recovery.expiresAt or 0)
                        and not a.pending() and not a.movementPaused() then
                        moved,why=l.mover:teleportTo(pos,speed,integrityBridge)
                    else why="chicken TP window unavailable" end
                end
            end
            if moved then
                t.usedTeleport=true;prep.relocatedAt=os.clock();t.phase="landing"
                engine:note("TP outbound", "confirmed chicken window; native baseline adopted")
            else
                if movement=="TP" then t.teleportFallback=why;engine:note("TP tween fallback",why) end
                l.mover:interpolateTo(pos,speed)
            end
        end
    end
    a.findBait=function(uid)
        local best,dist
        for _,rec in pairs(areaEggRecords())do
            if not same(rec.Uid,uid) and rec.AreaId=="Forest" and rec.State=="Slot" and rec.BottomCFrame
                and AreaEggSlotIdentity.IsFirstAreaUid(rec.Uid) then
                local d=a.distance(a.eggGoal(rec));if not dist or d<dist then best,dist=rec,d end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    a.choose=function(retired)
        if questTravel then return target end
        local rec=a.record(target.Uid)
        if a.available(rec) and not retired[rec.Uid] then
            if not same(stealRuntime.attemptUid,rec.Uid) then
                stealRuntime.attemptUid=rec.Uid
                RuntimeStatus.attempts=(RuntimeStatus.attempts or 0)+1
            end
            return rec
        end
    end
    a.request=function(rec)
        assert(not a.pending(),"pickup single-flight violation")
        local bait=engine.phase=="PREPARE"
        assert(not questTravel or bait,"quest travel cannot request a target egg")
        local ticket={uid=rec.Uid,category=rec.AssetCategory,owner=owner,session=SESSION.Marker,
            character=l.character,generation=stealRuntime.respawnGeneration,started=os.clock(),
            inFlight=true,done=false,purpose=bait and "chicken-bait" or "standalone-target"}
        getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest=ticket
        if bait then
            t.bait,t.request=rec,ticket
            t.recoveryGeneration=l.recovery.generation
            local stop=getgenv().__CHSAE_GuardStopActive;if type(stop)=="function"then stop()end
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            if not alive() or not engine.active or a.sealed() then
                ticket.inFlight,ticket.done,ticket.accepted,ticket.error=false,true,false,"cancelled before invoke";return
            end
            local live=a.record(ticket.uid)
            if not a.available(live) or a.distance(a.eggGoal(live))>(bait and 1 or engine.c.reach)
                or not a.recovered() or a.movementPaused() then
                ticket.inFlight,ticket.done,ticket.accepted,ticket.error=false,true,false,"pickup state changed before invoke";return
            end
            local ok,accepted,issue=pcall(EggCmds.RequestCarryAreaEgg,ticket.uid,carrySlotKey(live))
            ticket.accepted=ok and accepted==true
            if not ok then ticket.error=tostring(accepted)
            elseif not ticket.accepted then ticket.error=tostring(issue or "server rejected")end
            ticket.finished,ticket.completedAt,ticket.done,ticket.inFlight=os.clock(),os.clock(),true,false
            if ticket.standaloneClaimVerified then return end
        end)
        return ticket
    end
    a.bindHitObserver=function()assert(RuntimeStatus.ensureStealChickenAttackBinding(),"Forest chicken handler unavailable")end
    a.invokeAttack=function(prep)
        if not alive() or a.sealed() or engine.preparation~=prep or not prep.carryActive or prep.released then return false,"bait transaction changed"end
        if l.nativeBody then
            local rec=a.record(target.Uid)
            if not a.available(rec) then return false,"target unavailable before chicken hit" end
            l.mover:stop()
            l.mover:faceGoal(a.eggGoal(rec))
        end
        t.hitReportAttempted=true
        local sent,issue=RuntimeStatus.invokeStealChickenAttack(prep.uid)
        if sent then m.hitReports+=1 end
        return sent,issue
    end
    if not recovering then a.prepare=function(rec)return Bait.new(a,rec)end end
    a.pickupReady=function(now)
        if recovering or engine.dropObserved then return a.recovered() and math.abs(root.Position.Y-engine.goal.Y)<=3 end
        return engine.preparation and engine.preparation:pickupReady(now) and math.abs(root.Position.Y-engine.goal.Y)<=3
    end
    a.movementPaused=function()
        return l.mover.registrationPending == true
            or (integrityState and rawget(integrityState,"CorrectionContext") ~= nil) == true
    end
    engine=Engine.new(a,{speed=RuntimeStatus.getDeliverySpeed(movement),returnSpeed=Settings.StealSlowReturn == true and 500 or RuntimeStatus.getDeliverySpeed(movement),
        maxCycles=1,settle=.35,settleSamples=3,reach=.6})
    t.engine=engine
    RuntimeStatus.StandaloneStealEngine=engine
    dev.transactionRetry=function(reason)
        if not alive() then return false end
        return engine:movementInterrupted(reason)
    end
    local previous=os.clock()
    dev.transactionStep=function(now)
        local prep=engine.preparation
        if t.usedTeleport and not t.teleportFallback and prep and prep.targetTweenGoal
            and (engine.phase=="OUTBOUND" or engine.phase=="SETTLE")
            and ((integrityState and integrityState.CorrectionContext) or a.distance(prep.targetTweenGoal)>6) then
            t.teleportFallback="TP landing corrected or displaced; continuing with tween"
            engine:note("TP tween fallback",t.teleportFallback)
        end
        if prep and prep.reactionAt and not t.chickenRecoveryUntil then
            local remaining=math.max(0,(tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")) or 0)-workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
            t.chickenRecoveryUntil=math.max(prep.reactionAt+3,now+remaining)
        end
        if prep and prep.targetTweenGoal and not prep.relocatedAt
            and (engine.phase=="OUTBOUND" or engine.phase=="SETTLE")
            and a.distance(prep.targetTweenGoal)<=.35 then
            prep.relocatedAt=now;t.phase="landing"
        end
        if prep and prep.relocatedAt and l.mover.holdCFrame and not prep.standRequested
            and not a.movementPaused() and Pose.canStand(prep.reactionAt,now,
            LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime"),workspace:GetServerTimeNow())then
            prep.standRequested=true;l.mover:standUp()
            camera:restore()
        end
        if engine.phase=="RETURN" and engine.carryActive and not engine.carryEndedAt
            and a.recovered() and not a.movementPaused()
            and points and pointIndex<#points and (root.Position-points[pointIndex]).Magnitude<=.6 then
            pointIndex+=1;l.mover:returnHome(points[pointIndex],engine.c.returnSpeed)
        end
        local pauseCredit = l.mover.pauseCredit or 0
        l.mover.pauseCredit = 0
        if pauseCredit > 0 then
            engine.registrationPauseSpent = engine.registrationPauseSpent or 0
            local credit = math.min(pauseCredit, math.max(0, 16 - engine.registrationPauseSpent))
            engine.registrationPauseSpent += credit
            if engine.deadline and (engine.phase=="OUTBOUND" or engine.phase=="RETURN" or engine.phase=="SETTLE") then
                engine.deadline += credit
            end
        end
        if questTravel and engine.phase~="IDLE" and engine.phase~="PREPARE" then
            if not alive() or a.sealed() then engine:stop("quest travel cancelled")
            elseif a.distance(a.eggGoal(target))<=0.5 and a.recovered() and not a.pending() then
                t.questArrived=true;engine:stop("quest destination reached")
            elseif now>=engine.deadline then engine:stop("quest travel timed out") end
        else engine:tick(now,now-previous) end
        previous=now
    end
    local lastPhase
    while alive() do
        if not engine.active then break end
        l.lastUse=os.clock()
        local phase=engine.phase..(engine.preparation and ":"..engine.preparation.phase or "")
        if phase~=lastPhase then
            lastPhase=phase
            setStealStatus(recovering and engine.phase=="OUTBOUND" and "Retrieving dropped egg"
                or phaseText[engine.phase] or "Stealing egg")
        end
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    end
    dev.transactionStep,dev.transactionRetry=nil,nil
    camera:restore();dev.transactionCamera=nil
    if engine.active then
        local _,unavailable=alive()
        engine:stop(t.failure or unavailable or l.stopReason or "cancelled")
    end
    -- Restore after every cycle, including TP and cancellation, before going idle.
    if dev.lease == l then
        if t.questArrived and alive() then dev.stopTween(l,true)
        else dev.restore(engine.cycles > 0 and "steal complete" or "steal ended") end
    end
    m.active=nil;m.lastReason=engine.reason or engine.phase
    if engine.cycles>0 then m.completed+=1 end
    local request=getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
    if request and not request.inFlight then getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest=nil end
    return t.questArrived==true or engine.cycles>0,m.lastReason,engine
end
function RuntimeStatus.runStandaloneSteal(target,keepGoing,questTravel)
    local ok,verified,reason,engine=xpcall(function()return m.run(target,keepGoing,questTravel)end,
        function(issue)return tostring(issue)end)
    if ok then return verified,reason,engine end
    local dev=RuntimeStatus.DevChickenTween
    local active=m.active
    dev.transactionRetry,dev.transactionStep=nil,nil
    if active and active.engine then pcall(function()active.engine:stop("transaction error: "..verified)end) end
    dev.restore("transaction error")
    m.active=nil
    return false,"transaction error: "..verified,active and active.engine
end
end
-- [[ END EXACT STANDALONE ENGINE ]] --

-- Death ends the character, but a fatal guard catch drops the positively carried
-- egg into the field. Preserve that exact UID as a provisional recovery lease so
-- the replacement character reclaims it. A never-carried outbound target still
-- resets normally. An InvokeServer already in flight cannot be cancelled, so tag
-- it and wait without moving the replacement character.
RuntimeStatus.onAutoStealDeath = function(deadCharacter)
    if not RuntimeStatus.stealFeatureEnabled() then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    local pending = getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
    local replicatedHeld = carriedAreaEgg()
    local priorKind = tostring(stealRuntime.lastRequestKind or "")
    local pendingProvedCarry = type(pending) == "table" and pending.carrySeen == true
    local recoveringExactDrop = (priorKind == "carry-drop"
            or priorKind == "carry-loss-sync" or priorKind == "death-drop-sync")
        and (stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid ~= nil or stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid ~= nil)
    local recoveryUid
    if replicatedHeld and replicatedHeld.Uid ~= nil then
        recoveryUid = replicatedHeld.Uid
    elseif carrying or stealRuntime.carriedUid ~= nil then
        recoveryUid = stealRuntime.carriedUid
            or (type(pending) == "table" and pending.uid or nil)
            or stealRuntime.lockedUid or stealRuntime.attemptUid
    elseif pendingProvedCarry then
        recoveryUid = pending.uid or stealRuntime.lockedUid or stealRuntime.attemptUid
    elseif recoveringExactDrop then
        recoveryUid = stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid
            or stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid or stealRuntime.lockedUid
    else
        -- Carry=false/FieldGone can beat the deferred HealthChanged handler.
        -- Fall back only to a UID positively observed during the short death window;
        -- claims and completed recovery clear this evidence explicitly.
        recoveryUid = stealRuntime.recentPositiveCarryUid()
    end
    if recoveryUid ~= nil and RuntimeStatus.isCaptureEventUid(recoveryUid) then
        recoveryUid = nil
    end


    stealRuntime.respawnGeneration += 1
    stealRuntime.requestFailureCount = 0
    if recoveryUid ~= nil then
        if tostring(stealRuntime.persistentUid) ~= tostring(recoveryUid) then
            stealRuntime.persistentUid = nil
        end
        if tostring(stealRuntime.dropRecoveryRecordUid) ~= tostring(recoveryUid) then
            stealRuntime.dropRecoveryRecord = nil
            stealRuntime.dropRecoveryRecordUid = nil
            stealRuntime.dropRecoveryRecordAt = 0
        end
        stealRuntime.lockedUid = recoveryUid
        stealRuntime.attemptUid = recoveryUid
        stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid = recoveryUid
        if (tonumber(stealRuntime.dropDetectedAt) or 0) <= 0 then
            stealRuntime.dropDetectedAt = now
        end
        stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid = recoveryUid
        if (tonumber(stealRuntime.deathRecoveryAt) or 0) <= 0 then
            stealRuntime.deathRecoveryAt = now
        end
        local liveRecoveryRecord = findAreaEgg(recoveryUid)
        local liveRecoveryState = liveRecoveryRecord
            and tostring(liveRecoveryRecord.State) or nil
        local liveRecoveryCarrier = liveRecoveryRecord
            and tonumber(liveRecoveryRecord.CarrierUserId) or nil
        local liveRecoveryReady = liveRecoveryRecord ~= nil
            and (((liveRecoveryState == "Slot" or liveRecoveryState == "Dropped")
                    and liveRecoveryRecord.BottomCFrame ~= nil)
                or liveRecoveryCarrier == LocalPlayer.UserId)
        if liveRecoveryReady then
            stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingAt = 0
            stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingReason = ""
        else
            -- Promotion from recent carry evidence starts a fresh full grace;
            -- this also bounds GuardCarried/unknown transitional rows.
            stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingAt = now
            stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingReason = liveRecoveryRecord
                and "death-record-transitioning" or "death-snapshot-missing"
        end
        stealRuntime.requestFailureUid = recoveryUid
        stealRuntime.requestFailureAt = now
        if priorKind ~= "carry-drop" then
            stealRuntime.lastRequestKind = "death-drop-sync"
        end
        stealRuntime.lastRequestError = "character died while carrying; awaiting exact egg"
        RuntimeStatus.pendingDroppedUid = recoveryUid
        if type(stealRuntime.webhookTarget) == "table"
            and tostring(stealRuntime.webhookTarget.uid) ~= tostring(recoveryUid) then
            stealRuntime.webhookTarget = nil
        end
    else
        stealRuntime.persistentUid = nil
        stealRuntime.lockedUid = nil
        stealRuntime.attemptUid = nil
        stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid = nil
        stealRuntime.dropDetectedAt = 0
        stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid = nil
        stealRuntime.deathRecoveryAt = 0
        stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingAt = 0
        stealRuntime.deathRecoveryMissingReason = ""
        stealRuntime.dropRecoveryRecord = nil
        stealRuntime.dropRecoveryRecordUid = nil
        stealRuntime.dropRecoveryRecordAt = 0
        stealRuntime.requestFailureUid = nil
        stealRuntime.requestFailureAt = 0
        stealRuntime.lastRequestKind = ""
        stealRuntime.lastRequestError = ""
        stealRuntime.webhookTarget = nil
        RuntimeStatus.pendingDroppedUid = nil
        stealRuntime.clearPositiveCarryEvidence()
    end
    carrying = false
    stealRuntime.carriedUid = nil
    RuntimeStatus.activeGuardAreaId = nil

    if type(pending) == "table" then
        if recoveryUid ~= nil and tostring(pending.uid) == tostring(recoveryUid) then
            pending.carrySeen = true
        end
        if pending.inFlight then
            pending.cancelledByDeath = true
        else
            getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest = nil
        end
    end

    ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = recoveryUid ~= nil
    local interruptedOwner = Arb.owner
    if recoveryUid ~= nil and interruptedOwner and interruptedOwner ~= "Steal" then
        Arb.release(interruptedOwner)
    end
    Arb.stealWants = recoveryUid ~= nil
    Arb.critical = false
    Arb.stealBeat = os.clock()
    Arb.release("Steal")
    RuntimeStatus.pauseStealTimer()
    RuntimeStatus.carry = recoveryUid ~= nil
        and "📦 Carry: lost on death · reclaiming" or "📦 Carry: none"
    if recoveryUid == nil then RuntimeStatus.set("target", "🎯 Target: none") end
    setStealStatus(recoveryUid ~= nil
        and "🔁 Respawning — reclaiming dropped egg" or "🟡 Respawning — rescanning")
    if wakeEggScanner then wakeEggScanner("character-death") end
end

-- Manual egg holding; the existing Steal worker serializes movement ownership.
do
local Stall = {}
RuntimeStatus.Stall = Stall

function Stall.points(bounds, position)
    local p = bounds.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
    local half = bounds.Size * 0.5
    if math.abs(p.X) > half.X or math.abs(p.Z) > half.Z
        or half.X <= 8 or half.Z <= 8 then return nil end
    local a = bounds.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(-half.X + 8, p.Y, 0))
    local b = bounds.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(half.X - 8, p.Y, 0))
    return {a, b}, p.X <= 0 and 2 or 1
end

function Stall.route(bounds, position, target)
    local previous = RuntimeStatus.movementPhase
    RuntimeStatus.movementPhase = "return"
    local ok, route = pcall(RuntimeStatus.guardRoutePoints, position, target, bounds.Parent.Name, bounds)
    RuntimeStatus.movementPhase = previous
    if not ok then error(route) end
    local half = bounds.Size * 0.5
    local y = bounds.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position).Y
    for i, point in ipairs(route) do
        local p = bounds.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
        route[i] = bounds.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(
            math.clamp(p.X, -half.X + 8, half.X - 8), y,
            math.clamp(p.Z, -half.Z + 8, half.Z - 8)))
    end
    route[#route + 1] = target
    return route
end

function Stall.itinerary(guards)
    local ordered, itinerary = {}, {}
    for _, area in ipairs(guards:GetChildren()) do
        local part=area:FindFirstChild("Bounds")
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then ordered[#ordered+1]=part end
    end
    table.sort(ordered,function(a,b)return a.Position.X<b.Position.X end)
    local minZ,maxZ=-math.huge,math.huge
    local gates=areaGateMap()
    for _, part in ipairs(ordered) do
        local gate=gates[part.Parent.Name]
        if not gate or (gate.req==nil and part.Parent.Name~="Forest")
            or not areaAllowed(part.Parent.Name) then break end
        local low=math.max(minZ,part.Position.Z-part.Size.Z/2+8)
        local high=math.min(maxZ,part.Position.Z+part.Size.Z/2-8)
        if low>high then break end
        minZ,maxZ=low,high
        itinerary[#itinerary+1]=part
    end
    return itinerary,#itinerary>0 and (minZ+maxZ)/2 or nil
end

function Stall.run()
    local held = carriedAreaEgg()
    if not held then
        setStealStatus("Stall · manually pick up an egg")
        task.wait(0.2)
        return
    end
    local root, humanoid = getCharParts()
    if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then task.wait(0.2); return end
    local objects = workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS")
    local areas = objects and objects:FindFirstChild("Areas")
    local guards = areas and areas:FindFirstChild("GuardAreas")
    local bounds, points, nextPoint
    for _, area in ipairs(guards and guards:GetChildren() or {}) do
        local part = area:FindFirstChild("Bounds")
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            points, nextPoint = Stall.points(part, root.Position)
            if points then bounds = part; break end
        end
    end
    if not bounds then
        setStealStatus("Stall · enter an egg area first")
        task.wait(0.2)
        return
    end
    local itinerary,laneZ=Stall.itinerary(guards)
    local index=table.find(itinerary,bounds)
    if not index then setStealStatus("Stall · waiting for unlocked area data");task.wait(.2);return end
    local direction=index==#itinerary and -1 or 1
    local character, uid = LocalPlayer.Character, held.Uid
    local function holding()
        local current = carriedAreaEgg()
        return sessionAlive() and Settings.Stall and LocalPlayer.Character == character
            and current ~= nil and tostring(current.Uid) == tostring(uid)
            and bounds.Parent ~= nil and not resetWallClosed()
    end
    Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = true, true
    if not Arb.acquireWait("Steal", 1) then
        Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = false, false
        task.wait(0.2)
        return
    end
    local dev = RuntimeStatus.DevChickenTween
    local ok, issue = pcall(function()
        if not holding() then return end
        if not setIntegrityGuard(true) then error("movement controller unavailable") end
        local ready, reason = dev.begin(true)
        if not ready then error(reason) end
        setStealControlLock(true)
        ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = true
        local function moving()
            return holding() and dev.lease ~= nil and dev.alive(dev.lease) and Arb.hold("Steal")
        end
        while moving() do
            local route
            if #itinerary>1 then
                local nextIndex=index+direction
                if nextIndex<1 or nextIndex>#itinerary then direction=-direction;nextIndex=index+direction end
                local destination=itinerary[nextIndex]
                if not destination.Parent or not areaAllowed(destination.Parent.Name) then break end
                setStealStatus("Stall · " .. destination.Parent.Name)
                route={Vector3.new(root.Position.X,root.Position.Y,laneZ),
                    Vector3.new(destination.Position.X,root.Position.Y,laneZ)}
                index=nextIndex
            else
                setStealStatus("Stall · " .. bounds.Parent.Name)
                route=Stall.route(bounds,root.Position,points[nextPoint])
            end
            for _, point in ipairs(route) do
                if not moving() then break end
                local moved, why = dev.move(point, 0.6, moving, nil, nil,
                    RuntimeStatus.getDeliverySpeed(Settings.StealMovementType),true)
                if not moved then
                    if holding() then error(why or "movement interrupted") end
                    break
                end
            end
            nextPoint = 3 - nextPoint
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
    end)
    dev.restore("Stall ended")
    setStealControlLock(false)
    setIntegrityGuard(false)
    ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = false
    Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = false, false
    Arb.release("Steal")
    if not ok then setStealStatus("Stall paused · " .. tostring(issue)) end
    task.wait(0.2)
end
end


task.spawn(function()
    -- Keep Auto-Steal self-healing. A non-movement presentation or executor
    -- exception must not leave Arb.owner="Steal" forever after one successful
    -- claim. The inner worker owns all normal state; the supervisor preserves an
    -- in-flight RemoteFunction and restarts from replicated carry state.
    while sessionAlive() do
        local workerOk, workerError = xpcall(function()
    local blacklist = {} -- [uid] = os.clock() until which we skip it
    RuntimeStatus.riftTargetBlocked = function(uid)
        return blacklist[uid] ~= nil and os.clock() <= blacklist[uid]
    end
    local seenRespawnGeneration = stealRuntime.respawnGeneration
    while sessionAlive() do
        -- Immediate cancellation/recovery paths must let replication and physics advance.
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        if not sessionAlive() then break end
        -- A worker restart or completed transaction must never inherit an old
        -- outbound-only sale permission.
        Arb.sellDuringSteal = false
        if Settings.Stall then RuntimeStatus.Stall.run(); continue end
        -- Keep the persisted mirror aligned even if a config restore changes the
        -- Obsidian control without firing its OnChanged callback on this executor.
        local toggleEnabled = autoStealTgl and autoStealTgl.Value == true
        if Settings.AutoSteal ~= toggleEnabled then Settings.AutoSteal = toggleEnabled end
        if not RuntimeStatus.stealWorkerAlive() then
            local claims = RuntimeStatus.StealClaim
            if claims.current then claims.last=claims.current end
            claims.current=nil
        end
        if RuntimeStatus.stealWorkerAlive() and RuntimeStatus.serviceStealClaimDrain() then
            Arb.critical,Arb.stealWants=false,false
            Arb.release("Steal")
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            continue
        end
        if not RuntimeStatus.stealWorkerAlive() then
            setStealControlLock(false)
            ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = false
            -- stealFeatureEnabled() dips for reasons that are not "the user
            -- turned Auto-Steal off": the Rift collect flag between its
            -- own transactions, an inventory-full auto-stop, a toggle bounce. A
            -- guard drop that is still reclaimable must outlive those. The two
            -- authoritative off paths (the toggle's own OnChanged and
            -- stopAutoStealForFullInventory) already clear it, so wiping here as
            -- well only ever destroyed a live recovery — which is what sent the
            -- worker back to TrackStart empty instead of to the dropped egg.
            if not (carryLossRecoveryPending()
                and os.clock() - (tonumber(stealRuntime.dropDetectedAt) or 0)
                    <= stealRuntime.disabledRecoveryHold) then
                clearPersistentTarget()
            end
            Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = false, false
            Arb.release("Steal") -- Auto-Steal off → pen/pet tasks are free
            RuntimeStatus.pauseStealTimer()
            RuntimeStatus.set("target", "🎯 Target: none")
            RuntimeStatus.carry = "📦 Carry: none"
            setStealStatus("🔴 Off")
            task.wait(0.5)
            continue
        end
        -- CharacterAdded is the fallback if an executor misses the dead
        -- Humanoid's final HealthChanged packet. Only reset here when transaction
        -- state actually survived onto a different character.
        local observedCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
        if observedCharacter ~= stealRuntime.characterToken then
            stealRuntime.characterToken = observedCharacter
            if stealRuntime.lockedUid or stealRuntime.persistentUid or carrying
                or Arb.owner == "Steal"
                or stealRuntime.recentPositiveCarryUid() ~= nil then
                RuntimeStatus.onAutoStealDeath(observedCharacter)
            end
        end
        if seenRespawnGeneration ~= stealRuntime.respawnGeneration then
            seenRespawnGeneration = stealRuntime.respawnGeneration
            blacklist = {}
        end

        -- Never stage or select against a dead/not-yet-replicated character.
        local liveRoot, liveHumanoid = getCharParts()
        if not (liveRoot and liveHumanoid and liveHumanoid.Health > 0) then
            local recoveringWhileDead = carryLossRecoveryPending()
            ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = recoveringWhileDead
            Arb.stealWants = recoveringWhileDead
            Arb.critical = false
            Arb.stealBeat = os.clock()
            Arb.release("Steal")
            setStealStatus(recoveringWhileDead
                and "🔁 Respawning — exact egg recovery locked"
                or "🟡 Respawning — waiting for character")
            task.wait(0.2)
            continue
        end
        local recoveringCarryLoss = carryLossRecoveryPending()
        if RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockReturnHasPriority()
            and not recoveringCarryLoss
            and not carrying and not Arb.critical
            and not RuntimeStatus.carryRequestInFlight() then
            setStealControlLock(false)
            ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = false
            Arb.sellDuringSteal = false
            Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = false, false
            Arb.release("Steal")
            RuntimeStatus.pauseStealTimer()
            RuntimeStatus.set("target", "🎯 Target: Crane return")
            RuntimeStatus.carry = "📦 Carry: none"
            setStealStatus("🔓 Submitting hatched Crane")
            task.wait(0.1)
            continue
        end
        if RuntimeStatus.adminEventHasPriority() and not recoveringCarryLoss then
            local liveRequest = getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
            local eventOwnsRequest = type(liveRequest) == "table"
                and liveRequest.owner == "AdminEvent"
            if Arb.owner == "AdminEvent" or eventOwnsRequest
                or (not carrying and not Arb.critical
                    and not RuntimeStatus.carryRequestInFlight()) then
                setStealControlLock(false)
                ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = true
                Arb.sellDuringSteal = false
                Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = false, false
                Arb.release("Steal")
                RuntimeStatus.pauseStealTimer()
                RuntimeStatus.set("target", "🎯 Target: Rift")
                RuntimeStatus.carry = "📦 Carry: none"
                setStealStatus("🌀 Rift has priority")
                task.wait(0.1)
                continue
            end
        end
        local inventoryFull, inventoryCount, inventoryCapacity = RuntimeStatus.eggInventoryCapacityState()
        if inventoryFull then
            if RuntimeStatus.riftCollecting == true
                or (Settings.AutoRift == true
                    and RuntimeStatus.riftActive == true
                    and RuntimeStatus.riftEggActive()) then
                RuntimeStatus.riftCollecting = false
                -- Inventory-full waiting owns no movement. Placement and actual
                -- event work retain their separate reservations below.
                ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = false
                Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = false, false
                Arb.release("Steal")
                setStealStatus("🌀 Inventory full · place or hatch required eggs")
                local riftWake = getgenv().__CHSAE_RiftWake
                if riftWake then pcall(function() riftWake:Fire("inventory-full") end) end
                task.wait(0.1)
            elseif RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockNeedsCrane() then
                ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = false
                Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = false, false
                Arb.release("Steal")
                setStealStatus("🔓 Great Bloom · make egg inventory space")
                task.wait(0.5)
            else
                RuntimeStatus.stopAutoStealForFullInventory(inventoryCount, inventoryCapacity,
                    "Your egg inventory is full!")
                task.wait(0.05)
            end
            continue
        end
        local guardReady = setIntegrityGuard(true)
        RuntimeStatus.defaultMoveFallback = not guardReady
        if not guardReady then
            setStealStatus("⏸️ Waiting to move")
        end
        setStealControlLock(true)
        if not Settings.PersistentSteal then stealRuntime.persistentUid = nil end
        Arb.critical = carrying
            or RuntimeStatus.activeDroppedRecoveryRecord(stealRuntime.lockedUid) ~= nil
        Arb.stealBeat = os.clock()

        if RuntimeStatus.ChickenTP.servicePending() then
            Arb.critical = true
            setStealStatus("🐔 Finishing chicken preparation")
            task.wait(0.1)
            continue
        end

        -- ── Phase 1: recover a carry that survived a reload/interruption ──
        local heldRec = carriedAreaEgg()
        local heldUid = heldRec and heldRec.Uid
            or stealRuntime.carriedUid
            or stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid
            or stealRuntime.lockedUid
            or stealRuntime.attemptUid
        -- Cached carry flags and stale CarrierUserId fields are not sufficient
        -- to launch a recovery return after an authoritative drop/transfer.
        if heldUid ~= nil and stillCarrying(heldUid)
            and not RuntimeStatus.StealClaim:verified(heldUid) then
            carrying = true
            if heldRec and heldRec.AreaId ~= nil then
                RuntimeStatus.activeGuardAreaId = tostring(heldRec.AreaId)
            end
            ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = true
            Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = true, true
            Arb.acquireWait("Steal", 3)
            ProgressionCtl.requestTreadmillExit()
            if areaResetActive() then
                Arb.release("Steal")
                setStealStatus("⏳ Wall closed — holding egg")
                local waitTime = resetWallClosed() and 10
                    or math.max(0.25, areaResetUntil - os.clock())
                waitForScannerWake(waitTime, function()
                    return not areaResetActive()
                end)
                continue
            end
            setStealStatus("🟢 Carrying → home")
            local startArea = getStartArea()
            local home = startArea and (startArea.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                or getExitTarget(30)
            if not home then
                setStealStatus("🟡 No exit line")
                task.wait(0.5)
                continue
            end

            local heldCategory = heldRec and heldRec.AssetCategory
            local heldAreaId = heldRec and heldRec.AreaId ~= nil
                and tostring(heldRec.AreaId) or RuntimeStatus.activeGuardAreaId
            local recoveryClaimSequence = stealRuntime.claimSequence
            local recoveryRequest=getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
            if type(recoveryRequest) ~= "table" or tostring(recoveryRequest.uid) ~= tostring(heldUid) then
                recoveryRequest={uid=heldUid,category=heldCategory,character=LocalPlayer.Character,
                    generation=stealRuntime.respawnGeneration,carrySeen=true,inFlight=false}
            end
            RuntimeStatus.beginStealClaim(recoveryRequest,true)
            local recoveryReturned, recoveryReturnReason = false, nil
            local recoveryConfirmed = claimConfirmed(
                heldUid, heldCategory, recoveryClaimSequence)
            while sessionAlive() and not recoveryConfirmed do
                recoveryReturned, recoveryReturnReason = RuntimeStatus.centeredStealReturnTo(
                    home, stealOn, function()
                        return resetWallClosed()
                            or ProgressionCtl.detectActiveTreadmill() ~= nil
                            or (heldUid
                                and (droppedAreaEgg(heldUid)
                                    or RuntimeStatus.carryLostInField(heldUid))
                                and not claimConfirmed(
                                    heldUid, heldCategory, recoveryClaimSequence))
                            or (heldUid
                                and tostring(stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid) == tostring(heldUid)
                                and tostring(RuntimeStatus.pendingDroppedUid) == tostring(heldUid)
                                and not claimConfirmed(
                                    heldUid, heldCategory, recoveryClaimSequence))
                    end, heldAreaId)
                recoveryConfirmed = claimConfirmed(
                    heldUid, heldCategory, recoveryClaimSequence)
                if recoveryReturned or recoveryConfirmed then break end
                if not RuntimeStatus.preserveCarriedReturn(
                    heldUid, recoveryReturnReason) then break end
                if ProgressionCtl.detectActiveTreadmill() then
                    ProgressionCtl.requestTreadmillExit()
                    setStealStatus("🟡 Treadmill blocked — exiting")
                    task.wait(0.10)
                elseif resetWallClosed() then
                    setStealStatus("⏳ Wall closed — holding carried egg")
                    waitForScannerWake(0.25, function()
                        return not resetWallClosed()
                    end)
                else
                    setStealStatus("↩️ Returning home")
                    task.wait(0.03)
                end
            end

            if ProgressionCtl.detectActiveTreadmill() then
                ProgressionCtl.requestTreadmillExit()
                setStealStatus("🟡 Treadmill blocked — exiting")
                continue
            end
            if resetWallClosed() then
                Arb.release("Steal")
                setStealStatus("⏳ Wall closed — holding egg")
                continue
            end

            local confirmed=recoveryConfirmed
                or (recoveryReturned and RuntimeStatus.waitStealClaim(heldUid,stealOn))
            local liveHeldRec = carriedAreaEgg()
            carrying = liveHeldRec ~= nil
            RuntimeStatus.activeGuardAreaId = liveHeldRec and liveHeldRec.AreaId ~= nil
                and tostring(liveHeldRec.AreaId) or nil
            Arb.critical = carrying

            if confirmed then
                RuntimeStatus.activeGuardAreaId = nil
                if heldUid and RuntimeStatus.candidateIndex then
                    RuntimeStatus.candidateIndex:Invalidate(heldUid, "recovered delivery verified")
                end
                ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = true
                -- Standalone finishes immediately on proof; no forced TrackStart settle.
                Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = false, false
                Arb.release("Steal")
                RuntimeStatus.clearCarryLossRecovery(heldUid)
                stealRuntime.persistentUid = nil
                stealRuntime.lockedUid = nil
                stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid = nil
                stealRuntime.dropDetectedAt = 0
                setStealStatus("✅ Egg collected")
            elseif not carrying then
                local droppedUid = heldUid or stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid
                if armDroppedEggReacquire(droppedUid, "recovered carry was dropped") then
                    setStealStatus("🥚 Guard dropped egg · reclaiming now")
                    task.wait(0.03)
                    continue
                elseif droppedUid and tostring(stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid) == tostring(droppedUid) then
                    -- CarryChanged(false) can lead FieldShifted(Dropped) by a few
                    -- frames. Hold this exact transaction instead of blacklisting
                    -- it during that provisional replication gap.
                    stealRuntime.lockedUid = droppedUid
                    ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = true
                    Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = true, true
                    Arb.stealBeat = os.clock()
                    if Arb.owner ~= "Steal" then Arb.acquireWait("Steal", 0.1) end
                    setStealStatus("🥚 Dropped egg syncing · reclaiming")
                    waitForScannerWake(0.08)
                    continue
                elseif Settings.PersistentSteal and heldUid then
                    stealRuntime.persistentUid = heldUid
                    setStealStatus("🔁 Carry lost — waiting for egg")
                else
                    if heldUid then blacklist[heldUid] = os.clock() + 3 end
                    setStealStatus("🟡 Egg dropped — rescanning")
                end
                Arb.critical = false
                continue
            else
                setStealStatus("🟢 Carrying → home")
                continue
            end

            refreshStealStatus()
            continue
        end


        -- A stalled InvokeServer must never be followed by another carry invoke.
        -- Let remote-only work/treadmill continue while we wait for the one request
        -- to finish. If it eventually grants the egg, Phase 1 above recovers it.
        local pendingCarry = getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
        if type(pendingCarry) == "table" then
            if pendingCarry.cancelledByDeath then
                local activeDeathUid = stealRuntime.deathRecoveryUid
                    or stealRuntime.lastDroppedUid
                if pendingCarry.inFlight and activeDeathUid ~= nil
                    and tostring(pendingCarry.uid) ~= tostring(activeDeathUid) then
                    -- A stale/Admin request cannot own the positively recovered
                    -- UID. Isolate its late reply and let recovery A proceed.
                    pendingCarry.supersededByRecovery = true
                    if getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest == pendingCarry then
                        getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest = nil
                    end
                    pendingCarry = nil
                    ProgressionCtl.treadmillSuppressed = true
                    Arb.stealWants, Arb.critical = true, true
                    Arb.stealBeat = os.clock()
                    setStealStatus("🔁 Recovering dropped egg")
                end
                if pendingCarry and pendingCarry.inFlight then
                    local liveRecoveryRecord = pendingCarry.carrySeen == true
                        and findAreaEgg(pendingCarry.uid) or nil
                    local recoveryRec = pendingCarry.carrySeen == true
                        and RuntimeStatus.activeDroppedRecoveryRecord(pendingCarry.uid) or nil
                    local liveCarrierId = liveRecoveryRecord
                        and tonumber(liveRecoveryRecord.CarrierUserId) or nil
                    local liveRecoveryState = liveRecoveryRecord
                        and tostring(liveRecoveryRecord.State) or nil
                    local takenByOther = liveRecoveryRecord ~= nil
