            for uid in pairs(f.owned) do if not slotSet[uid] then f.owned[uid] = nil end end
            local plan, reason, eject = f.plan(save)
            if not d.settings.AutoFuse then
                for uid in pairs(f.owned) do eject = uid; break end
                if not eject then f.status = "Off"; return end
            end
            if eject then
                f.status = "Returning protected/unused pet"
                f.pending = { action = "EjectPet", uid = eject, at = d.now() }
                local accepted, message = d.request("EjectPet", eject)
                if accepted == false then f.pending = nil; f.status = tostring(message or "Cannot return pet") end
                return
            end
            if not plan then f.status = reason; return end
            local full, _, capacity = d.capacity()
            if full or not capacity then f.status = "Waiting for egg inventory space"; return end
            local price = d.price(save, plan.uids)
            if not finite(price) or not finite(save.Money) or save.Money < price then
                f.status = "Waiting for fuse cost"; return
            end
            if not d.alive() or not d.settings.AutoFuse or not d.idle() or not d.ready() then return end
            if plan.loaded < 3 then
                local uid = plan.uids[plan.loaded + 1]
                -- Validate a fresh save immediately before each insertion.
                local latest = d.save()
                local checked = f.plan(latest)
                if not checked or checked.uids[checked.loaded + 1] ~= uid
                    or checked.loaded ~= plan.loaded then return end
                f.owned[uid] = true
                f.pending = { action = "LoadPet", uid = uid, at = d.now() }
                f.status = "Loading " .. plan.category .. " (" .. tostring(plan.loaded + 1) .. "/3)"
                local accepted, message = d.request("LoadPet", uid)
                if accepted == false then f.pending = nil; f.owned[uid] = nil; f.status = tostring(message or "Pet rejected") end
            else
                local latest = d.save()
                local checked = f.plan(latest)
                if not checked or checked.loaded ~= 3 or latest.FusionLocked ~= false
                    or latest.FusionEggReward ~= false then return end
                for i, uid in ipairs(plan.uids) do if checked.uids[i] ~= uid then return end end
                if not d.settings.AutoFuse or not d.idle() or not d.ready() then return end
                f.status = "Fusing " .. plan.category
                f.pending = { action = "BeginFuse", at = d.now(), uids = table.clone(plan.uids) }
                local accepted, message, reward = d.request("BeginFuse")
                if accepted == false then f.pending = nil; f.status = tostring(message or "Fuse rejected")
                elseif accepted == true then
                    f.completed += 1
                end
            end
        end
        return f
    end
end
-- [[ END FUSE CONTROLLER ]] --

-- [[ FUSE TAB ]] --
;(function()
    local box = Window.__FuseTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Auto Fuse")
    Window.__FuseBox = box
    local controller, label, toggle
    CHK.Merge(box, function()
        label = box:AddLabel("FuseStatus", { Text = "Off", DoesWrap = true })
    end)
    local function changed()
        configSave(true)
        RuntimeStatus.markValueFilterChanged()
    end
    BindDropdownOverlay(box, "FuseCategories", "Categories", TargetCategoryData.Items, {
        configKey = "FuseCategories", multi = true, store = Settings.FuseCategories,
        text = "Categories", displayMap = TargetCategoryData.Display,
        tooltip = "Choose pets to fuse. Each fuse uses 3 matching pets.",
        onChange = changed,
    })
    RuntimeStatus.addKGFilterControls(box, "Fuse", "FuseKGMode", "FuseKGThreshold", changed, true)
    RuntimeStatus.addValueFilterInput(box, "FuseMinimumValue", "FuseMinimumValue", "Prevent Minimum Value", changed,
        "Keep pets at this income per second and above. K, M, B, T work; 0 disables.")
    toggle = box:AddToggle("AutoFuseToggle", { Text = "Auto Fuse", Default = Settings.AutoFuse,
        Tooltip = "Fuse while idle. Costs 3 matching pets and the game fee." })
    toggle:OnChanged(function(value) Settings.AutoFuse = value == true; configSave(true) end)
    getgenv().__CHSAE_ConfigControllers.AutoFuse = {
        GetValue = function() return Settings.AutoFuse end,
        SetValue = function(_, value) toggle:SetValue(value == true) end,
    }
    local Save, AssetItems, Kernel, Remotes
    local function modules()
        if Save and AssetItems and Kernel and Remotes then return true end
        return pcall(function()
            Save = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Save)
            AssetItems = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.AssetItems)
            Kernel = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.FuseKernel)
            Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes).Fusery
            assert(Remotes.LoadPet and Remotes.BeginFuse and Remotes.FinishReveal and Remotes.EjectPet)
        end)
    end
    local function idle()
        return sessionAlive() and Arb.free() and not Arb.stealBusy() and not Arb.critical
            and not carrying and carriedAreaEgg() == nil and not RuntimeStatus.carryLossRecoveryPending()
            and not Arb.placeBusy and not Arb.hatchBusy
            and not RuntimeStatus.hatchPetOutputPending and not RuntimeStatus.adminEventPending
            and not RuntimeStatus.riftWantsBody and not RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockReturnPending
    end
    local function ready()
        local identity = type(getthreadidentity) == "function" and getthreadidentity() or nil
        if type(setthreadidentity) == "function" then pcall(setthreadidentity, 8) end
        local ok, result = pcall(RuntimeStatus.sellerValueFilterReady, "FuseMinimumValue")
        if identity and type(setthreadidentity) == "function" then pcall(setthreadidentity, identity) end
        return ok and result == true
    end
    controller = RuntimeStatus.createFuseController({
        settings = Settings, now = os.clock, serverNow = function() return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end,
        alive = sessionAlive, idle = idle, ready = ready,
        save = function()
            local save = Save.Get()
            RuntimeStatus.reconcileNewPetUids(save)
            return save
        end,
        decode = function(raw) return AssetItems.Decode(raw) end,
        mayEnter = function(...) return Kernel.MayEnterFuse(...) end,
        weight = weightKg, kgMatches = RuntimeStatus.kgFilterMatches, value = valueScore,
        protected = function(uid, save)
            return RuntimeStatus.petSellUidProtected(uid, save, true)
                or (RuntimeStatus.greatBloomUnlockProtectCranePets == true and save.Inventory[uid].Category == "Crane")
        end,
        capacity = RuntimeStatus.eggInventoryCapacityState,
        price = function(save, uids)
            local items = {}
            for _, uid in ipairs(uids) do items[#items + 1] = AssetItems.Decode(save.Inventory[uid]) end
            return Kernel.PriceFor(items)
        end,
        disable = function() Settings.AutoFuse = false; pcall(function() toggle:SetValue(false) end); configSave(true) end,
        request = function(action, uid)
            local ok, accepted, reason, reward = pcall(function()
                if uid then return Remotes[action]:InvokeServer(uid) end
                return Remotes[action]:InvokeServer()
            end)
            if not ok then return nil, tostring(accepted) end -- retain pending state on uncertain delivery
            return accepted, reason, reward
        end,
    })
    if getgenv().__CHSAE_Debug then
        getgenv().__CHSAE_Debug.GetFuse = function()
            return { enabled = Settings.AutoFuse, status = controller.status, completed = controller.completed,
                pending = controller.pending and controller.pending.action }
        end
        getgenv().__CHSAE_Debug.PreviewFuse = function()
            if not modules() then return { reason = "Fuse modules unavailable" } end
            local plan, reason = controller.plan(Save.Get())
            return { category = plan and plan.category, uids = plan and plan.uids, reason = reason }
        end
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while sessionAlive() do
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                if (Settings.AutoFuse or controller.pending) and modules() and not Arb.petsBusy and idle() then
                    Arb.petsSerial(function() controller.tick() end, "Auto Fuse")
                elseif Settings.AutoFuse then controller.status = "Waiting for idle time" end
            end)
            if not ok then controller.status = "Fuse paused: " .. tostring(err) end
            if sessionAlive() then pcall(RuntimeStatus.setLabel, label, controller.status) end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)
end)()
-- [[ END FUSE TAB ]] --

-- EVENT TAB — Rift
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════
;(function()
    local Save, RiftRemotes, AssetItems, FuseKernel, Eligibility, EggRecords
    local Planner = RuntimeStatus.RiftPlanner
    local state, stateAt, stateRequest, stateError = nil, 0, nil, nil
    local nextActionAt, plan = 0, nil
    local stateRetryAt = 0
    local function modules()
        if Save and RiftRemotes and AssetItems and FuseKernel and Eligibility and EggRecords then return true end
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            Save = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Save)
            RiftRemotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes).Rift
            AssetItems = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.AssetItems)
            FuseKernel = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.FuseKernel)
            Eligibility = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.RiftEligibility)
            EggRecords = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.EggRecords)
        end)
        if not ok then stateError = tostring(err) end
        return ok and RiftRemotes ~= nil
    end
    RiftBox = EventTab:AddLeftGroupbox("🌀 Rift")
    local eventLabel, flowLabel
    CHK.Merge(RiftBox, function()
        eventLabel = RiftBox:AddLabel("RiftEventLabel", { Text = "Checking Rift", DoesWrap = true })
        flowLabel = RiftBox:AddLabel("RiftFlowLabel", { Text = "🔴 Off", DoesWrap = true })
    end)
    local wake = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
    getgenv().__CHSAE_RiftWake = wake
    local function wakeWorker(reason)
        if sessionAlive() then pcall(function() wake:Fire(reason or "state") end) end
    end
    local function setFlow(text)
        RuntimeStatus.adminEventFlow = text
        RuntimeStatus.setLabel(flowLabel, text)
        RuntimeStatus.wakeOverlay("rift-flow")
    end
    local function saveNow()
        local ok, value = pcall(Save.Get)
        if ok and type(value) == "table" and type(value.Inventory) == "table"
            and type(value.EggInventory) == "table" then return value end
        return nil
    end
    local function valueReady()
        -- Native module calls can lower this worker's GUI capabilities even
        -- when the executor still reports identity 8. Scope the non-yielding
        -- textbox check explicitly and always restore the caller's identity.
        local identity = type(getthreadidentity) == "function" and getthreadidentity() or nil
        if type(setthreadidentity) == "function" then pcall(setthreadidentity, 8) end
        local ok, ready = pcall(RuntimeStatus.sellerValueFilterReady, "RiftMinimumValue")
        if identity ~= nil and type(setthreadidentity) == "function" then pcall(setthreadidentity, identity) end
        return ok and ready == true
    end
    local function refreshState()
        if stateRequest or os.clock() < stateRetryAt or not modules() then return end
        local request = { started = os.clock() }
        stateRequest = request
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, result = pcall(function() return RiftRemotes.AskState:InvokeServer() end)
            if not sessionAlive() then return end
            if ok and type(result) == "table" then
                state, stateAt, stateError = result, os.clock(), nil
            else
                stateError = tostring(result)
                stateRetryAt = os.clock() + 3
            end
            stateRequest = nil
            wakeWorker("state")
        end)
    end
    local function protectedTransaction()
        if RuntimeStatus.carryLossRecoveryPending() then return true end
        local request = getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
        if type(request) == "table" then
            if request.inFlight then return true end
            local untilAt = tonumber(request.proofDeadline)
                or ((tonumber(request.completedAt) or tonumber(request.started) or 0) + 0.6)
            if request.accepted and os.clock() <= untilAt then return true end
        end
        return carrying or carriedAreaEgg() ~= nil or Arb.critical
            or (Arb.owner == "Steal" and stealRuntime.lockedUid ~= nil)
    end
    -- [[ RIFT NORMAL TARGET CHECK ]] --
    local function normalStealTargetAvailable()
        if Settings.AutoSteal ~= true then return false end
        local index = RuntimeStatus.candidateIndex
        if not (index and type(index.entries) == "table") then return false end
        local function selected(values)
            for _, value in pairs(values) do if value then return true end end
            return false
        end
        local rf, cf, af = selected(Settings.TargetRarities), selected(Settings.TargetCategories), selected(Settings.TargetAreas)
        if not rf and not cf and not af and not Settings.TargetPriority
            and not RuntimeStatus.kgFilterActive(Settings.TargetKGMode, Settings.TargetKGThreshold)
            and not RuntimeStatus.valueFilterActive(Settings.TargetValueThreshold) then return false end
        for _, entry in ipairs(index.entries) do
            local raw, rarity = entry.rec, entry.rarity
            if raw and tostring(raw.State) == "Slot" and raw.BottomCFrame and rarity
                and not RuntimeStatus.isCaptureEventUid(raw.Uid)
                and areaAllowed(raw.AreaId)
                and not RuntimeStatus.riftTargetBlocked(raw.Uid)
                and (not rf or Settings.TargetRarities[tostring(rarity._id)] == true)
                and (not cf or Settings.TargetCategories[tostring(raw.AssetCategory)] == true)
                and (not af or Settings.TargetAreas[tostring(raw.AreaId)] == true)
                and RuntimeStatus.kgFilterMatches(entry.weight, Settings.TargetKGMode, Settings.TargetKGThreshold, entry.weightKnown)
                and RuntimeStatus.valueFilterMatches(entry.value, Settings.TargetValueThreshold, "atLeast", entry.valueKnown)
                and (Settings.TargetPriority ~= "Mutation" or #entry.mutations > 0) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    RuntimeStatus.normalStealTargetAvailable = normalStealTargetAvailable
    -- [[ END RIFT NORMAL TARGET CHECK ]] --
    local function releaseBody()
        if Arb.owner == "AdminEvent" then Arb.critical = false; Arb.release("AdminEvent") end
        RuntimeStatus.riftWantsBody, RuntimeStatus.adminEventPending = false, false
        RuntimeStatus.adminEventActive = false
        ProgressionCtl.refreshEventPending()
    end
    local function resetIntent()
        RuntimeStatus.riftCollecting, RuntimeStatus.riftTargetUid = false, nil
        RuntimeStatus.riftPlacementWanted = false
        releaseBody()
    end
    local function riftRewardCapacityReady()
        local full, count, capacity = RuntimeStatus.eggInventoryCapacityState()
        if not full then return true end
        -- A Rift trade-in/claim creates an egg. Do this before acquireBody, so
        -- a full inventory cannot dismount the player only to receive the
        -- inevitable server rejection and let Auto Treadmill re-enter.
        resetIntent()
        nextActionAt = math.max(nextActionAt, os.clock() + 3)
        setFlow(("⏸️ Egg inventory full (%d/%d) · Rift submission paused")
            :format(tonumber(count) or 0, tonumber(capacity) or 0))
        return false
    end
    local function petCandidates(save)
        local list, equipped = {}, {}
        for _, uid in pairs(save.EquippedAssets or {}) do equipped[tostring(uid)] = true end
        local held = RuntimeStatus.externallyHeldPetUid()
        for uid, raw in pairs(save.Inventory) do
            if not equipped[tostring(uid)] and tostring(uid) ~= tostring(held) then
                local nativeOk, allowed = pcall(FuseKernel.MayEnterRift, uid, raw)
                local decoded, item = pcall(AssetItems.Decode, raw)
                if nativeOk and allowed == true and decoded and type(item) == "table"
                    and item.IsFavorite ~= true and item.InFuse ~= true then
                    local value, known = RuntimeStatus.riftValueScore(item)
                    if Planner.ValueAllowed(value, known, Settings.RiftMinimumValue) then
                        list[#list + 1] = { uid = tostring(uid), category = item.Category, value = value,
                            waiting = os.clock() < (tonumber(RuntimeStatus.hatchProtectedPetUids[tostring(uid)]) or 0) }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return list
    end
    local function eggCandidates(save)
        local list, seen = {}, {}
        for uid, raw in pairs(save.EggInventory) do
            local ok, egg = pcall(EggRecords.Decode, raw)
            local decoded, item = pcall(EggRecords.ToAssetItemData, ok and egg or raw)
            local value, known = RuntimeStatus.riftValueScore(decoded and item or raw)
            if raw.IsFavorite ~= true and raw.InFuse ~= true
                and Planner.ValueAllowed(value, known, Settings.RiftMinimumValue) then
                local key = tostring(uid)
                seen[key] = true
                list[#list + 1] = { uid = key, category = decoded and item.Category or raw.AssetCategory or raw.Category,
                    value = value, placed = raw.Placement ~= nil }
            end
        end
        -- Preserve exact claim/hatch UIDs during separate replication packets.
        for uid, handoff in pairs(RuntimeStatus.riftEggHandoffs) do
            if os.clock() - handoff.at > 10 then RuntimeStatus.riftEggHandoffs[uid] = nil
            elseif not seen[uid] then
                list[#list + 1] = { uid = uid, category = handoff.category, value = 0, placed = true }
            end
        end
        return list
    end
    local function updatePlan(save)
        plan = Planner.Plan(state, petCandidates(save), eggCandidates(save))
        RuntimeStatus.riftPlan = plan
        RuntimeStatus.riftReservedPets = plan and plan.pets or {}
        RuntimeStatus.riftReservedEggs = plan and plan.eggs or {}
        RuntimeStatus.riftInventoryCount = 0
        if plan then
            local lines = { "🌀 " .. tostring(state.BannerDisplayName or state.BannerId or "Rift") }
            for _, slot in ipairs(plan.slots) do
                local status = slot.petUid and (slot.waiting and "waiting for pet" or "ready")
                    or slot.eggUid and (slot.placed and "hatching" or "place egg") or "missing"
                lines[#lines + 1] = slot.category .. " · " .. status
                if slot.eggUid then RuntimeStatus.riftInventoryCount += 1 end
            end
            RuntimeStatus.setLabel(eventLabel, table.concat(lines, "\n"))
        end
    end
    local function fieldTarget()
        local best, distance, count = nil, math.huge, 0
        local root = getCharParts()
        -- Match normal stealing: area speed signs are recommendations, not filters.
        -- Read current records so a stale selection cache cannot hide a required egg.
        for _, raw in pairs(areaEggRecords()) do
            if raw and plan.missing[tostring(raw.AssetCategory)] and raw.BottomCFrame
                and (raw.State == "Slot" or raw.State == "Dropped")
                and not RuntimeStatus.isCaptureEventUid(raw.Uid)
                and not RuntimeStatus.riftTargetBlocked(raw.Uid) then
                local value, known = RuntimeStatus.riftValueScore(raw)
                if Planner.ValueAllowed(value, known, Settings.RiftMinimumValue) then
                    count += 1
                    local d = root and (root.Position - raw.BottomCFrame.Position).Magnitude or 0
                    if d < distance then best, distance = raw, d end
                end
            end
        end
        RuntimeStatus.riftFieldCount = count
        return best
    end
    local function transaction()
        local q = getgenv().__CHSAE_RiftTransaction
        if type(q) == "table" and q.jobId ~= game.JobId then
            getgenv().__CHSAE_RiftTransaction = nil
            return nil
        end
        return type(q) == "table" and q or nil
    end
    local function reconcileRequest(save)
        local q = transaction()
        if not q then return false end
        Arb.petsBusy, Arb.remoteActivity = true, "Rift " .. tostring(q.action)
        RuntimeStatus.riftReservedPets = q.petSet or {}
        -- The request has already been dispatched. Let main Steal take the body
        -- while this worker retains the exact transaction and inventory lock.
        if Arb.owner == "AdminEvent" and not Arb.hold("AdminEvent") then releaseBody() end
        if q.inFlight then setFlow("⏳ Waiting for Rift server response"); return true end
        local fresh = state and stateAt >= (q.finishedAt or math.huge)
        local removed = true
        for uid in pairs(q.petSet or {}) do if save.Inventory[uid] then removed = false end end
        local newEgg = false
        for uid in pairs(save.EggInventory) do if not q.eggsBefore[uid] then newEgg = true break end end
        local verified = fresh and ((q.action == "trade" and removed and state.PendingReward)
            or (q.action == "claim" and not state.PendingReward and newEgg))
        local rejected = q.ok == true and q.accepted == false
        if verified or rejected then
            getgenv().__CHSAE_RiftTransaction = nil
            Arb.petsBusy, Arb.remoteActivity = false, nil
            releaseBody()
            nextActionAt = os.clock() + (rejected and 3 or 0.5)
            setFlow(verified and (q.action == "claim" and "✅ Rift egg claimed" or "✅ Pets submitted")
                or ("⏸️ Rift rejected: " .. tostring(q.message):sub(1, 110)))
            return true
        end
        setFlow("⏳ Verifying Rift " .. q.action .. " · waiting for inventory and reward state")
        return true
    end
    local function acquireBody()
        if protectedTransaction() or Arb.petsBusy or Arb.hatchBusy or Arb.placeBusy then return false end
        if Arb.owner == "AdminEvent" and not Arb.hold("AdminEvent") then
            releaseBody()
            return false
        end
        RuntimeStatus.riftWantsBody, RuntimeStatus.adminEventPending = true, true
        ProgressionCtl.refreshEventPending()
        ProgressionCtl.requestTreadmillExit()
        if ProgressionCtl.detectActiveTreadmill() ~= nil or not Arb.acquire("AdminEvent") then return false end
        RuntimeStatus.adminEventName, RuntimeStatus.adminEventActive = "Rift", true
        Arb.hold("AdminEvent")
        return true
    end
    local function beginRequest(action, save)
        if transaction() or os.clock() < nextActionAt
            or not valueReady() then return end
        -- Fresh native state and a fresh inventory are checked immediately before
        -- the sole atomic call. Refresh *before* taking the movement body: the
        -- old order reserved AdminEvent, dismounted the treadmill, then noticed
        -- this state was stale and returned. The next planner pass released the
        -- reservation, letting Auto Treadmill mount again and repeat that loop.
        if os.clock() - stateAt > 1.5 or stateRequest then
            refreshState()
            setFlow("Refreshing Rift state before submission")
            return
        end
        if not riftRewardCapacityReady() then return end
        if not acquireBody() then return end
        save = saveNow()
        if not save or Settings.AutoRift ~= true or not riftRewardCapacityReady() then
            releaseBody()
            return
        end
        local q = { jobId = game.JobId, action = action, inFlight = true, started = os.clock(),
            petSet = {}, uids = {}, eggsBefore = {} }
        for uid in pairs(save.EggInventory) do q.eggsBefore[uid] = true end
        if action == "trade" then
            local check = Planner.Plan(state, petCandidates(save), eggCandidates(save))
            if not check or not check.ready or check.signature ~= plan.signature or state.PendingReward then
                releaseBody(); return
            end
            for i, slot in ipairs(check.slots) do q.uids[i] = slot.petUid; q.petSet[slot.petUid] = true end
            RuntimeStatus.riftReservedPets = q.petSet
        elseif not state.PendingReward then releaseBody(); return end
        getgenv().__CHSAE_RiftTransaction = q
        Arb.petsBusy, Arb.remoteActivity = true, "Rift " .. action
        setFlow(action == "trade" and "Submitting three required pets" or "Claiming Rift egg")
        task.spawn(function()
            q.ok, q.accepted, q.message = pcall(function()
                if action == "trade" then return RiftRemotes.AskTradeIn:InvokeServer(q.uids) end
                return RiftRemotes.AskFinishReveal:InvokeServer()
            end)
            q.finishedAt, q.inFlight = os.clock(), false
            if sessionAlive() then refreshState(); wakeWorker("response") end
        end)
    end
    local function step()
        if not modules() then setFlow("Rift modules unavailable"); return end
        if os.clock() - stateAt > 3 then refreshState() end
        local save = saveNow()
        if not save then setFlow("Waiting for inventory"); return end
        if reconcileRequest(save) then
            if Arb.owner == "AdminEvent" then Arb.hold("AdminEvent") end
            return
        end
        local liveOk, live = pcall(Eligibility.IsFeatureLive)
        RuntimeStatus.riftActive = liveOk and live == true
        RuntimeStatus.adminEventStatus = RuntimeStatus.riftActive and "Rift is live" or "Rift is unavailable"
        if Settings.AutoRift ~= true then
            resetIntent()
            RuntimeStatus.riftReservedPets, RuntimeStatus.riftReservedEggs = {}, {}
            if state and Planner.Signature(state) then
                RuntimeStatus.setLabel(eventLabel, "🌀 " .. tostring(state.BannerDisplayName or state.BannerId)
                    .. "\n" .. table.concat(state.Requirements, "\n"))
            end
            setFlow("🔴 Off")
            return
        end
        if not state or os.clock() - stateAt > 10 then
            resetIntent(); setFlow(stateError and "Rift state unavailable" or "Checking Rift requirements"); return
        end
        if not RuntimeStatus.riftActive or state.Unlocked ~= true then
            resetIntent(); setFlow("Rift is closed or locked"); return
        end
        updatePlan(save)
        if not valueReady() then
            if not protectedTransaction() then resetIntent() end
            setFlow("Waiting for the protection value to finish editing")
            return
        end
        local normal = normalStealTargetAvailable()
        -- PriorityEvent is retained for config compatibility. Eligible normal
        -- steals always win; Rift work resumes as soon as none are available.
        local action = Planner.Action(true, protectedTransaction(), normal, false, state.PendingReward, plan)
        RuntimeStatus.riftPriorityYield = action == "normal"
        if action == "transaction" then setFlow("Finishing the current steal"); return end
        resetIntent()
        if action == "normal" then setFlow("Normal steal has priority")
        elseif action == "trade" or action == "claim" then beginRequest(action, save)
        elseif action == "place" then
            RuntimeStatus.riftPlacementWanted = true
            if RuntimeStatus.wakeRiftPen then RuntimeStatus.wakeRiftPen("rift-place") end
            setFlow("Placing required eggs in your pen")
        elseif action == "collect" then
            local target = fieldTarget()
            if target then
                RuntimeStatus.riftCollecting, RuntimeStatus.riftTargetUid = true, tostring(target.Uid)
                setFlow(Settings.StealMovementType .. " · collecting " .. tostring(target.AssetCategory))
                if wakeEggScanner then wakeEggScanner("rift-collect") end
            else setFlow("Waiting for a missing required egg to spawn") end
        elseif action == "hatch" then
            if RuntimeStatus.wakeRiftPen then RuntimeStatus.wakeRiftPen("rift-hatch") end
            setFlow("Waiting for required pets to hatch")
        else setFlow("Waiting for three Rift requirements") end
    end
    RuntimeStatus.addValueFilterInput(RiftBox, "RiftMinimumValue", "RiftMinimumValue", "Protect Minimum Value", function()
        wakeWorker("protection")
    end)
    local toggle = RiftBox:AddToggle("AutoRiftToggle", {
        Text = "Auto Rift", Default = Settings.AutoRift,
        Tooltip = "Collect and hatch required eggs, then claim Rift rewards.",
    })
    toggle:OnChanged(function(value)
        Settings.AutoRift = value == true
        if not value then
            RuntimeStatus.riftCollecting = false
            RuntimeStatus.riftPlacementWanted = false
            if not transaction() then resetIntent() end
        end
        configSave(true); wakeWorker("toggle")
        if wakeEggScanner then wakeEggScanner("rift-toggle") end
    end)
    Settings.PriorityEvent = false -- retired override, accepted in old profiles
    getgenv().__CHSAE_ConfigControllers.AutoRift = toggle
    if getgenv().__CHSAE_Debug then
        getgenv().__CHSAE_Debug.GetRift = function()
            return { State = state, Plan = plan, Flow = RuntimeStatus.adminEventFlow,
                MinimumValue = Settings.RiftMinimumValue, PriorityEvent = Settings.PriorityEvent,
                Request = transaction(), Error = stateError }
        end
        getgenv().__CHSAE_Debug.PreviewRift = function()
            local save = modules() and saveNow()
            return save and Planner.Plan(state, petCandidates(save), eggCandidates(save)) or nil
        end
    end
    -- [[ RIFT EVENT WORKER ]] --
    local pending = false
    trackScanConnection(wake.Event, function() pending = true end)
    trackScanConnection(scanWake.Event, function(reason)
        -- Collecting wakes Auto-Steal; it must not wake its own planner again.
        if reason ~= "rift-collect" and (Settings.AutoRift or transaction()) then wakeWorker(reason) end
    end)
    for _, name in ipairs({ "AreaEggRecordUpdated", "AreaEggRecordRemoved",
        "AreaEggCarryStateChanged", "RuntimeSnapshotUpdated" }) do
        trackScanConnection(EggCmds[name], function()
            if Settings.AutoRift or transaction() then wakeWorker("eggs") end
        end)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        if modules() and RiftRemotes.BannerRotated then
            trackScanConnection(RiftRemotes.BannerRotated.OnClientEvent, function()
                stateAt = 0
                wakeWorker("banner")
            end)
        end
        while sessionAlive() do
            pending = false
            local ok, err = pcall(step)
            if not ok then
                if not transaction() then resetIntent() end
                setFlow("Rift paused: " .. tostring(err):sub(1, 140))
            end
            if not sessionAlive() then break end
            if not pending then
                -- Only server state lacks a complete push signal. Retain its
                -- refresh interval, plus any pending action's actual deadline.
                local now = os.clock()
                local due = (not state or stateRequest) and now + 3 or math.max(stateAt + 3, stateRetryAt)
                if nextActionAt > now then due = math.min(due, nextActionAt) end
                if not ok then due = now + 3 end
                local timer = task.delay(math.max(0.1, due - now), function() wakeWorker("deadline") end)
                wake.Event:Wait()
                pcall(task.cancel, timer)
            end
            -- Coalesce bursts; wakes received while step yields stay pending.
            if sessionAlive() then task.wait(0.1) end
        end
    end)
    -- [[ END RIFT EVENT WORKER ]] --
end)() -- independent Rift state machine

do
    local FLIGHT_SPEED = 500
    local FLAT_XZ = Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
    local createFlight = function(d)
    local m = { root = nil, support = nil, height = nil, reason = "idle" }
    function m:Stop()
        if self.support then d.destroy(self.support) end
        self.root, self.support, self.height = nil, nil, nil
    end
    function m:Step(root, allowed, height)
        if not allowed or not root or type(height) ~= "number" or height ~= height
            or math.abs(height) == math.huge then self.reason = "flight prerequisites"; self:Stop(); return false end
        if self.root ~= root then self:Stop() end
        local position, velocity, mass = d.sample(root)
        if mass <= 0 or mass == math.huge or mass ~= mass
            or velocity.Magnitude > FLIGHT_SPEED * 1.2 then
            self.reason = "rig physics settling"; self:Stop(); return false
        end
        local delta = d.goal(root, height) - position
        local desired = delta.Magnitude > 0.15
            and delta.Unit * math.min(FLIGHT_SPEED, delta.Magnitude * 8) or Vector3.zero
        local registered, _, reason = d.register(root, desired, mass * (desired - velocity))
        if not registered then
            self.reason = reason or "movement registration unavailable"
            if reason == "renewing" and self.support then
                if d.pause then d.pause(self.support) end
                return true
            end
            self:Stop(); return false
        end
        self.reason = nil
        self.root, self.height = root, height
        if not self.support then self.support = d.create(root) end
        d.update(self.support, desired, mass)
        return true
    end
    m.Destroy = m.Stop
    m.Disconnect = m.Stop
    return m
end
    local flightDependencies = {
        sample = function(root)
            return root.Position, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, root.Anchored and math.huge or root.AssemblyMass
        end,
        register = function(root, desired, impulse)
            local direction = desired.Magnitude > 0 and desired.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
            local context = integrityBridge and integrityBridge.state
                and rawget(integrityBridge.state, "ImpulseContext")
            local origin = type(context) == "table" and context.OriginPosition
            local vertical = type(context) == "table" and tonumber(context.MaxVerticalSpeed)
            local upward = type(context) == "table" and tonumber(context.MaxUpwardDistance)
            local covered = typeof(origin) == "Vector3" and vertical and upward
                and math.abs(desired.Y) + 5 <= vertical
                and root.Position.Y - origin.Y + math.max(0,desired.Y) * 0.05 + 2 < upward
            return registerIntegrityTravel(root, direction, math.max(1,desired.Magnitude),24,impulse,not covered)
        end,
        pause = function(support)
            if support.active then support.velocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero end
        end,
        create = function(root)
            local character = root.Parent
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            assert(humanoid, "flight Humanoid unavailable")
            local support = {root=root, humanoid=humanoid, platformStand=humanoid.PlatformStand, active=true, collisions={}}
            local ok, issue = pcall(function()
                support.velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
                support.velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
                support.velocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
                support.gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
                support.gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
                support.gyro.D = 100
                support.gyro.P = 10000
                support.gyro.CFrame = root.CFrame
                local function track(part)
                    if support.active and part:IsA("BasePart") and part:IsDescendantOf(character)
                        and support.collisions[part] == nil then
                        support.collisions[part] = part.CanCollide
                    end
                end
                support.partAdded = character.DescendantAdded:Connect(track)
                support.partRemoving = character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(part)
                    if not support.active then return end
                    local canCollide = support.collisions[part]
                    if canCollide ~= nil then
                        support.collisions[part] = nil
                        pcall(function() part.CanCollide = canCollide end)
                    end
                end)
                for _, part in ipairs(character:QueryDescendants("BasePart")) do track(part) end
                support.velocity.Parent = root
                support.gyro.Parent = root
                humanoid.PlatformStand = true
            end)
            if not ok then
                support.active = false
                if support.partAdded then support.partAdded:Disconnect() end
                if support.partRemoving then support.partRemoving:Disconnect() end
                table.clear(support.collisions)
                if support.velocity then support.velocity:Destroy() end
                if support.gyro then support.gyro:Destroy() end
                humanoid.PlatformStand = support.platformStand
                error(issue)
            end
            return support
        end,
        update = function(support, desired)
            if not support.active then return end
            for part in pairs(support.collisions) do
                if part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
            end
            support.velocity.Velocity = desired
            local horizontal = desired * FLAT_XZ
            if horizontal.Magnitude > 0.15 then
                support.gyro.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(support.root.Position, support.root.Position + horizontal)
            end
        end,
        destroy = function(support)
            if not support.active then return end
            support.active = false
            support.partAdded:Disconnect()
            support.partRemoving:Disconnect()
            for part, canCollide in pairs(support.collisions) do
                pcall(function() part.CanCollide = canCollide end)
            end
            table.clear(support.collisions)
            support.velocity:Destroy()
            support.gyro:Destroy()
            support.humanoid.PlatformStand = support.platformStand
        end,
    }
    RuntimeStatus.newScrambleFlight = function(goal)
        local dependencies = table.clone(flightDependencies)
        dependencies.goal = goal
        return createFlight(dependencies)
    end
end
Window.__EventShopBox = EventTab:AddLeftGroupbox("🛍️ Event Shop")


do
    local S = { drones = {}, revision = -1, fullRevision = -1, droneRevision = -1,
        nextSnapshot = 0, nextAction = 0, stopped = false }
    RuntimeStatus.Scramble = S
    local box = EventTab:AddRightGroupbox("🧪 DR Scramble")
    local shopBox = Window.__EventShopBox
    Window.__ScrambleBox = box
    local label, timerLabel
    CHK.Merge(box, function()
        timerLabel = box:AddLabel("ScrambleOutbreakTimer", {Text="Outbreak: checking",DoesWrap=true})
        label = box:AddLabel("ScrambleStatus", {Text="Off",DoesWrap=true})
    end)
    local function updateTimer()
        local s,now=S.snapshot,workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        local w=s and s.Window
        local text="Outbreak: checking"
        if s and (s.Enabled~=true or now>=(tonumber(s.EventEndsAt) or 0)) then text="Event ended / unavailable"
        elseif w then
            local active=w.Active==true and now<(tonumber(w.EndsAt) or 0)
            local due=tonumber(active and w.EndsAt or w.NextAt)
            if due and due>now then
                local seconds=math.ceil(due-now)
                text=(active and "Outbreak ends in " or "Next outbreak in ")..string.format("%02d:%02d",math.floor(seconds/60),seconds%60)
            else text="Outbreak: updating" end
        end
        if S.timerText~=text then S.timerText=text;RuntimeStatus.setLabel(timerLabel,text) end
    end
    local wake = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
    local timer, pending = nil, false
    local function signal()
        if S.stopped or not sessionAlive() then return end
        pending = true
        wake:Fire()
    end
    local function status(text)
        if S.status == text then return end
        S.status = text
        pcall(function() label:SetText(text) end)
    end
    local function enabled()
        return not S.stopped and sessionAlive()
            and (Settings.AutoScrambleFarm or Settings.AutoScrambleQuest or Settings.AutoScrambleShop)
    end
    local function available()
        local s = S.snapshot
        return enabled() and s and s.Ready == true and s.Enabled == true and s.WorldReady == true
            and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < (tonumber(s.EventEndsAt) or 0)
    end
    local function applyDrones(packet)
        if type(packet) ~= "table" or packet.OwnerUserId ~= LocalPlayer.UserId
            or type(packet.Revision) ~= "number" or packet.Revision <= S.droneRevision then return end
        if not S.droneReady and not packet.Full then S.nextSnapshot = 0; return end
        if packet.Full then table.clear(S.drones); S.droneReady = true end
        S.droneRevision = packet.Revision
        for _, id in ipairs(packet.Removed or {}) do S.drones[id] = nil end
        for _, row in ipairs(packet.Upserts or {}) do
            if row.OwnerUserId == LocalPlayer.UserId and typeof(row.CFrame) == "CFrame" then S.drones[row.Id] = row end
        end
    end
    local function apply(packet)
        if S.stopped or not sessionAlive() or type(packet) ~= "table" then return end
        applyDrones(packet.Drones)
        local rev = packet.Revision
        if type(rev) ~= "number" then return end
        if rev > S.revision then S.revision = rev; S.state, S.ready = packet.State, packet.Ready end
        if not packet.Patch and rev > S.fullRevision then S.fullRevision = rev; S.snapshot = packet end
        if S.snapshot then S.snapshot.State, S.snapshot.Ready = S.state, S.ready end
        signal()
    end
    local function release()
        if S.releasePartInput then S.releasePartInput() end
        if S.walkHumanoid then
            local root=getCharParts()
            if root and S.walkHumanoid.Parent==root.Parent then S.walkHumanoid:MoveTo(root.Position) end
            S.walkHumanoid=nil
        end
        if S.flightConnection then S.flightConnection:Disconnect(); S.flightConnection=nil end
        if S.flight then S.flight:Stop(); S.flight=nil end
        S.flightGoal=nil
        local dev = RuntimeStatus.DevChickenTween
        if dev and dev.lease and dev.lease.owner == "Scramble" then dev.restore("Scramble released") end
        if Arb.owner == "Scramble" then
            if S.character == LocalPlayer.Character and S.bat and S.bat.Parent == S.character
                and S.bat ~= S.previousTool then
                local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                if backpack then S.bat.Parent = backpack end
            end
            Arb.release("Scramble")
        end
        S.character, S.bat, S.previousTool, S.action = nil, nil, nil, nil
        S.preparingPart,S.preparedPart=nil,nil
        S.stagedRoute=nil
    end
    function S:Disconnect()
        if self.stopped then return end
        self.stopped = true
        release()
        if timer then pcall(task.cancel, timer); timer = nil end
        wake:Fire()
        wake:Destroy()
    end
    getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns[#getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns+1] = S
    local function idle()
        local pending=getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest
        local bait=S.preparingPart and pending and pending.owner=="Scramble" and pending.purpose=="chicken-bait"
            and findAreaEgg(pending.uid)
        local ownBait=bait and bait.State=="Carried" and tonumber(bait.CarrierUserId)==LocalPlayer.UserId
        return available() and not Settings.Stall and not Arb.critical and (not carrying or ownBait)
            and not Arb.stealBusy() and not Arb.placeBusy and not Arb.petsBusy and not Arb.hatchBusy
            and not RuntimeStatus.riftWantsBody and not RuntimeStatus.riftCollecting
            and not RuntimeStatus.riftPlacementWanted and not resetWallClosed()
    end
    local function valid()
        if S.action and Settings[S.action]~=true then return false end
        if S.action=="AutoScrambleFarm" then
            local window=S.snapshot and S.snapshot.Window
            if not window or not window.Active or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()>=(window.EndsAt or 0) then return false end
        end
        return idle() and Arb.hold("Scramble")
    end
    local function acquire()
        if not idle() or not Arb.acquire("Scramble") then return false end
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if S.character ~= character then
            S.character = character
            S.previousTool = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        end
        if not ProgressionCtl.requestTreadmillExit() then status("Leaving treadmill");return false end
        if not setIntegrityGuard(true) then
            status("Waiting for movement controller")
            return false
        end
        return valid()
    end
    local function caveTeleporter()
        local objects=workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS")
        local zones=objects and objects:FindFirstChild("SecretZones")
        local cave=zones and zones:FindFirstChild("Cave")
        return cave and cave:FindFirstChild("Teleporter")
    end
    local function insideCave(root,teleporter)
        local landing=teleporter and teleporter:FindFirstChild("EntryTp")
        return root and landing and math.abs(root.Position.Y-landing.Position.Y)<40
            and (root.Position-landing.Position).Magnitude<160
    end
    local function stopPartFlight()
        if S.flightConnection then S.flightConnection:Disconnect();S.flightConnection=nil end
        if S.flight then S.flight:Stop();S.flight=nil end
        S.flightGoal=nil
    end
    local function moveDirect(position, reach, route, forceFlight)
        local dev = RuntimeStatus.DevChickenTween
        local root, humanoid = getCharParts()
        if not root or not humanoid or not valid() then return false, "movement unavailable" end
        route=route or S.action
        if S.stagedRoute~=route and not insideCave(root,caveTeleporter()) then
            local track=RuntimeStatus.getTrackStart()
            if not track then return false,"TrackStart unavailable" end
            if S.flightConnection then S.flightConnection:Disconnect();S.flightConnection=nil end
            if S.flight then S.flight:Stop();S.flight=nil;S.flightGoal=nil end
            local ready,reason=dev.begin(true,"Scramble",valid)
            if not ready then return false,reason end
            status("Going to TrackStart")
            local arrived,issue=dev.move(track.Position+Vector3.new(0,humanoid.HipHeight,0),0.35,valid,nil,resetWallClosed,500,true)
            if not arrived or not valid() then return false,issue or "staging cancelled" end
            S.stagedRoute=route
        end
        if forceFlight or S.flight or math.abs(position.Y-root.Position.Y)>8 then
            if dev.lease and dev.lease.owner=="Scramble" then dev.restore("Scramble flight") end
            if dev.lease then return false, "another movement owns the rig" end
            S.flightGoal=position
            local partArrived=false
            local function arrive()
                if forceFlight and (root.Position-position).Magnitude<=(reach or 0.5) then
                    partArrived=true;stopPartFlight();return true
                end
                return false
            end
            if not S.flight then
                S.flight=RuntimeStatus.newScrambleFlight(function() return S.flightGoal end)
                S.flightConnection=RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
                    local current, hum=getCharParts()
                    if current~=root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or root.Anchored or not valid() then release();return end
                    -- Endpoint hover used to request a 24-stud envelope at
                    -- nearly zero speed and release the quest before its hold.
                    if arrive() then return end
                    local ok, moved=pcall(function() return S.flight:Step(root,true,S.flightGoal.Y) end)
                    if not ok or not moved then release() end
                end)
            end
            local deadline=os.clock()+(position-root.Position).Magnitude/500+8
            while S.flight and valid() do
                if arrive() then return true end
                if (root.Position-position).Magnitude<=(reach or 0.5) then return true end
                if os.clock()>=deadline then break end
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            if partArrived and valid() then return true end
            release()
            return false, "flight interrupted"
        end
        local ok, reason = dev.begin(true,"Scramble",valid)
        if not ok then return false, reason end
        return dev.move(position,reach,valid,nil,resetWallClosed,500,true)
    end
    local function settle(position,reach)
        local root,humanoid=getCharParts()
        if not root or not humanoid then return false,"Character unavailable" end
        local deadline,stable,previous=os.clock()+10,nil,root.Position
        status("Waiting for arrival to settle")
        while valid() and os.clock()<deadline do
            local current,hum=getCharParts()
            if current~=root or hum~=humanoid or hum.Health<=0 then return false,"Character changed" end
            local correcting=integrityState and rawget(integrityState,"CorrectionContext")~=nil
            if not correcting and (root.Position-position).Magnitude<=reach
                and (root.Position-previous).Magnitude<=1
                and (tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")) or 0)<=workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
                stable=stable or os.clock()
                if os.clock()-stable>=2 then return true end
            else stable=nil end
            previous=root.Position
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        return false,"Arrival did not settle"
    end
    local function walk(position,reach)
        if S.flightConnection then S.flightConnection:Disconnect();S.flightConnection=nil end
        if S.flight then S.flight:Stop();S.flight=nil;S.flightGoal=nil end
        local dev=RuntimeStatus.DevChickenTween
        if dev.lease and dev.lease.owner=="Scramble" then dev.restore("Cave walking") end
        local root,humanoid=getCharParts()
        if not root or not humanoid or not valid() then return false,"Walking unavailable" end
        reach=reach or 4
        local function flatOffset()
            return Vector3.new(position.X-root.Position.X,0,position.Z-root.Position.Z)
        end
        local function stop()
            if not root.Parent then return end
            local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(0,velocity.Y,0)
        end
        S.walkHumanoid=humanoid
        local deadline=os.clock()+math.min(30,flatOffset().Magnitude/math.max(1,humanoid.WalkSpeed)+8)
        local brake=math.max(reach+8,12)
        local creepSpeed=24
        local nextMove,creeping,arrived,dt=0,false,false,1/60
        while valid() and os.clock()<deadline do
            local current,hum=getCharParts()
            if current~=root or hum~=humanoid or hum.Health<=0 then break end
            local offset=flatOffset()
            local distance=offset.Magnitude
            if distance<=reach then arrived=true;break end
            if not creeping and distance>brake then
                if os.clock()>=nextMove then humanoid:MoveTo(position);nextMove=os.clock()+0.25 end
            else
                creeping=true
                stop()
                root.CFrame=root.CFrame+offset.Unit*math.min(distance,creepSpeed*dt)
                humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position)
            end
            dt=RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        if S.walkHumanoid==humanoid then
            humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position)
            S.walkHumanoid=nil
        end
        stop()
        if arrived then return true end
        return false,"Cave walk interrupted or blocked"
    end
    local function crossCave(enter)
        local teleporter=caveTeleporter()
        local root,humanoid=getCharParts()
        if not teleporter or not root or not humanoid then return false,"Cave teleporter unavailable" end
        if (insideCave(root,teleporter)==true)==enter then return true end
        local gate=teleporter:FindFirstChild(enter and "Entry" or "Exit")
        local attachment=gate and gate:FindFirstChild("SecretZoneInteraction")
        local prompt=attachment and attachment:FindFirstChild("SecretZonePrompt")
        local approach=teleporter:FindFirstChild(enter and "ExitTp" or "EntryTp")
        local landing=teleporter:FindFirstChild(enter and "EntryTp" or "ExitTp")
        local trigger=rawget(getgenv(),"fireproximityprompt")
        if not prompt or not prompt.Enabled or not approach or not landing or type(trigger)~="function" then
            return false,"Cave prompt unavailable"
        end
        local goal=approach.Position+Vector3.new(0,humanoid.HipHeight+root.Size.Y/2,0)
        local moved,reason
        if enter then
            moved,reason=moveDirect(goal,0.5,"CaveEntry")
            if moved then moved,reason=settle(goal,2) end
        else
            local anchor=attachment.WorldPosition
            local back=Vector3.new(approach.Position.X-anchor.X,0,approach.Position.Z-anchor.Z)
            local stand=anchor+(back.Magnitude>0 and back.Unit*5 or Vector3.zero)
            moved,reason=walk(Vector3.new(stand.X,goal.Y,stand.Z),2)
        end
        if not moved or not valid() then return false,reason or "Cave travel cancelled" end
        if (root.Position-attachment.WorldPosition).Magnitude>prompt.MaxActivationDistance then
            return false,"Cave prompt out of range"
        end
        if S.flightConnection then S.flightConnection:Disconnect();S.flightConnection=nil end
        if S.flight then S.flight:Stop();S.flight=nil;S.flightGoal=nil end
        local dev=RuntimeStatus.DevChickenTween
        if dev.lease and dev.lease.owner=="Scramble" then dev.restore("Cave portal transition") end
        status(enter and "Entering Secret Cave" or "Leaving Secret Cave")
        trigger(prompt)
        local deadline=os.clock()+8
        while valid() and os.clock()<deadline do
            local current,hum=getCharParts()
            if current~=root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return false,"Cave character changed" end
            if (current.Position-landing.Position).Magnitude<15
                and math.abs(current.Position.Y-landing.Position.Y)<8 then
                S.stagedRoute=nil
                return true
            end
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        return false,"Cave portal arrival not confirmed"
    end
    local function move(position,reach,route)
        local enter=route=="EscapedExperiment" or route=="ExperimentVault"
        local crossed,reason=crossCave(enter)
        if not crossed then return false,reason end
        if enter then return walk(position,6) end
        return moveDirect(position,reach,route,route=="LostPart1" or route=="LostPart2")
    end
    local function request(action, id, args)
        if S.busy or not S.remotes or S.stopped or not sessionAlive()
            or (action~="Snapshot" and not enabled()) then return false end
        local ticket = {}; S.busy = ticket
        task.spawn(function()
            if S.stopped or not sessionAlive() or (action~="Snapshot" and not valid()) then S.busy=nil;signal();return end
            local ok, result = pcall(function() return S.remotes.Request:InvokeServer(action,id,args) end)
            if S.stopped or not sessionAlive() then return end
            if S.busy ~= ticket then return end
            S.busy=nil
            if ok and type(result)=="table" then
                apply(action=="Snapshot" and result or result.Snapshot)
                if action~="Snapshot" and result.Ok~=true then
                    status("Request declined: "..tostring(result.Reason or result.Error or action))
                    S.nextAction=os.clock()+5
                end
            else status("Event request failed");S.nextAction=os.clock()+5 end
            signal()
        end)
        return true
    end
    local function collectPart(id)
        -- Resolve again after travel: a streamed/floating part can replace the
        -- instance used for the destination. Completion comes from event state.
        local world=workspace:FindFirstChild("DrScrambleEvent")
        local model=world and world:FindFirstChild(id)
        local part=model and model.PrimaryPart
        local prompt=part and part:FindFirstChild("ClaimLostPart")
        local root,humanoid=getCharParts()
        if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or not root or not humanoid then
            return false,"Lost Part prompt unavailable"
        end
        local function collected() return S.state and (S.state.LostParts or {})[id]==true end
        if collected() then return true end
        local keyboard=game:GetService("UserInputService")
        local function available(holding)
            local current,hum=getCharParts()
            return not S.stopped and sessionAlive() and valid() and current==root and hum==humanoid
                and humanoid.Health>0 and part.Parent and prompt.Parent==part
                and not keyboard:GetFocusedTextBox()
                and (root.Position-part.Position).Magnitude<=prompt.MaxActivationDistance
                and (not holding or prompt.Enabled)
                and not (integrityState and integrityState.CorrectionContext)
                and (tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")) or 0)<=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        end
        if not available(true) then return false,"Lost Part hold not ready" end
        local duration=prompt.HoldDuration
        if duration<0 or duration>15 or duration~=duration then return false,"Invalid prompt hold duration" end
        local beganAt,triggered,holding=nil,false,false
        local began=prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function(player)
            if player==nil or player==LocalPlayer then beganAt=os.clock() end
        end)
        local fired=prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
            if player==nil or player==LocalPlayer then triggered=true end
        end)
        local function releaseInput()
            if holding then
                holding=false
                pcall(function() prompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
            end
            began:Disconnect();fired:Disconnect()
            if S.releasePartInput==releaseInput then S.releasePartInput=nil end
        end
        S.releasePartInput=releaseInput
        local ok,done,reason=pcall(function()
            status("Holding Lost Part prompt: "..id)
            holding=true
            prompt:InputHoldBegin()
            local sentAt=os.clock()
            local deadline=sentAt+duration+2
            while os.clock()<deadline do
                if collected() then return true end
                if not available(not triggered) then return false,"Lost Part hold interrupted" end
                if triggered and os.clock()-(beganAt or sentAt)>=duration then break end
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            releaseInput()
            if not triggered or os.clock()-(beganAt or sentAt)<duration then
                return false,"Lost Part prompt did not complete"
            end
            status("Waiting for part confirmation: "..id)
            S.nextSnapshot=0
            request("Snapshot")
            deadline=os.clock()+5
            while os.clock()<deadline do
                if collected() then return true end
                if not available(false) then return false,"Lost Part confirmation interrupted" end
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            return false,"Lost Part collection not confirmed"
        end)
        releaseInput()
        if not ok then return false,"Lost Part input failed: "..tostring(done) end
        return done,reason
    end
    local ids = {"MutationConsumable","LimitedTimeExperimentPet","Nibbles013","CashBooster","SpeedBoost","TreadmillBooster"}
    BindDropdownOverlay(shopBox,"ScrambleShopItemsDropdown","Scramble items",ids,{
        configKey="ScrambleShopItems",multi=true,store=Settings.ScrambleShopItems,
        text="Scramble items",displayMap={MutationConsumable="Scrambled mutation",LimitedTimeExperimentPet="Experiment #001",
            Nibbles013="Nibbles #013",CashBooster="2x Cash",SpeedBoost="1.25x Speed",TreadmillBooster="2x Treadmill"},
        onChange=function() configSave(true);signal() end,
    })
    for _, item in ipairs({{"AutoScrambleFarm","Auto Farm",box},{"AutoScrambleQuest","Auto Quest",box},
        {"AutoScrambleShop","Auto Buy Scramble",shopBox}}) do
        local key = item[1]
        local toggle = item[3]:AddToggle(key.."Toggle",{Text=item[2],Default=Settings[key]})
        toggle:OnChanged(function(value)
            Settings[key]=value==true
            S.nextSnapshot=0
            if not enabled() then release() end
            configSave(true);signal()
        end)
        getgenv().__CHSAE_ConfigControllers[key]=toggle
    end
    local function tick()
        updateTimer()
        if not enabled() then release();status("Off") end
        if not S.remotes then
            S.remotes=require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes).Scramble
            if not S.remotes then status("Event unavailable");return end
            for _, pair in ipairs({{S.remotes.State,apply},{S.remotes.Drones,function(packet) applyDrones(packet);signal() end}}) do
                local conn=pair[1].OnClientEvent:Connect(pair[2])
                getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns[#getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns+1]=conn
            end
        end
        if Arb.owner=="Scramble" and not valid() then release() end
        local dev=RuntimeStatus.DevChickenTween
        if dev and dev.lease and dev.lease.owner=="Scramble" then dev.lease.lastUse=os.clock() end
        if S.busy then status("Waiting for event response");return end
        if os.clock()>=S.nextSnapshot then
            S.nextSnapshot=os.clock()+(enabled() and 10 or 30)
            request("Snapshot")
            return
        end
        if not enabled() then return end
        if not available() then release();status("Waiting for event availability");return end
        if os.clock()<S.nextAction then return end
        local s,state=S.snapshot,S.state
        if type(state)~="table" then return end
        if not idle() then release();status("Waiting for higher-priority work");return end
        if Settings.AutoScrambleQuest and not state.Completed then
            local id,action
            if not (state.LostParts or {}).LostPart1 then id="LostPart1"
            elseif not (state.LostParts or {}).LostPart2 then id="LostPart2"
            elseif state.TotalParts==5 then
                -- Discover and claim together after collection: one cave visit.
                if not state.Discovered then id,action="EscapedExperiment","Discover"
                elseif s.VaultRewardReady then id,action="ExperimentVault","Vault" end
            end
            local row=id and s.Quest and s.Quest[id]
            if row and typeof(row.Position)=="Vector3" then
                S.action="AutoScrambleQuest"
                if not acquire() then return end
                status("Quest: "..id)
                local world=workspace:FindFirstChild("DrScrambleEvent")
                local model=world and world:FindFirstChild(id)
                local part=model and model.PrimaryPart
                local goal=part and not action and part.Position or row.Position
                local moved,reason=move(goal,0.5,id)
                if not moved then release();status(reason);S.nextAction=os.clock()+5;return end
                if not valid() then release();return end
                S.nextAction=os.clock()+3
                if action then request(action)
                else
                    local collected,issue=collectPart(id)
                    S.nextSnapshot=0
                    if collected then status("Part collected: "..id)
                    else release();status(issue);S.nextAction=os.clock()+3 end
                end
                return
            end
        end
        if Settings.AutoScrambleShop then
            for _, offer in ipairs(s.Shop or {}) do
                local bought=(state.ShopPurchases or {})[offer.Id]
                local count=type(bought)=="table" and bought.Period==s.ShopPeriod and (tonumber(bought.Count) or 0) or 0
                if Settings.ScrambleShopItems[offer.Id] and type(offer.Price)=="number" and offer.Price>0
                    and (state.Samples or 0)>=offer.Price and type(offer.Quote)=="string"
                    and (not offer.PurchaseLimit or count+(offer.Quantity or 1)<=offer.PurchaseLimit) then
                    S.action="AutoScrambleShop"
                    if not acquire() then return end
                    status("Buying "..tostring(offer.Label));S.nextAction=os.clock()+2
                    request("Shop",offer.Id,{Quote=offer.Quote,Sequence=state.ShopSequence})
                    return
                end
            end
        end
        if Settings.AutoScrambleFarm and s.Window and s.Window.Active and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()<(s.Window.EndsAt or 0) then
            local root=getCharParts()
            if not root then release();return end
            local best,distance
            local visuals=workspace:FindFirstChild("ScrambleLocalVisuals")
            for id,row in pairs(S.drones) do
                if (tonumber(row.Health) or 0)>0 and (not row.ExpiresAt or row.ExpiresAt>workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) then
                    local model=visuals and visuals:FindFirstChild("PersonalDrone_"..id)
                    local hitbox=model and model:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
                    if not hitbox or (tonumber(hitbox:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0)>0 then
                        local position=hitbox and hitbox.Position or row.CFrame.Position
                        local d=(root.Position-position).Magnitude
                        if not distance or d<distance then best,distance=position,d end
                    end
                end
            end
            if best then
                S.action="AutoScrambleFarm"
                if not acquire() then return end
                local tool=S.character and S.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                if tool and tool:GetAttribute("IsBat")==true and tool~=S.previousTool then S.bat=tool end
                status("Farming drones · Samples: "..tostring(state.Samples or 0))
                if distance>7 or S.stagedRoute~=S.action then
                    local delta=root.Position-best
                    local goal=best+(delta.Magnitude>0 and delta.Unit*5 or Vector3.zero)
                    if not move(goal,2) then release() end
                end
                return
            end
        end
        release()
        status("Samples: "..tostring(state.Samples or 0).." · Parts: "..tostring(state.TotalParts or 0).."/5 · "
            ..(state.Completed and "Quest complete" or "Waiting for outbreak / parts"))
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while sessionAlive() and not S.stopped do
            pending=false
            local ok,issue=pcall(tick)
            if not ok then release();status("Paused: "..tostring(issue));S.nextAction=os.clock()+3 end
            if S.stopped or not sessionAlive() then break end
            if enabled() then task.wait(.25)
            elseif not pending then
                timer=task.delay(1,signal)
                wake.Event:Wait()
                if timer then pcall(task.cancel,timer);timer=nil end
            end
        end
        S:Disconnect()
    end)
end

-- [[ SERVER BROWSER CONTROLLER ]] --
function RuntimeStatus.createServerBrowser(d)
    local c = { rows = {}, selected = nil, busy = false, revision = 0,
        status = "Enable Find Server or press Refresh", lastSuccess = nil, nextRefresh = 0 }
    local function finite(n) return type(n) == "number" and n == n and n >= 0 and n < math.huge end
    function c:Cancel()
        self.revision += 1
        self.busy = false
        self.status = "Find Server off"
        d.render(self)
    end
    function c:Select(id)
        for _, row in ipairs(self.rows) do
            if row.id == id then self.selected = id; d.render(self); return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function c:Refresh()
        if not d.alive() or self.busy or d.now() < self.nextRefresh then return false end
        self.revision += 1
        local revision = self.revision
        self.busy = true
        self.nextRefresh = d.now() + 10
        self.status = "Finding least-populated servers..."
        d.render(self)
        local function current() return d.alive() and self.revision == revision end
        d.delay(25, function()
            if current() and self.busy then
                self.revision += 1; self.busy = false; self.lastSuccess = nil
                self.nextRefresh = d.now() + 60
                self.status = "Request timed out. Try Refresh later."
                d.render(self)
            end
        end)
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            local found, seen, cursors, cursor = {}, {}, {}, nil
            for _ = 1, 3 do
                local page = d.fetch(cursor)
                if not current() then return nil end
                assert(type(page) == "table" and type(page.data) == "table", "Invalid server response")
                for _, row in ipairs(page.data) do
                    if type(row) == "table" and type(row.id) == "string" and row.id ~= ""
                        and row.id ~= d.jobId and not seen[row.id]
                        and finite(row.playing) and finite(row.maxPlayers)
                        and row.playing % 1 == 0 and row.maxPlayers % 1 == 0
                        and row.playing < row.maxPlayers then
                        seen[row.id] = true
                        found[#found + 1] = { id = row.id, playing = row.playing, maxPlayers = row.maxPlayers,
                            ping = finite(row.ping) and row.ping or nil, fps = finite(row.fps) and row.fps or nil }
                    end
                end
                cursor = page.nextPageCursor
                if #found >= 20 or type(cursor) ~= "string" or cursor == "" or cursors[cursor] then break end
                cursors[cursor] = true
            end
            table.sort(found, function(a, b)
                if a.playing ~= b.playing then return a.playing < b.playing end
                if a.ping ~= b.ping then return (a.ping or math.huge) < (b.ping or math.huge) end
                return a.id < b.id
            end)
            while #found > 20 do table.remove(found) end
            return found
        end)
        if not current() then return false end
        self.busy = false
        self.nextRefresh = d.now() + (ok and 10 or 60)
        if not ok then
            self.lastSuccess = nil
            self.status = "Refresh failed: " .. tostring(result):gsub("^.-:%d+: ", ""):sub(1, 150)
            d.render(self)
            return false
        end
        self.rows, self.lastSuccess = result, d.now()
        local keep = false
        for _, row in ipairs(result) do if row.id == self.selected then keep = true; break end end
        if not keep then self.selected = result[1] and result[1].id or nil end
        self.status = #result > 0 and (tostring(#result) .. " servers found · Fewest players first")
            or "No available public servers. Try Refresh later."
        d.render(self)
        return true
    end
    function c:Hop()
        if self.busy then return false, "Wait for the server refresh" end
        if not self.lastSuccess or d.now() - self.lastSuccess > 90 then return false, "Refresh the server list first" end
        for _, row in ipairs(self.rows) do
            if row.id == self.selected and row.id ~= d.jobId and row.playing < row.maxPlayers then
                return d.teleport(row.id)
            end
        end
        return false, "No available server selected"
    end
    return c
end
-- [[ END SERVER BROWSER CONTROLLER ]] --

-- [[ SERVER TAB ]] --
;(function()
    local controls = Window.__ServerTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Server Controls")
    local results = Window.__ServerTab:AddRightGroupbox("Available Servers")
    Window.__ServerControlsBox, Window.__ServerResultsBox = controls, results
    local status
    CHK.Merge(controls, function()
        status = controls:AddLabel("ServerSearchStatus", { Text = "Enable Find Server or press Refresh", DoesWrap = true })
    end)
    local toggle = controls:AddToggle("FindServerToggle", { Text = "Find Server", Default = Settings.FindServer,
        Tooltip = "Find low-player public servers now and refresh every 60 seconds." })
    local browser, render
    MakeButtonPanel(controls, "ServerBrowserButtons", {
        { "Refresh", function()
            task.spawn(function()
                if not browser:Refresh() and sessionAlive() then Library:Notify(browser.status, 4) end
            end)
        end },
        { "Server Hop", function()
            local ok, message = browser:Hop()
            if not ok then Library:Notify(message or "Unable to hop", 4) end
        end },
    })
    local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    list.Name = "CloverServerList"
    list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    list.BorderSizePixel = 0
    list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 340)
    list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
    list.ScrollBarThickness = 4
    list.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
    results:AddUIPassthrough("ServerListPanel", { Instance = list, Height = 340 })
    local empty = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    empty.Name = "EmptyServerList"
    empty.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 50)
    empty.Text = "No servers loaded"
    empty.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 165, 165)
    empty.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    empty.TextSize = 12
    empty.Parent = list
    local buttons = {}
    for i = 1, 20 do
        local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
        button.Name = "ServerRow" .. i
        button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 50)
        button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1 + (i - 1) * 54)
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 32)
        button.BorderSizePixel = 0
        -- Match VoidHub(GAG2)'s Buy List / Wild Pet list typography.
        button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 165, 165)
        button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
        button.TextSize = 12
        button.TextWrapped = true
        button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        button.Visible = false
        local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
        padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8); padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6); padding.Parent = button
        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner"); corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); corner.Parent = button
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Color = Library.Scheme.OutlineColor
        stroke.Thickness = 1
        stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        stroke.Parent = button
        button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local row = browser.rows[i]
            if row then browser:Select(row.id) end
        end)
        button.Parent = list
        buttons[i] = button
    end
    local function uiCall(fn)
        local identity = type(getthreadidentity) == "function" and getthreadidentity() or nil
        if type(setthreadidentity) == "function" then pcall(setthreadidentity, 8) end
        local ok, err = pcall(fn)
        if identity and type(setthreadidentity) == "function" then pcall(setthreadidentity, identity) end
        return ok, err
    end
    render = function(state)
        if not sessionAlive() then return end
        uiCall(function()
            -- SetText updates wrapping height when an error replaces a short status.
            status:SetText(state.status)
            empty.Visible = #state.rows == 0
            for i, button in ipairs(buttons) do
                local row = state.rows[i]
                button.Visible = row ~= nil
                if row then
                    local selected = row.id == state.selected
                    button.BackgroundColor3 = selected and Color3.fromRGB(45, 55, 45) or Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 32)
                    local stroke = button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if stroke then stroke.Color = selected and Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100) or Library.Scheme.OutlineColor end
                    button.Text = string.format("%s%d / %d players\n%s ms · %s FPS",
                        selected and "✓ " or "", row.playing, row.maxPlayers,
                        row.ping and tostring(math.floor(row.ping)) or "—",
                        row.fps and string.format("%.0f", row.fps) or "—")
                end
            end
            list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #state.rows * 54)
        end)
    end
    local function failHop(message, attempt)
        if not RuntimeStatus.serverHopPending or (attempt and RuntimeStatus.serverHopPending ~= attempt) then return end
        RuntimeStatus.serverHopPending = nil
        RuntimeStatus.intentionalDisconnectUntil = 0
        RuntimeStatus.intentionalDisconnectReason = nil
        browser.lastSuccess = nil
        browser.status = "Hop failed: " .. tostring(message) .. ". Refresh to try again."
        render(browser)
    end
    browser = RuntimeStatus.createServerBrowser({
        alive = sessionAlive, now = os.clock, delay = task.delay, jobId = game.JobId, render = render,
        fetch = function(cursor)
            local requester = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request
            assert(type(requester) == "function", "HTTP request unavailable")
            local url = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. tostring(game.PlaceId)
                .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&excludeFullGames=true&limit=100"
            if cursor then url ..= "&cursor=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(cursor) end
            local response = requester({ Url = url, Method = "GET", Timeout = 20 })
            assert(type(response) == "table", "Invalid HTTP response")
            local code = tonumber(response.StatusCode or response.status_code or response.Status)
